jobs.title: Commercial Operations Manager – Global Market Access
jobs.description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world's manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility -our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how thework we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that's you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

As a Global Commercial Operations Manager - Market Access, you will lead commercial operations for our Market Access teams, helping drive the adoption of global capabilities across regions while balancing the need for standardization with regional flexibility. You will play a key role in enabling effective planning, execution, and performance visibility across the organization by establishing consistent operating models that improve efficiency and support growth.

You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including Global Commercial Operations Centers of Excellence (Sales Planning, Enablement, and Reporting & Analytics), to deliver standardized tools, capabilities, and insights. Through these partnerships, you will support Market Access growth across distributors, system integrators, and machine builders.

You will be part of the Global Commercial Operations team, collaborating with regional Market Access leaders and cross-functional partners worldwide.

You will report to Global Commercial Operations Manager, Global Industry & Global Market Access.

Your Responsibilities:

  • Serves as the primary commercial operations lead for Regional Market Access teams.
  • Partners with Market Access leadership to operationalize growth strategies and execution priorities.
  • Defines operational requirements needed to support regional partner-led growth models.
  • Ensure Market Access teams have effective planning frameworks, execution tools, and performance visibility.
  • Leverages Global Commercial Operations COEs to design and deliver planning, enablement, and reporting capabilities required by Market Access.
  • Translates Market Access operational needs into scalable, COE-aligned solutions.
  • Ensures COE outputs are fit-for-purpose, adopted by regions, and delivering intended outcomes.
  • Drives standardization where it improves effectiveness and scalability supports justified regional variation.

  • Leads operational alignment of partner programs for Market Access in coordination with the Program Effectiveness team.
  • Ensure programs are executable within Market Access planning, enablement, and reporting workflows.
  • Provides feedback and recommendations on program effectiveness based on regional execution and results.

  • Supports go-to-market evolution, channel changes, and partner model development from an operational perspective.
  • Acts as the Market Access operations voice in cross-functional forums and transformation projects.
  • Supports transformation initiatives impacting Market Access execution.
  • Identifies and resolves operational friction across Market Access regions.

The Essentials - You Will Have:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, or related field MBA or equivalent business acumen preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in sales operations, sales planning, or a related strategic role experience in market access or partner operations is preferred.
  • Strong understanding of indirect sales channels (distributors, system integrators, OEMs/machine builders).

The Preferred - You Might Also Have:

  • Proven ability to balance strategic intent with operational execution.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to synthesize complex data into actionable insights.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills able to influence and align stakeholders at all levels.
  • Experience with change management frameworks and driving adoption across global teams.
  • Collaborative and adaptable, with a track record of working effectively across matrixed organizations.
  • Proficiency in Salesforce, Anaplan, and data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) is a plus.
  • Project management certification (e.g., PMP, Six Sigma) or continuous improvement experience is a strong advantage

What We Offer:

Our benefits package includes …

  • Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm
  • Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees
  • Company volunteer and donation matching program - Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation.
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program
  • On-demand digital course library for professional development

... and other local benefits!

Rockwell Automation's hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

jobs.title: Director, Clinical Data Management
jobs.description:
eClinical Solutions helps life sciences organizations around the world accelerate clinical development initiatives with expert data services and the elluminate Clinical Data Cloud – the foundation of digital trials. Together, the elluminate platform and digital data services give clients self-service access to all their data from one centralized location plus advanced analytics that help them make smarter, faster business decisions.

Overview

The Director, Clinical Data Management, is responsible for executing strategic direction and ensuring effective end-to-end data management services across programs and studies. This role has primary leadership responsibility for the India-based CDM organization and is accountable for elevating the quality, consistency, and predictability of clinical data delivery, ensuring that projects meet or exceed established quality standards, timelines, and financial targets. A key focus of the role is to strengthen and mature the Clinical Data Management (CDM) function by enhancing leadership effectiveness, reinforcing core data management fundamentals, and implementing consistent operational oversight and best practices. The Director will also lead the development and scaling of a high-performing team of Clinical Data Management professionals, data analysts, and subject matter experts focused on ongoing data review, proactive data surveillance, and generation of meaningful customer insights.

In parallel, the Director will play a critical role in modernizing the organization's data management capabilities through the adoption of risk-based methodologies, advanced analytics, centralized and AI-enabled data review, and other data-driven approaches aligned with broader business objectives. The role partners with internal and external stakeholders optimize data management technologies, processes, and standards while driving cross-functional collaboration to deliver scalable solutions that enhance operational effectiveness and customer value. As a Subject Matter Expert (SME), the Director also contributes to business growth through thought leadership, strategicconsulting, client engagement, and the advancement of differentiated data management and analytics capabilities.

Key Tasks & Responsibilities

  • Provide strategic leadership for the India-based Clinical Data Management (CDM) organization, ensuring high-quality, consistent, and predictable delivery of end-to-end data management services across programs and studies.
  • Drive the evolution and maturity of the CDM function by reinforcing data management fundamentals, and implementing standardized operational oversight, governance, and best practices.
  • Drive process improvements, automation initiatives, and adoption of emerging technologies in clinical data management.
  • Execute initiatives focused on modernizing data review and oversight processes through the use of data insights, analytics, and AI-enabled data review capabilities.
  • Build a culture of quality, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Ensure all CDM activities are executed in compliance with SOPs, ICH/GCP guidelines, regulatory requirements, and applicable quality standards while maintaining inspection readiness.
  • Establish, monitor, and report key operational metrics related to quality, productivity, cycle times, delivery predictability, and financial performance.
  • Develop and implement continuous improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency and scalability.
  • Oversee resource planning, talent development, organizational capability building, and succession planning to support current delivery needs and future business growth.
  • Partner cross-functionally with other operational teams to optimize data management processes, standards, systems integration, and delivery models.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) for Clinical Data Management, contributing to innovation initiatives, and development of scalable solutions that enhance customer value and operational effectiveness.
  • Support business development activities through thought leadership, strategic consulting, client presentations, proposal support, and participation in sponsor engagements
  • Foster strong client relationships by promoting a customer-centric culture focused on quality execution, transparency, responsiveness, and long-term partnership growth.
  • Provide regular operational and strategic updates to executive leadership regarding delivery performance, organizational health, risks, opportunities, and strategic initiatives.
  • Perform other duties and strategic initiatives as assigned.

Education

  • Minimum of 15 years of progressive experience in Clinical Data Management within CRO, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or medical device environments, including leadership of global clinical data management operations and delivery teams preferred.
  • Bachelor of Science degree / Master of Science, in Life Sciences, Health Sciences, Pharmacy,Nursing, Biotechnology, or a related scientific discipline preferred.

Professional Skills

  • Strong strategic leadership capabilities with the ability to drive organizational transformation, operational excellence, and scalable delivery models within Clinical Data Management.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive adoption of innovative technologies, including AI-enabled data review, analytics-driven oversight, and automation solutions that enhance quality, efficiency, and operational scalability.
  • Strong experience with Clinical Data Management systems, EDC platforms, and other clinical data acquisition technologies.
  • Excellent leadership, mentoring, and talent development skills with experience building and scaling high-performing delivery teams and future leaders.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex client relationships requiring multiple DM services and projects.
  • Proven ability to establish and monitor operational metrics, identify trends and risks, and implement data-driven process improvements.
  • Strong project management skills and experience with scope management, resource management, financial management, project planning and resource allocation
  • Strong prior customer interface experience with a demonstrated ability to develop, maintain and grow strong Client relationships.
  • A detail-oriented team player with strong organizational skills and the ability to multi-task, prioritize and plan within a high-energy, solutions-based environment where the customer comes first.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Technical Skills & Experience

  • Knowledge of ICH/GCP guidelines, 21 CFR Part 11 and clinical trial methodology
  • Experience with EDC and Clinical Data Management Systems: Medidata Rave is preferred.
  • Experience with clinical data reporting, visualization, and analytics platforms used to support operational insights, quality oversight, and proactive risk identification.

jobs.title: Experienced Clinical Research Associate
jobs.description:
Our successful Clinical Research Associates possess varied backgrounds in medical and other science-related healthcare fields. Individuals who have succeeded in the CRA role include:

  • Nurses
  • Dieticians
  • Pharmacy Technicians
  • Pharmaceutical/Device Sales Representatives
  • Biotech Engineers
  • PhD/Pharm.D candidates
  • Health and Wellness Coordinators
  • Research Assistants.

PACE® – MEDPACE CRA TRAINING PROGRAM

No research experience is needed as Medpace provides comprehensive initial and ongoing training, unmatched by other CROs. Through our PACE® Training Program, you will join other Professionals Achieving CRA Excellence:

  • PACE® provides the platform to effectively and confidently carry out your duties, enhance your current abilities and ultimately help you become a high-functioning independent Medpace CRA.
  • PACE® will prepare you by developing your CRA skills through interactive discussions and hands on job-related exercises and practicums.
  • To supplement your in-house and field-based training you may also participate in other clinical research departmental core rotations, learning other aspects of the drug/device development and approval process.

UNEXPECTED REWARDS

This role takes you on a journey through travel and excitement which will allow you to make a difference on a large scale through the enhancement of pharmaceuticals and medical devices. The CRA position provides many other distinctive advantages including:

  • Dynamic working environment, with varying responsibilities day-to day
  • Expansive experience in multiple therapeutic areas
  • Work within a team of therapeutic and regulatory experts
  • Defined CRA promotion and growth ladder with potential for mentoring and management advancements
  • Competitive pay and opportunity for significant travel bonus

Home-based option available for CRA for more than 1 year of monitoring experience.

Responsibilities

As a CRA, you will specifically be responsible for the following:

  • Conduct qualification, initiation, monitoring, and closeout visits for research sites in compliance with the approved protocol;
  • Communication with the medical site staff including coordinators, clinical research physicians and their site staff;
  • Verifying adequate investigator qualifications, training and resources, including facilities, laboratories, equipment, and staff;
  • Medical record and research source documentation verification against case report form data, including informing the site staff of any entry errors, ensuring good documentation practices are being adhered to and communicating protocol deviations appropriately per SOPs, GCP and applicable regulatory requirements;
  • Verification that the investigator is enrolling only eligible subjects;
  • Regulatory document review;
  • Medical device and/or investigational product/drug accountability and inventory;
  • Verification and review of adverse events, serious adverse events, concomitant medications and corresponding illnesses to confirm accurate data reporting in accordance with the protocol;
  • Assessing the clinical research site's patient recruitment and retention success and offering suggestions for improvement;
  • Completion of monitoring reports and follow-up letters, which includes providing summaries of the significant findings, deviations, deficiencies, and recommended actions to secure compliance.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree with at least 2 to 4 years of experience as a Clinical Research Associate;
  • Willing to travel approximately 60-80% nationally;
  • Familiarity with Microsoft® Office; and
  • Strong communication and presentation skills a plus.

Medpace Overview

Medpace is a full-service clinical contract research organization (CRO) providing phase l-lV clinical development services to the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and medical device industries. Our mission is to accelerate the global development of safe and effective medical therapeutics through the advancement of clinical research. We leverage in-country regulatory and therapeutic expertise across all major therapeutic areas including oncology, cardiology, metabolic, endocrinology, central nervous system, and anti-viral and anti-infective. Headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio, we employ more than 6,500 people across 40+ countries.

Why Medpace

When you join Medpace, you become part of an innovative team that brings cutting-edge therapies to market while building a meaningful and rewarding career focused on scientific excellence and improving patient outcomes around the world through continuous learning and cross-functional collaboration.

Purpose-Driven Work

    • Work alongside physicians, scientists, and industry-leading experts committed to advancing the global development of medical therapeutics through clinical research excellence
Collaborative Culture

    • Contribute to an interactive team environment that empowers decision making, creative thinking, and continuous learning through open communication and mutual trust.
    • Leadership throughout Medpace is both accessible and approachable
Continuous Growth & Development

    • Office based environment with on-site mentors
    • Defined career paths with clear advancement opportunities
    • Industry renowned onboarding and training programs designed to accelerate professional development
    • Ongoing training and continuous learning opportunities throughout your career
    • An environment that encourages employees to influence change, contribute ideas, and grow quickly

Other Employee Benefits

    • Competitive compensation programs that recognize and reward performance
    • Comprehensive health, wellness, retirement, and PTO benefits
    • Office based culture with occasional WFH that provides flexibility for eligible positions after training
    • Company-sponsored social events
Please note benefits may vary based on country.

What To Expect Next

A Medpace team member will review your application and if your profile matches our current needs, you will be contacted for an interview. While we review all applications carefully, we are unable to respond to every applicant, and only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.

jobs.title: Pediatric Physiotherapist
jobs.description:
Position Summary

TruHap Child Development Center is seeking a passionate and dedicated Pediatric Physiotherapist to support children with developmental delays, neurological conditions, Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD), ADHD, Cerebral Palsy, Down Syndrome, and other developmental challenges.

The therapist will focus on improving gross motor skills, posture, balance, coordination, strength, mobility, and functional independence while working closely with families and a multidisciplinary team to help children achieve their developmental goals.

Key ResponsibilitiesParent Consultation & Assessment
  • Conduct parent consultations to understand developmental concerns and functional challenges.
  • Perform comprehensive assessments of gross motor development, posture, balance, coordination, strength, mobility, and functional abilities.
  • Identify developmental delays and movement-related difficulties affecting daily activities.
  • Explain assessment findings and intervention plans to parents.
Goal Setting & Treatment Planning
  • Develop individualized short-term and long-term goals for each child.
  • Design treatment plans based on the child's developmental needs.
  • Review and modify goals based on progress and reassessment findings.
  • Create home exercise and activity programs for parents to support progress outside therapy sessions.
Therapy Sessions
  • Conduct one-on-one pediatric physiotherapy sessions.
  • Improve gross motor skills such as sitting, standing, walking, running, jumping, climbing, and stair navigation.
  • Work on balance, coordination, posture, strength, endurance, and motor planning.
  • Facilitate age-appropriate motor development and functional independence.
  • Use play-based and child-friendly therapeutic approaches.
  • Support children in achieving greater participation in school, home, and community activities.
Parent Guidance
  • Educate parents regarding developmental milestones and motor development.
  • Train parents in home exercise programs and carry-over activities.
  • Provide guidance on positioning, mobility, physical activity, and functional participation.
  • Conduct monthly Parent-Therapist Meetings (PTMs) to discuss progress and future goals.
Documentation & Reporting
  • Maintain daily therapy log sheets and treatment records.
  • Document session activities, progress, and outcomes.
  • Prepare progress reports and discharge summaries whenever required.
  • Ensure accurate and timely documentation as per center protocols.
Team Collaboration
  • Work closely with Speech Therapists, Behaviour Therapists, Special Educators, Psychologists, and other healthcare professionals.
  • Participate in multidisciplinary case discussions.
  • Contribute to integrated intervention planning for children.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Physiotherapy (BPT/MPT).
  • Experience or interest in Pediatric Physiotherapy.
  • Experience working with children with Autism, ADHD, Cerebral Palsy, Down Syndrome, Developmental Delay, and Neurological Conditions preferred.
  • Freshers with pediatric internship experience may also apply.
Skills Required
  • Strong understanding of pediatric motor development.
  • Knowledge of developmental milestones and neurodevelopmental conditions.
  • Excellent communication and parent counselling skills.
  • Strong observation, assessment, and documentation abilities.
  • Ability to engage children through play-based intervention.
  • Patience, empathy, and a child-centered approach.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
  • Achievement of child-specific developmental goals.
  • Parent satisfaction and engagement.
  • Timely completion of documentation and reports.
  • Consistency in conducting PTMs and parent education sessions.
  • Child progress in mobility, balance, coordination, posture, strength, and functional independence.
  • Effective collaboration with multidisciplinary team members.
Why Join TruHap
  • Work in a multidisciplinary child development center.
  • Opportunity to make a meaningful impact on children's lives.
  • Exposure to a wide range of developmental and neurological conditions.
  • Continuous learning and professional growth opportunities.
  • Supportive and collaborative work environment.

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Regulatory Affairs Manager
jobs.description:
Company Description EON MEDITECH PVT. LTD., based in Gujarat, India, is dedicated to the development and manufacture of surgical implants and instruments, with a core focus on ENT (Otorhinolaryngology). The company has achieved significant recognition in Otology by being the first in India to develop titanium middle ear implants and prostheses for complex micro ear surgeries. EON Meditech offers a comprehensive portfolio that includes ENT implants, ear grommets, rhinology and laryngology products, PVA dressing packs, specialized ENT instruments, plasma surgery systems, and gelatin sponges. As one of the first and only manufacturers for several of these categories in India, the organization is committed to innovation and to transforming the ENT space through high-quality, patient-focused solutions.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Regulatory Manager to manage EON Meditech's regulatory submissions, product registrations, and compliance documentation across domestic and international markets. You will work closely with the technical, quality, and international sales teams to ensure our products meet all applicable regulatory requirements in every market we operate in.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Manage product registration and renewal applications — CDSCO, CE, USFDA, and international markets (LatAm, Middle East, Africa)

• Prepare and maintain regulatory submissions, technical files, and design dossiers

• Ensure compliance with ISO 13485, MDR, QSR, and other applicable standards

• Coordinate with international distributors and regulatory agents for local country registrations

• Review product labelling, IFUs, and promotional materials for regulatory compliance

• Track changes in regulations across key markets and advise the team accordingly

• Support audits — internal, third-party, and regulatory authority inspections

• Maintain regulatory documentation archive in an organized and audit-ready manner

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• 5+ years of experience in regulatory affairs for medical devices

• Knowledge of CDSCO, CE marking, ISO 13485, and at least one international regulatory framework

• Excellent written English — you will write technical documents and regulatory submissions

• Detail-oriented with strong documentation and organizational habits

• Ability to work independently and manage multiple submissions simultaneously

• Experience with LatAm or Middle East regulatory processes is an added advantage.

About Apple Hospital

Apple Hospital is a NABH Accredited Multi-Specialty Hospital committed to delivering high-quality, patient-centered healthcare services. Equipped with advanced medical technology and a team of experienced healthcare professionals, we strive to provide safe, effective, and compassionate care to our patients.

We are currently seeking a dedicated and detail-oriented Registered Pharmacist to join our pharmacy team. The ideal candidate will play a vital role in ensuring the safe dispensing of medications, maintaining regulatory compliance, and supporting optimal patient care.

Key Responsibilities

  • Dispense prescribed medications accurately and in compliance with applicable regulations and hospital policies.
  • Review prescriptions for appropriateness, dosage accuracy, potential drug interactions, and contraindications.
  • Counsel patients and caregivers regarding medication usage, dosage schedules, storage requirements, and possible side effects.
  • Maintain proper records of medication dispensing and inventory management.
  • Monitor stock levels and coordinate procurement to ensure adequate availability of medicines and pharmaceutical supplies.
  • Verify the authenticity and validity of prescriptions received from healthcare providers.
  • Collaborate with physicians, nurses, and other healthcare professionals to support safe medication practices.
  • Ensure compliance with pharmacy regulations, quality standards, and hospital protocols.
  • Participate in medication audits, inventory checks, and quality improvement initiatives.
  • Maintain cleanliness, organization, and safety standards within the pharmacy department.
  • Assist in handling emergency medication requirements and critical care drug supplies when required.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm) or Diploma in Pharmacy (D.Pharm) from a recognized institution.
  • Valid registration with the State Pharmacy Council.
  • Strong understanding of pharmaceutical products, medication management, and dispensing practices.
  • Knowledge of pharmacy laws, regulations, and ethical standards.
  • Proficiency in pharmacy management software and basic computer applications.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and patient counseling skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to patient safety.

Preferred Qualifications

Data Management leadership on studies and take responsibility for the development of the project documentation, system set-up, data entry and data validation procedures and processes assigned to more junior staff. We are seeking an experienced Dermatologist to help evaluate and enhance large language model (LLM) outputs in the medical domain. You'll assess AI-generated clinical content for dermatological accuracy, safety, and relevance — contributing to the development of responsible AI in healthcare.

jobs.title: Statistical Programmer- Future Roles (India)
jobs.description:
Description

Statistical Programmer- Future Roles (India)

Syneos Health® is a leading fully integrated biopharmaceutical solutions organization built to accelerate customer success. We translate unique clinical, medical affairs and commercial insights into outcomes to address modern market realities.

Every day we perform better because of how we work together, as one team, each the best at what we do. We bring a wide range of talented experts together across a wide range of business-critical services that support our business. Every role within Corporate is vital to furthering our vision of Shortening the Distance from Lab to Life®.

Discover what our 29,000 employees, across 110 countries already know.

WORK HERE MATTERS EVERYWHERE

Why Syneos Health

  • We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
  • We are committed to our Total Self culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Our Total Self culture is what unites us globally, and we are dedicated to taking care of our people.
  • We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why Because when we bring together diversity of thoughts, backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives – we're able to create a place where everyone feels like they belong.

Job Responsibilities

  • Uses SAS or other software to develop custom programming code to generate summary tables, data listings, graphs and derived datasets as specified in the statistical analysis plan and programming specifications.
  • Works to ensure that outputs meet quality standards and project requirements. Performs validation programming and works with other Programmers, Biostatisticians, and other project team members to resolve discrepancies or any findings. Keeps project team members informed of programming progress and issues requiring their attention. Follow applicable SOPs, WIs, and relevant regulatory guidelines (e.g. ICH).
  • Maintains well organized, complete, and up-to-date project documentation, testing, and verification/quality control documents and programs ensuring inspection readiness.
  • Manages scheduling and time constraints across multiple projects at a time, sets goals based on priorities from management, and adapts to timeline or priority changes by reorganizing daily workload. Develops specifications for datasets and outputs of any complexity according to statistical and sponsor requirements. Anticipates and addresses potential programming issues, reflects forethought, establishes the basis for efficient programming and accurately defines all variables to be accepted by peer review and sponsor/requestor with little rework.
  • Prepares in advance for internal meetings, contributes ideas, and demonstrates respect for opinions of others.
  • Conducts effective internal meetings (appropriate in format, frequency and attendance). Distributes relevant information in advance. Ensures minutes are promptly and accurately distributed. Follows action items through to completion, and maintains order and focus of meetings, working toward consensus. Displays willingness to work with others and assist with projects and initiatives as necessary to meet the needs of the business. Negotiates and establishes accurate time estimates for completion of study programming activities with internal team members and statistical programming management, and completes project programming activities within timeframe allotted.
  • Acts as the lead statistical programmer. Directs the programming activities of other programming personnel and monitors progress on programming deliverables. Reviews project documentation such as Statistical Analysis Plan, mock shells, programming specifications, annotated CRFs, and SAS database design. Provides feedback to the appropriate project team members which reflects forethought and reduces inefficiencies in programming activities.
  • Participates in sponsor meetings, kickoff meetings, and bid defense meetings as statistical programming representative, as required by sponsor. Contributes to the mentoring of programming personnel through developing training courses, presenting training materials, reviewing work, and providing feedback or guiding new associates in process. Transfers deliverables. Performs other work-related duties as assigned.
  • Minimal travel may be required.

Qualifications:

  • Undergraduate degree, preferably in a scientific or statistical discipline; in lieu of degree, an equivalent combination of education and demonstrated programming experience.
  • Extensive programming experience in SAS or other required software, preferably in a clinical trial environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to read, write, speak and understand English.

We are always excited to connect with great talent. This posting is intended for a [possible] upcoming opportunity rather than a live role. By expressing your interest, you'll be added to our talent pipeline and considered should this role become available.

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you'll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

http://www.syneoshealth.com

Additional Information

Tasks, duties, and responsibilities as listed in this job description are not exhaustive. The Company, at its sole discretion and with no prior notice, may assign other tasks, duties, and job responsibilities. Equivalent experience, skills, and/or education will also be considered so qualifications of incumbents may differ from those listed in the Job Description. The Company, at its sole discretion, will determine what constitutes as equivalent to the qualifications described above. Further, nothing contained herein should be construed to create an employment contract. Occasionally, required skills/experiences for jobs are expressed in brief terms. Any language contained herein is intended to fully comply with all obligations imposed by the legislation of each country in which it operates, including the implementation of the EU Equality Directive, in relation to the recruitment and employment of its employees. The Company is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, including the provision of reasonable accommodations, when appropriate, to assist employees or applicants to perform the essential functions of the job.

Summary

Roles within the Statistical Programming job family are responsible for developing programs and providing statistical programming support for statisticians or for client or business use to address needs for sourcing, organizing (creating statistical tables, listings, and graphs), and interpreting complex data sets utilizing codes and programs. This includes developing codes that create analysis datasets, tables, and figures, evaluating programming processes, and suggesting revisions geared toward increasing productivity. Impact and Contribution Individual contributors with responsibility in a professional or technical discipline or specialty, but may manage two or fewer employees. May direct the work of lower level professionals or manage processes and programs. The majority of time is spent contributing to the design, implementation or delivery of processes, programs, and policies, using knowledge and skills typically acquired through advanced education. Individual contributor with developing subject matter expertise and responsibility for processes. In-depth knowledge and skills within a professional discipline, understanding the impact of work on related areas. May be responsible for entire projects or processes within area of responsibility.

jobs.title: Head of Technology Digital Public Health Program
jobs.description:
About The Organisation

The Antara Foundation (TAF) envisions a world where women and children do not suffer from preventable health conditions. We believe that every mother and each child deserves an equal start to a healthy life. We support the public health system deliver solutions at scale, to improve maternal and child health outcomes, by partnering with government and communities. Interventions of The Antara Foundation follow two closely integrated paths: to help the government system deliver better quality health care to the community and to support the community to mobilize and seek better health outcomes.

For more information visit www.antarafoundation.org

About The Digital Public Health Program

TAF's Digital Public Health Program (DPHP) is building the next generation of scalable, interoperable digital health systems, combining conversational AI, WhatsApp-based workflow automation, data pipelines, and decision-support tools. These systems are designed for real-world, low-resource settings and aim to support frontline workers and health systems in delivering timely, high-quality care.

We are an early-stage but rapidly scaling team, building at the intersection of public health, technology, and behaviour change. This requires individuals who can take ownership, solve problems independently, learn quickly, and operate comfortably in ambiguity while shaping evolving systems.

Role Overview

The Head of Technology is the most senior technical role in the organisation and will build, own, and run TAF's entire engineering function. Beyond technology ownership, this role is accountable for engineering delivery across TAF's digital product portfolio, ensuring products move efficiently from concept and pilot to production deployment and scale. You will set up and own the full technology stack, establish engineering culture and practices, lead and grow the in-house team, and ensure that everything TAF builds is production-grade, field-ready, and maintainable at scale.

You will be the technical authority that the CSO, Product Lead, and external partners rely on. You will hold our AI research and engineering partners accountable to delivery standards, lead architecture decisions, and translate complex technical realities into language that programme leadership and government stakeholders can act on.

This is a player-coach role. You will spend more time leading and shaping than writing code, but you will have the depth to review any deliverable, challenge any design decision, and step in when it matters. If you have built engineering functions from early stages, shipped production systems that real users in constrained environments depend on, and want to apply that experience to a public health challenge that matters at scale, we would love to hear from you.

What You Will Do

Build and Own the Engineering Function

  • Set up and own TAF's full technology stack end-to-end: cloud infrastructure (GCP), data pipelines, AI/ML layer, WhatsApp and voice interfaces, APIs, DevOps, and security, in a way that is scalable, documented, and can be built upon by others.
  • Own engineering execution against agreed product roadmaps and delivery commitments, translating product strategy into technical roadmaps, milestones, resourcing plans, and measurable outcomes.
  • Lead all architecture and infrastructure decision-making, balancing technical excellence, delivery timelines, organizational priorities, and field realities across the product portfolio.
  • Ensure products are delivered with speed, reliability, and maintainability, with the stack optimized for low-bandwidth, low-connectivity, and multilingual field environments.
  • Establish engineering standards, code review practices, documentation norms, and quality benchmarks that hold across in-house and partner-built systems.
  • Anticipate technical debt and systemic risks before they become problems, and make pragmatic decisions on build-vs-configure and make-vs-partner tradeoffs.

Lead and Grow the Engineering Team

  • Lead engineering hiring, onboarding, performance management, and capability development as the team scales.
  • Directly manage the in-house engineering team with clear expectations, regular feedback, and high accountability.
  • Actively mentor engineers, investing in their technical depth and professional growth, not just their task output.
  • Define team structures, role profiles, and capability needs as the engineering function grows with the program.
  • Create a culture of ownership, accountability, rapid learning, and execution excellence.

Hold External Partners Accountable

  • Serve as the primary technical authority in relationships with external AI research and engineering partners, including academic institutions.
  • Review, evaluate, and challenge technical deliverables: architecture proposals, codebases, models, APIs, against production-grade standards and program requirements.
  • Manage Statements of Work, delivery milestones, and technical reviews, ensuring accountability without micromanagement.
  • Make informed decisions on when to accept, push back on, or restructure partner deliverables.
  • Evaluate opportunities to transition strategic capabilities from external partners into sustainable in-house engineering capacity over time.

Integrate Across Product and Programme

  • Partner with the Product Lead to prioritize technical investments, make roadmap trade-offs, and ensure engineering effort is aligned with user and program impact.
  • Work closely with the Product Lead and Product Managers to translate program and user requirements into sound technical designs, ensuring field realities are built in from the start.
  • Establish predictable engineering processes that provide visibility into delivery timelines, risks, dependencies, and resource requirements.
  • Lead technical planning for digital pilots, new product development, and integrations with the government's public health and nutrition systems (ABDM, RCH/JANANI, ANMOL, Poshan Tracker, and HMIS) where TAF's products need to connect with or feed into national infrastructure.
  • Represent the technology function credibly with government counterparts, donors, and institutional partners where technical authority is required.
  • Support grant proposals, partner SOW reviews, and donor reporting with technically sound and accurate inputs.

Experience & Qualifications

  • 8+ years of professional experience building and shipping production-grade digital systems, with significant depth in full-stack, backend, or platform engineering, including at least 3 years leading engineering teams.
  • Demonstrated experience building or significantly scaling an engineering function: setting up infrastructure, establishing team culture, and owning the full stack in a resource-constrained environment.
  • Proven track record of directly managing and mentoring engineers. This is a non-negotiable requirement at this level.
  • Strong command of system architecture, API design, data pipelines, DevOps practices, and security fundamentals.
  • Experience building, integrating, or operating AI-enabled products in production environments.
  • Experience technically overseeing external engineering vendors or research partners, reviewing architecture, managing deliverables, and holding teams to a standard.
  • Prior experience in a resource-constrained environment: early-stage startup, GovTech, social enterprise, or nonprofit, where judgment under ambiguity and ownership across the stack were required.

Preferred

  • Hands-on familiarity with India's government digital health infrastructure: ABDM APIs, FHIR R4, RCH/JANANI, ANMOL, or HMIS, gained through direct integration or product work, not vendor implementation.
  • Experience with WhatsApp-based platforms, conversational AI systems, or ASR-LLM-TTS pipelines.
  • Demonstrated ownership of products or platforms from inception through deployment and scale, including technical design, delivery management, and operational responsibility.
  • Prior work with NHM, state health departments, or digital health organizations in a technical capacity.
  • Understanding of data privacy and consent frameworks relevant to health data in India.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Equivalent experience with a demonstrable portfolio of production systems and team leadership will also be considered.

Success in the first 12 months

Within the first 12 months, the Head of Technology will be expected to:

  • Build and lead a high-performing engineering team with clear ownership, strong practices, and a culture of accountability.
  • Establish scalable engineering practices, documentation standards, and deployment processes across the full stack.
  • Successfully deliver and maintain multiple production systems used by frontline health workers and program teams.
  • Create clear visibility into engineering delivery, technical risks, and resource requirements for organizational leadership.
  • Build a maintainable and scalable technology platform capable of supporting TAF's expanding digital health portfolio across states.
  • Reduce dependency on external engineering partners where strategically appropriate, by building in-house capability.

Who We Are Looking For

  • Builders who take full ownership of the stack, the team, and the standard, and do not wait to be told what needs fixing.
  • Leaders who develop engineers as seriously as they develop systems, and who understand that the quality of the team is as important as the quality of the code.
  • Technically authoritative but pragmatic, able to make sound decisions under uncertainty, without over-engineering, and comfortable revisiting decisions when the evidence demands it.
  • Strong communicators who can translate technical complexity for non-technical stakeholders across programme leadership, government, and donors, and who can hold their own in a room with both engineers and health system administrators.
  • Comfortable operating in highly ambiguous environments where product requirements, government priorities, and technical constraints evolve simultaneously.
  • Motivated by mission: genuine belief in the role of technology in strengthening public health systems for underserved communities and energized by the complexity of building in that context.

We are committed to building a thoughtful and diverse team across roles and levels, and encourage candidates with varied backgrounds and perspectives to apply.

This role collaborates closely with NLP, product, and operations teams to refine model outputs, build oncology data dictionaries, optimize abstraction logic, and ensure clinical accuracy across oncology workflows.

This role works at the intersection of oncology and artificial intelligence. The role is responsible for evaluating and refining AI-generated outputs from electronic health records and clinical databases to ensure accuracy, consistency, and protocol alignment.   • Serve as an oncology subject-matter expert to guide model optimization across solid and hematologic malignancies.
  • Identify systematic error patterns in AI outputs and propose workflow or model-level improvements.
  • Conduct second-level and quality-control reviews to benchmark AI performance.
  • Contribute to SOP development for AI-assisted abstraction workflows.

Qualification:

  • 3+ years of experience in oncology clinical data abstraction, clinical research, or patient-treatment data analysis.

  • Comfort working with AI-assisted workflows and structured data systems.

Education:

B.Sc (Nursing), BDS, BAMS, BHMS, MDS, BPharm, MPharm

1. We are revolutionizing a unique industry that has the potential to impact and benefit patients

from all over the world - you can create impact at scale.

jobs.title: Head of Regulatory Affairs
jobs.description:
Job Purpose

To lead and manage the Regulatory Affairs function for the company's injectable business, ensuring timely product registrations, regulatory compliance, lifecycle management, and successful market authorizations across domestic and international markets. The incumbent will be responsible for developing regulatory strategies, managing global submissions, and liaising with health authorities to support business growth objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Regulatory Strategy & Leadership

  • Develop and implement regulatory strategies for registration and commercialization of sterile injectable products in regulated and semi-regulated markets.
  • Lead the Regulatory Affairs team and provide technical guidance on global regulatory requirements.
  • Drive departmental objectives aligned with the organization's business goals and expansion plans.
  • Act as the primary regulatory representative during strategic business discussions and audits.

Product Registration & Market Authorization

  • Oversee preparation, review, and submission of dossiers in CTD/eCTD and country-specific formats.
  • Ensure timely filing of new product registrations, variations, renewals, and responses to deficiency queries.
  • Manage registrations across domestic, regulated, and ROW markets including, EU, UK, Canada, Australia, GCC, Africa, ASEAN, LATAM, and CIS regions.
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams to support product launches and market expansion activities.

Regulatory Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory guidelines, GMP requirements, and international standards.
  • Monitor changes in global regulatory requirements and assess their impact on existing products and operations.

Agency Interactions & Audits

  • Serve as the primary contact for regulatory authorities, customers, and business partners.
  • Coordinate and support regulatory inspections, GMP audits, and customer audits.

Dossier Management & Documentation

  • Ensure maintenance of accurate regulatory databases and document management systems.
  • Review technical documents including product specifications, stability data, validation reports, and quality documentation.
  • Oversee lifecycle management activities for approved products.

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Collaborate with R&D, Quality Assurance, Quality Control, Manufacturing, Business Development, and Supply Chain teams.
  • Provide regulatory assessments for new product development, technology transfers, and change control activities.
  • Support due diligence activities, licensing opportunities, and business partnerships.

Team Management

  • Lead, mentor, and develop the Regulatory Affairs team.
  • Establish performance objectives and monitor departmental productivity.
  • Ensure continuous learning and development within the regulatory function.

Qualifications

  • Master's Degree in Pharmacy (M.Pharm), Pharmaceutical Sciences, Life Sciences, or related discipline.

Experience

Pharmaceutical Manufacturing – Sterile Injectables / Parenterals / Biologics / Oncology Injectables.

jobs.title: Doctor
jobs.description:
Company Description Doctotalk is a real-time, pay-per-minute teleconsultation platform that connects users instantly with verified medical practitioners via chat or video, without scheduling or waiting. The platform is designed to help doctors monetize their expertise efficiently by setting their own per-minute consultation rates and working without clinic overhead. Doctotalk's availability-driven model enables high-frequency, short-duration consultations, improving utilization, earnings, and patient access across geographies. The platform features encrypted communication, transparent pricing, integrated wallets, and reliable session handling, with data managed in line with platform policies. Doctotalk is a technology layer that connects patients with independent practitioners and does not itself provide medical advice or emergency services.
Role Description This is a remote role for a Doctor on the Doctotalk platform. The Doctor will provide real-time teleconsultations to patients via chat and video, delivering safe, evidence-based, and empathetic medical advice within their licensed scope of practice. Responsibilities include taking detailed histories, reviewing symptoms and prior records where available, formulating differential diagnoses, recommending investigations as appropriate, and outlining clear management plans or referrals. The Doctor will document each encounter accurately in the platform, ensure adherence to medical, ethical, and data-privacy standards, and follow relevant telemedicine and jurisdictional regulations.
Qualifications
  • Current, unrestricted medical degree (MBBS, MD, BAMS, or equivalent) and valid license to practice medicine in at least one applicable jurisdiction.
  • Board certification or equivalent training in a primary care, internal medicine, family medicine, pediatrics, emergency medicine, or relevant specialty.
  • Demonstrated clinical competence in history-taking, virtual examination techniques, diagnosis, treatment planning, and follow-up decision-making.
  • Strong communication and counseling skills, with the ability to explain diagnoses, risks, and treatment options clearly and neutrally in a virtual setting.
  • Comfort with telemedicine tools, electronic documentation, and secure chat/video platforms; ability to troubleshoot basic technical issues.
  • Commitment to evidence-based practice, patient safety, data privacy, and adherence to local telehealth regulations and professional guidelines.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment, manage time and availability efficiently, and handle high-frequency, short consultations.
  • Willingness to serve diverse patient populations with cultural sensitivity and without discrimination based on background, identity, or beliefs.
  • Prior telehealth experience is preferred but not mandatory; openness to learning digital care best practices is essential.
  • Reliable high-speed internet connection

Role summary: Deliver accurate, compliant medical coding and support revenue cycle outcomes as a Medical Coding Analyst in Chennai, India (Hybrid). In this role, you will code and validate clinical documentation across E/M outpatient and inpatient, neuro coding, denial coding, and surgery coding, ensuring coding selections align to applicable guidelines and internal standards. You will report to the Medical Coding Manager.

Team Summary

Medical Coding teams in this area perform coding of clinical documentation to support correct capture of historical medical conditions, baseline signs and symptoms, adverse events, medications, and non-drug therapies. The work includes supporting the use and implementation of computer output where applicable, maintaining coding guideline accuracy, researching and resolving coding discrepancies, and running reports to ensure reporting correctness. The team also maintains knowledge of regulations and coding guidelines relevant to clinical studies and collaborates with cross-functional departments on study design, documentation, testing, and implementation. This role supports informed downstream operations by ensuring clinical research, clinical operations, and statistics are aware of coding implications and dictionary-rule needs for data collection and analysis.

Essential Job Responsibilities

  • Code medical documentation accurately using CPC/CCS (or equivalent) standards and applicable guideline references.
  • Apply multi-specialty coding across E/M outpatient, E/M inpatient, neuro coding, surgery coding, and denial coding as assigned.
  • Validate coded outputs by ensuring clinical documentation supports diagnosis/procedure selections and required coding rules are met.
  • Research coding discrepancies by reviewing documentation, guidelines, coding edits, and internal references.
  • Resolve denials related to coding by identifying coding-related causes and supporting appropriate correction pathways.
  • Document coding decisions and research outcomes in required systems for traceability and audit readiness.
  • Run and review coding-related reports as needed to ensure reporting accuracy and completeness.
  • Perform root cause analysis for recurring coding errors and support targeted corrective actions.
  • Use AI-enabled assistance to improve coding throughput and learning by applying AI-supported suggestions (when available) to summarize documentation or highlight potential guideline-relevant details, then confirming accuracy with your coding standards and the source record.

Additional Job Responsibilities

  • Assist with the implementation of computer output workflows by supporting validation and feedback loops.
  • Contribute to updating coding guidelines and internal references based on observed trends and discrepancy learnings.
  • Participate in quality calibration sessions to align on coding interpretations and scoring.
  • Support internal validation or cross-validation activities by preparing accurate coding outputs and notes.
  • Assist with training and knowledge sharing by explaining common discrepancy patterns and guideline interpretations.
  • Help monitor coding performance trends and provide suggestions to improve consistency and reduce rework.

Expected Education & Experience

  • 2–4 years of experience in medical coding or revenue cycle coding operations (as applicable to the role).
  • CPC or CCS (or equivalent) certification required.
  • Healthcare RCM knowledge preferred, especially how coding accuracy impacts claims and denials.
  • Hands-on experience with E/M outpatient (OP) and E/M inpatient (IP) coding.
  • Experience with neuro coding and surgery coding.
  • Experience with denial coding and/or denial-related coding rework workflows.
  • Ability to perform root cause analysis for coding discrepancies and recurring error patterns.
  • Strong knowledge of coding guidelines and documentation requirements.
  • Ability to work in a hybrid setting based in Chennai, India.

Travel: NA % travel annually.

If you're currently in a large organization where your impact feels diluted across layers of hierarchy, or in consulting where you deliver projects but rarely see the full journey from submission to commercial launch and real clinical impact — this role is your chance to move to the global stage with end-to-end accountability.

  • True Ownership & Global Impact: Move from supporting roles to owning regulatory pathways that directly enable first-of-its-kind products to reach patients worldwide.

You will work closely with Clinical Research Associates, Clinical Operations Leaders, and project teams in a highly collaborative and regulated environment. The role requires strong attention to detail and the ability to track and follow up on critical study issues such as protocol deviations and adverse events. jobs.title: MedDRA Coder
jobs.description:
ABOUT THIS ROLE

We are an AI company building tools for clinical trial data management in the pharmaceutical industry. Our AI processes electronic data capture (EDC) exports, codes adverse events to MedDRA, flags data discrepancies, and raises queries — the same work clinical data teams do across hundreds of trials. We need clinical data managers and coders who can review our outputs and tell us, from real trial experience, whether what the AI is doing is right.

WORKFLOWS COVERED

  • Clinical trial data review — edit checks, discrepancy management, and query resolution in EDC systems
  • Medical coding of adverse events and medical history using MedDRA and WHO Drug Dictionary
  • ALCOA-C data integrity checks across clinical datasets
  • Data cleaning, database lock preparation, and transfer to biostatistics

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Share how clinical data management and medical coding work in practice across the full trial lifecycle — from EDC setup and data review through to database lock
  • Review coding outputs, data review processes, or quality check designs and tell us where they would fail real clinical data standards
  • Help us understand the practical challenges of MedDRA and WHO Drug coding — the ambiguous cases, the version updates, the sponsor-specific conventions that vary across CROs
  • Advise on what good clinical data quality looks like and flag where process descriptions or outputs diverge from real trial operations

YOU ARE THE RIGHT FIT IF

  • Minimum 3 years in clinical data management or medical coding in the pharma or CRO industry — not hospital or insurance coding
  • Have personally reviewed clinical datasets, coded adverse events, or run edit checks in EDC — not just project management
  • Know the tools — Medidata Rave, Oracle Inform, Veeva Vault CDMS — from using them across actual trials (exposure to safety systems such as Argus Safety is a plus)
  • Worked at organisations such as IQVIA, Parexel, Syneos Health, Covance, Pfizer, Novartis, AstraZeneca, or a similar pharma company or CRO

NICE TO HAVE

  • CCDM certification (Society for Clinical Data Management)
  • CDISC CDASH or SDTM experience — building or reviewing datasets
  • Crossover into pharmacovigilance — experience with safety data and ICSR processing

jobs.description:
G&L have multiple positions available for Regulatory Affairs Manager. We are growing our teams on a global basis; there has never been a more exciting time to join us!

Please note that we have vacancies in Barcelona, Belfast London and Mumbai. If you have the experience we require and can work in one of our offices, we want to hear from you!

Do you want to help bring life-changing medicines to the world

Are you passionate about science, strategy, and regulatory excellence As a CMC Regulatory Manager, you'll play a key role in ensuring that high-quality medicines continue to reach patients safely and efficiently across global markets.

You'll sit at the intersection of science, manufacturing, and regulatory strategy, guiding post-approval activities and ensuring that every change to our products meets global regulatory standards.

If you enjoy solving complex problems, working across teams, and translating technical data into clear regulatory strategies, this role is for you.

What You'll Be Doing

Lead Post-Approval Regulatory Strategies

Develop and implement regulatory strategies for post-approval CMC activities, including:

  • Variations
  • Renewals
  • Market expansions
  • Annual reports

Your work ensures our products continue to meet global regulatory expectations throughout their lifecycle.

Evaluate Manufacturing and Quality Changes

Review change controls and assess how manufacturing or quality updates impact regulatory filings.

You'll determine:

  • Regulatory classification of changes
  • Submission requirements
  • Global regulatory impact

Review Critical Scientific Data

Collaborate with quality and manufacturing teams to review key reports such as:

  • Process validation studies
  • Stability studies
  • Analytical method validation

You'll ensure all data supports regulatory submissions and meets compliance standards.

Collaborate Across Teams

Work closely with colleagues across:

  • Manufacturing
  • Supply Chain
  • Quality Control
  • Quality Assurance
  • Global Regulatory teams

Your coordination keeps submissions accurate, complete, and on schedule.

Shape Regulatory Submissions

Draft and review CMC sections of regulatory documents, including:

  • Variation submissions
  • Responses to health authority questions
  • Technical regulatory documentation

Your expertise helps transform complex scientific information into clear regulatory narratives.

Manage Regulatory Systems

Oversee projects within Regulatory Information Management (RIM) systems, ensuring global submissions are tracked, maintained, and compliant.

Anticipate and Manage Risk

Identify potential regulatory challenges early and implement strategies to keep projects on track.

What You Bring

Experience

  • Experience in Regulatory Affairs within the pharmaceutical industry
  • Strong background in CMC or technical regulatory documentation
  • Experience preparing CMC sections of regulatory submissions or variations
  • Experience in validation, quality assurance, or pharmaceutical production is highly valued

Technical Knowledge

  • Strong understanding of CMC and post-approval regulatory requirements
  • Knowledge of:
  • Stability studies
  • Process validation
  • Analytical method validation
  • Comparability studies
  • Experience working with Biological products or vaccines is a mandatory requirement for this role.

Skills That Make You Shine

  • Exceptional attention to detail
  • Strong problem-solving ability
  • Excellent project management skills
  • Ability to collaborate with cross-functional global teams

Languages

  • Fluency in English (written and spoken)
  • Additional language (French, Italian, or German) is a plus.

Why This Role Matters

Your work ensures that safe, effective medicines continue to reach patients around the world — even as products evolve and improve.

In short: you help science move forward, compliantly.

We strive to make this vision a reality by pioneering innovative solutions that prioritize patient well-being and provider efficiency. With Sciometrix, the future of healthcare is not just about treating illnesses; it's about empowering patients to live their best lives.

We are seeking a Campaign Manager to drive pipeline growth through performance-driven digital marketing initiatives. This role will own end-to-end campaign strategy and execution across paid channels, with a strong focus on generating qualified leads, improving conversion rates, and contributing directly to revenue.The ideal candidate brings expertise in B2B healthcare marketing, paid media (LinkedIn, Google, Meta), and funnel optimization, with a data-driven mindset and a strong understanding of how to translate campaigns into measurable business outcomes.This role requires a balance of campaign strategy, performance marketing, and analytical rigor to scale demand generation in a fast-paced healthcare technology environment.

Collaborative, Cross-Functional Environment: Work closely with marketing, product, clinical, design, and sales teams to create impactful content that drives awareness, engagement, and lead generation. Your role will sit at the intersection of storytelling, strategy, and business growth.

jobs.title: Senior Executive, R&D- Formulation & Development
jobs.description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a highly competent and experienced Senior Formulation & Development (F&D) Chemist with extensive hands-on exposure in the development of solid oral dosage forms, specifically tablets and pellets. The candidate must possess in-depth knowledge of formulation strategies, process optimization, and regulatory documentation, with a strong command over the preparation of Product Development Reports (PDRs) in line with global regulatory expectations.

Key Responsibilities

PDR Preparation & Documentation:

  • Independently prepare comprehensive and compliant Product Development Reports (PDRs), including:
    • Justification for formulation approach and component selection
    • Process design, optimization, and scalability strategy
    • Risk assessment (FMEA) and control strategy
    • Compatibility, stability, and in-process data interpretation
    • Troubleshooting and change justifications (if applicable)
  • Prepare supporting documentation such as MFR, FPSs.
  • Ensure all documentation complies with ICH, USFDA, EU, and other applicable regulatory guidelines.
Formulation Development (Tablets & Pellets Focus)

  • Develop robust and scalable formulations for immediate-release (IR), modified-release (MR), and delayed-release (DR) tablets as well as multi-particulate pellet formulations (coated or uncoated).
  • Conduct pre-formulation studies, API characterization, excipient screening, and compatibility studies.
  • Design and execute lab-scale, exhibit, and validation batches of tablets and pellets using QbD principles.
  • Optimize critical formulation and process parameters for wet granulation, dry granulation, direct compression, extrusion–spheronization, layering, and pellet coating processes.
  • Conduct process optimization and scale-up in coordination with manufacturing or pilot plant teams.

Regulatory & Quality Compliance

  • Ensure all development and documentation activities are conducted in accordance with cGMP, GLP, and global regulatory expectations.
  • Collaborate with QA and Regulatory Affairs during internal and external audits, as well as during regulatory filings.
  • Contribute to dossier preparation by providing required CMC data and responding to technical queries.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Analytical R&D, Packaging, QA, Regulatory, and Manufacturing departments to ensure project alignment and successful execution.
  • Support technology transfer to commercial production teams with detailed technical input and documentation.

Team Leadership & Mentoring

  • Guide junior scientists and trainees in conducting formulation trials, data analysis, and documentation practices.
  • Train team members on best practices for tablets and pellets formulation and PDR preparation.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Education: M.Pharm (Pharmaceutics) or B.Pharm
  • Experience: 5–8 years in pharmaceutical F&D, with specific hands-on experience in tablets and pellets formulation
  • Must-Have Skills:
    • Deep understanding of PDR preparation, granulation techniques, compression, coating, and pelletization processes
    • Strong expertise in scientific writing and PDR preparation
    • Experience in formulation development for regulated markets (e.g. EU, ROW, Russia, Chille and other regulated Market)
  • Preferred: Exposure to QbD and regulatory filing

In this role, you will have the opportunity to boost your skills and become the heart of an innovative engine that is contributing to global impact and improvement.

At Takeda's ICC we Unite in Diversity:

Takeda is committed to creating an inclusive and collaborative workplace, where individuals are recognized for their backgrounds and abilities they bring to our company. We are continuously improving our collaborators journey in Takeda, and we welcome applications from all qualified candidates. Here, you will feel welcomed, respected, and valued as an important contributor to our diverse team

OBJECTIVES / PURPOSE:

We are seeking a forecaster to join Takeda's GCC Commercial Analytics & Insights (CA&I) organization in India as part of the Forecasting capability supporting International Business Units (IBU). This individual contributor role is responsible for building, maintaining, and evolving multiple forecast types across Ex-US markets - including short-term in-market demand forecasts, long-term strategic forecasts, patient-based epidemiology forecasts, and launch and event scenarios - in partnership with affiliate forecasting leads. The Senior Analyst is accountable for forecast model integrity, assumption discipline, and the business relevance of outputs delivered into brand planning, S&OP, and portfolio cycles.

ACCOUNTABILITIES:

Forecast Model Development and Delivery:

  • Build and maintain a portfolio of forecasts across multiple IBU markets and brands, spanning short-term tactical forecasts (24-36 months), long-term strategic forecasts (10+ years), in-line product forecasts, and pipeline and BD forecasts.
  • Apply the appropriate forecast methodology to each disease area, including patient-based approaches (prevalence, incidence, disease progression), demand-based approaches (trend, time-series, regression, exponential smoothing), and hybrid models that integrate both.
  • Conduct scenario and sensitivity analyses for market events, competitive entries, LOEs, pricing changes, indication expansions, and access scenarios across IBU geographies.
  • Maintain rigorous assumption documentation, version control, and audit trails for every forecast cycle, supporting reproducibility and review by affiliate and global stakeholders.
  • Track forecast accuracy across cycles, perform variance analyses against actuals, and translate learnings into improved drivers and assumptions for the next cycle.

Data, Methodology, and Tooling:

  • Work with IQVIA MIDAS, local audit data, syndicated subnational data, claims, prescription data, and epidemiology sources to build robust market and patient views across Ex-US geographies.
  • Apply statistical and machine learning techniques where appropriate - including ARIMA, exponential smoothing, regression (single and multivariate), Prophet, and other time-series methods - to enhance forecast accuracy for in-market brands.
  • Build forecast outputs and tracking dashboards in Tableau or Power BI; structure model files in Excel and, where applicable, in Python or R for automation and reproducibility.

Stakeholder Partnership and Communication:

  • Partner with affiliate forecasting leads, brand teams, finance, and global IBU stakeholders to clarify intake, align on methodology, and walk through outputs, assumptions, risks, and scenarios.
  • Translate model outputs into clear narratives, decision-grade slides, and assumption summaries tailored to commercial, finance, and senior leadership audiences.
  • Represent the GCC forecasting pod in cross-functional working sessions for brand planning, S&OP, LRP, and ad-hoc strategic questions.

Process Improvement and Operational Excellence:

  • Identify opportunities to automate recurring forecast updates, standardize templates across markets and brands, and build reusable assumption libraries that improve speed and consistency.
  • Contribute to building capability within the GCC pod, including knowledge sharing, documentation of best practices, and onboarding support for new analysts.
  • Leverage AI and GenAI tools to accelerate data preparation, assumption research, deviation reasoning, and narrative generation within forecasting workflows.

Knowledge, Skills & Experience:

Education:

  • Bachelor's Degree required in Statistics, Economics, Data Science, Life Sciences, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
  • Advanced degree (Master's or MBA) in Analytics, Economics, Data Science, Business, or a related quantitative field is strongly preferred.
  • Relevant certifications in forecasting, analytics, cloud platforms, or statistical methods are a plus.

Experience:

  • 3-5 years of progressive experience in pharmaceutical forecasting or related quantitative areas.
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining multiple forecast types - including prevalence and disease-progression (patient-based) models and demand-based models, across short-term and long-term, in-line and launch horizons - across more than one market.
  • Experience supporting Ex-US markets is required, particularly EU markets; exposure to Asian or Latin American markets is a strong plus.
  • Working knowledge of pharma data assets such as IQVIA MIDAS, local audit data, prescription and claims data, and epidemiology sources for Ex-US markets.
  • Advanced Excel skills for forecast model construction are required.
  • Strong experience with Tableau or Power BI for forecast tracking, scenario reporting, and commercial performance dashboard development.
  • Familiarity with cloud analytics environments (Databricks, AWS, Azure) and forecasting platforms (e.g., Anaplan, JDA/Blue Yonder, SAP IBP) is a plus.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple forecast cycles simultaneously in a fast-paced, cross-cultural, matrixed environment.
  • Working knowledge of coding techniques such as Python, R, or SAS for data preparation, time-series analysis, and automation is a nice to have, not a mandatory requirement.

Skills & Competencies:

  • Pharmaceutical Domain Knowledge –:Understands demand drivers, patient flow, market events, lifecycle stages, and competitive dynamics across therapy areas and Ex-US markets.
  • Analytical Rigor –:Applies disciplined assumption management, sensitivity analysis, and accuracy tracking to every forecast deliverable.
  • Stakeholder Partnership –:Builds trusted working relationships with affiliate forecasting leads, brand teams, finance, and global partners across multiple time zones.
  • Data Storytelling –:Distils forecast outputs, assumptions, risks, and scenarios into clear narratives with practical business implications and decision points.
  • Operational Excellence –:Identifies and implements opportunities to automate, standardize, and scale forecasting workflows using modern tools and practices.
  • Cross-Cultural Communication –:Fluent communicator across India-EU-Asia-LatAm time zones; adapts style effectively for technical and commercial audiences.
  • Operational Excellence — Identifies and implements opportunities to automate, standardize, and scale forecasting workflows using modern tools and engineering practices.
  • Cross-Cultural Communication — Fluent communicator across India-EU-Asia-LatAm time zones; adapts style effectively for technical and commercial audiences

TAKEDA LEADERSHIP BEHAVIORS:

In alignment with Takeda's Values-Based Culture, this role requires demonstration of the following leadership behaviors

  • Act with Integrity — Deliver accurate, transparent work and take full responsibility for quality.
  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally — Contribute positively to GCC-IBU team workflows and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Drive Accountability — Take ownership of all assigned tasks and deliver on commitments.
  • Embrace Learning — Continuously build analytical and domain capabilities through feedback and self-driven development.

BENEFITS:

It is our priority to provide competitive compensation and a benefit package that bridges your personal life with your professional career. Amongst our benefits are
