jobs.title: Regulatory Labeling Mgr
jobs.description:
Regulatory Labeling Manager will support the planning, coordination, and execution of EU and global labelling compliance activities within the Regulatory Affairs organisation. This role will support end-to-end labelling activities, including Product Information updates, linguistic review, mock-up coordination, artwork review, approval workflows, and implementation of approved labelling changes.

Working in a fast-paced, matrixed environment with no direct reports, the role will collaborate closely with global, regional, and local Regulatory Affairs teams, Quality, Operations, Supply Chain, affiliates, and external vendors. The position requires strong attention to detail, effective stakeholder management, and the ability to coordinate multiple labelling deliverables across markets, timelines, and functions.

This role provides an opportunity to contribute to EU labelling activities, support inspection readiness, strengthen labelling processes, and ensure that Product Information, packaging components, and artwork are maintained in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements, approved Marketing Authorizations, and internal quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Labelling Compliance and Change Management

Coordinate day-to-day labelling activities to support timely and compliant implementation of approved labelling changes across EU and global markets.

Manage labelling change requests, track deliverables, monitor timelines, and maintain accurate records in applicable labelling, artwork, or document management systems.

Serve as an operational point of contact for labelling activities, providing guidance to internal stakeholders on labelling processes, document requirements, formats, and timelines.

Ensure labelling updates are aligned with approved Product Information, internal procedures, quality standards, and market-specific implementation requirements.

Identify potential compliance risks, delays, inconsistencies, or documentation gaps and escalate issues to the appropriate stakeholders for timely resolution.

  • EU Labelling Process and Product Information Coordination

Support EU labelling activities across applicable procedures, including centralised, decentralised, mutual recognition, and national procedures, as relevant.

Coordinate updates to EU Product Information components, including the Summary of Product Characteristics, Package Leaflet, outer labelling, inner labelling, mock-ups, and related packaging text.

Support alignment of labelling content with approved Marketing Authorisations, regulatory commitments, internal procedures, and country-specific requirements.

Coordinate with regional and local Regulatory Affairs contacts to gather requirements, clarify expectations, resolve queries, and support implementation of approved labelling changes.

Track EU labelling milestones, review comments, approvals, and implementation status to ensure visibility across stakeholders and support delivery against agreed timelines.

  • Linguistic Review Coordination

Facilitate linguistic review activities for EU labelling updates, working with affiliates, local regulatory contacts, translation vendors, and internal reviewers.

Coordinate the review of country-specific translations to support consistency, accuracy, and alignment with approved source Product Information.

Track linguistic review comments, queries, responses, and approvals to ensure timely completion of country-specific labelling requirements.

Support resolution of translation queries, terminology discrepancies, formatting issues, and Member State or local affiliate comments in partnership with relevant stakeholders.

Maintain accurate documentation of linguistic review activities, decisions, approvals, and final approved local texts in applicable systems.

  • Artwork Review, Approval, and Implementation

Coordinate artwork review and approval workflows to ensure packaging components accurately reflect approved labelling text, technical requirements, and market-specific information.

Support review of artwork components, including cartons, labels, leaflets, blisters, foils, and other printed packaging materials, as applicable.

Collaborate with artwork vendors, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Supply Chain, Operations, and local affiliates to support timely artwork creation, review, approval, release, and implementation.

Review artwork-related documentation for completeness, consistency, version control, and alignment with approved Product Information and internal procedures.

Monitor artwork timelines and proactively follow up with stakeholders to address delays, open comments, approval bottlenecks, or implementation risks.

Maintain accurate records of artwork decisions, review comments, approvals, version history, and implementation evidence in relevant systems.

  • Cross-functional and Vendor Coordination

Partner with global, regional, and local stakeholders across Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Operations, Supply Chain, and affiliates to support compliant and timely labelling implementation.

Coordinate with external vendors, including translation providers and artwork vendors, to ensure deliverables meet agreed quality expectations, timelines, and service-level requirements.

Assist in monitoring vendor performance, identifying service gaps, and escalating issues that may impact labelling compliance, linguistic review, artwork approval, or implementation timelines.

Participate in project meetings with internal and external partners to align on priorities, clarify requirements, resolve operational challenges, and drive completion of milestones.

Support effective collaboration across time zones by maintaining clear communication, structured follow-up, and accurate tracking of open actions.

  • Process Improvement, Inspection Readiness, and Knowledge Sharing

Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives focused on labelling processes, EU labelling workflows, linguistic review coordination, artwork review, templates, trackers, and system usage.

Support inspection readiness by ensuring labelling documentation, approval records, SOP adherence, and implementation evidence are complete, accurate, and readily available.

Collect and analyse labelling operations data to identify trends, process gaps, cycle-time delays, and opportunities to improve efficiency, compliance, and transparency.

Assist in developing or refining training materials, job aids, process maps, and work instructions to promote consistent execution of labelling procedures.

Provide guidance and operational support to peers and junior team members on labelling compliance processes, EU labelling requirements, artwork review, linguistic review, and quality expectations.

Stay informed of emerging EU labelling expectations, regulatory requirements, and industry practices that may impact Product Information, artwork processes, or labelling implementation activities.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or Master's degree with 9 to 12 years of directly related experience in Regulatory Affairs, labelling compliance, artwork management, quality, or a related pharmaceutical or biotechnology function.

Equivalent combinations of education and relevant experience may also be considered.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting EU and/or global labelling processes, including Product Information updates, linguistic review, mock-up review, artwork review, approval workflows, and implementation activities.

Familiarity with EU labelling requirements, approved Product Information, country-specific implementation needs, and coordination with regional affiliates or local regulatory contacts.

Experience working with labelling management systems, artwork management systems, or document management platforms such as Veeva Vault or similar tools.

Understanding of end-to-end labelling implementation, from approved regulatory text through translation, linguistic review, artwork creation, review, approval, release, and market implementation.

Experience coordinating Summary of Product Characteristics, Package Leaflet, outer labelling, inner labelling, mock-ups, and printed packaging components.

Demonstrated ability to manage multiple labelling deliverables in a matrix organisation while meeting deadlines and maintaining compliance.

Strong collaboration and communication skills, with experience working across international teams, external vendors, and multiple time zones.

Experience coordinating with translation vendors, artwork vendors, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Operations, Supply Chain, and regional or local stakeholders.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with excellent attention to detail and the ability to identify risks, gaps, inconsistencies, or discrepancies in labelling documentation.

Ability to support process improvement initiatives and contribute to efficient, compliant, and scalable labelling workflows.

Familiarity with inspection readiness expectations, SOP compliance, documentation standards, quality-controlled processes, and audit-ready record maintenance.

- Coordinate conference, workshop and industry sponsorship activities.

7. Digital Marketing Coordination

The executive does not necessarily need to personally design or edit content but should coordinate with the digital marketing team.

Responsibilities include:

- Suggesting topics for reels, videos and advertisements.
- Coordinating doctors for video shoots.
- Collecting patient testimonials after appropriate consent.
- Coordinating Meta Ads, Google Ads and social-media campaigns with the marketing team/agency.
- Monitoring leads generated from digital campaigns.
- Ensuring leads receive timely calls and follow-up.
- Sharing field feedback with the content and advertising teams.

8. Lead Management & Conversion

- Maintain records of leads received from campaigns, camps and referrals.
- Coordinate with receptionist/counsellor for lead follow-up.
- Track enquiry → appointment → consultation → procedure conversion.
- Identify reasons for lost leads.
- Re-contact prospective patients where appropriate.
- Prepare weekly lead and conversion reports.

9. Field Marketing

The position requires regular fieldwork.

The candidate should be comfortable with:

- Doctor visits
- Hospital visits
- Corporate visits
- Society activities
- Camps
- Medical association meetings
- Industry meetings
- Travel within Surat and surrounding South Gujarat areas

Occasional outstation travel may be required.

Daily Work Expectations

A typical day may include:

Morning: Review leads and previous-day follow-ups
→ Doctor/Hospital/Corporate visits
→ Camp or event coordination
→ Referral-source follow-up
→ Marketing-team coordination
→ Lead and appointment tracking
→ Daily activity reporting

Candidate Profile

Qualification

Preferred:

- MBA / PGDM in Marketing
- BBA / B.Com / Graduate with healthcare marketing experience
- Hospital Administration / Healthcare Management qualification

Candidates with strong healthcare field-marketing experience may be considered irrespective of degree.

Experience

Preferred: 1–5 years

Experience in any of the following will be an advantage:

- Hospital marketing
- Healthcare marketing
- Pharmaceutical field sales
- Medical devices
- Diagnostic centres
- Cosmetic/aesthetic clinics
- Dental chains
- Doctor relationship management

Required Skills

- Excellent communication skills
- Gujarati and Hindi communication essential
- Working knowledge of English
- Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills
- Confident personality and professional presentation
- Good follow-up skills
- Basic knowledge of Excel/Google Sheets
- WhatsApp and social-media familiarity
- Ability to work independently in the field
- Target-oriented approach
- Basic understanding of healthcare ethics and patient confidentiality

Preferred Characteristics

We are looking for someone who is:

Energetic • Honest • Disciplined • Presentable • Relationship-Oriented • Target-Driven • Comfortable with Fieldwork • Good at Follow-up

Key Performance Indicators – KPI

Performance will be evaluated based on:

1. Number of productive doctor visits
2. New referring doctors developed
3. Active referring doctors maintained
4. Hospital and corporate tie-ups
5. Camps organized
6. Patient leads generated
7. Qualified appointments generated
8. Lead-to-consultation conversion
9. Referrals generated
10. Workshop/CME registrations
11. Follow-up completion rate
12. Marketing database growth
13. Monthly revenue contribution
14. Reporting discipline

Suggested Monthly Activity Targets

Indicative targets can include:

- 100–150 doctor/hospital visits
- 15–25 new meaningful doctor connections
- 5–10 institutional/corporate meetings
- 2–4 camps or awareness activities
- Regular follow-up with existing referral partners
- Weekly lead-conversion review
- Monthly marketing performance report

Final targets may vary according to assigned department and territory.

Reporting Structure

The Marketing Executive should maintain:

Daily:
Visits + leads + follow-ups + outcomes

Weekly:
Doctor referral report + lead conversion + upcoming activities

Monthly:
New referral sources + active referrals + camps + conversions + revenue contribution + next-month action plan

Growth Opportunity

A high-performing Marketing Executive may grow into:

Senior Marketing Executive → Business Development Manager → Marketing Manager → Regional Marketing/Franchise Development Manager

Elegance Healthcare offers an opportunity to develop multiple healthcare verticals rather than working with a single speciality.

Primary Goal of the Position

To build a strong and ethical referral, outreach and marketing network that increases patient awareness, qualified enquiries, doctor relationships and sustainable patient footfall across Elegance Healthcare.

Our Team

jobs.title: State Program Manager-Lead Poisoning Prevention Program-Rajasthan
jobs.description:
1. POSITION DESCRIPTION: State Program Manager, Vital Strategies India Services Private Limited (VSISPL), Rajasthan

2. ORGANISATIONAL AND PROJECT BACKGROUND:

Vital Strategies India Services Private Limited, with a registered office at New Delhi, is a social enterprise that provides technical and management consultancy services to address the leading causes of death, disease or injury and improve health outcomes. It seeks to provide innovative, cost-efficient solutions to global clients that are locally relevant, effective, and enduring by pursuing high-value partnerships and leveraging India's high-quality human capital and technology advantage.

About Lead Poisoning Prevention Program:

Lead poisoning is a widespread but preventable crisis that affects millions—particularly children—leading to severe cognitive, developmental, and lifelong health consequences. Vital Strategies is expanding its program that addresses the issue of lead poisoning in low- and middle-income countries. We plan to build upon existing efforts and interest by collaborating with governmental agencies in more Indian states to strengthen health systems and build local expertise in lead poisoning prevention to enact sound, cost-effective policies to address exposures.

3. JOB PURPOSE:

The State Program Manager will provide technical support in enhancing the state health systems capacity to reduce lead poisoning. The manager will offer epidemiological and programmatic support, including supporting the design, implementation, and monitoring of blood lead surveillance in the state. With support from the team, the State Program Manager will use data to help the government plan, formulate, and enact sound local public health policies. The role involves collaborating with a team of environmental health scientists, epidemiologists, clinicians, public health professionals, statisticians, and partnering with high-level government officials.

Duties and Responsibilities:

(A) Technical and Programmatic Support:

(1)Collaborate with a team to provide technical support in the design and implementation of the lead poisoning prevention program;

(2) Assist in guiding and building the capacity of government and non-government staff to implement the lead poisoning prevention program;

(3) Provide support in the development of a surveillance framework, standardizing surveillance procedures, and obtaining ethical approval;

(4) Train and monitor state, district, and field surveillance teams activities;

(5) Support organizing technical discussions and training for journalists;

(6) Provide support on policy analysis;

(7) Facilitate training sessions for health officials, frontline workers, journalists, and other stakeholders.

(B) Stakeholder Management:

(1)Assist in developing and maintaining partnerships with government and non-government stakeholders across various sectors, including health, environment (such as pollution control board), academic and research institutions, etc;

(2)In collaboration with the supervisor, serve as a Vital Strategies focal point and representative for key state-level stakeholders.

(C) Data Management:

(1)With designated personnel, monitor data collection, ensure data quality, and manage data sets;

(2)Provide on-ground monitoring through regular visits to selected districts;

(3)Work with senior epidemiologists to clean, analyze, and report surveillance data ensuring quality of surveillance data.

(D) Communication:

(1)Create presentations, technical reports, and non-technical summaries for varied audiences, including policy-makers and the general public;

(2) Disseminate and present report findings to stakeholders and promote data use for policy and planning.

(E) Operations and Administration:

(1)Supervise and support a small, dispersed team;

(2)Assist with program start-up, logistics, contracting, expense monitoring, activity reporting, and procurement;

(3)Oversee payment processing for state program team members and vendors, collaborating with the Finance and Operations teams of the Vital Strategies India office;

(4)Communicate regularly with staff assigned to support national heavy metal surveillance and source identification;

(5)Coordinate state activities with the initiative's partner organizations;

(6)Assist with other duties assigned by the supervisor.

4. QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE AND COMPETENCIES:

Qualifications:

Master's degree in public health, epidemiology, environmental science, or related public health field (e.g., biostatistics, demography) or public administration, or MBBS.

Experience:

Required

(1) Minimum six to seven years of relevant experience, of which at least 3 years should be at the state level;

(2) Experience in supporting the design and monitoring of health surveillance programs at the state level or previous experience managing large health-related surveys;

(3) Experience working with government health departments, regulatory bodies, and public health facilities;

(4) Experience supporting the implementation and monitoring of public health programs at the state level;

(5) Experience in designing, managing field data collection, analysis, and reporting;

(6) Experience in using data analytic software (e.g. R, Stata, SAS, Excel) and/or data visualization platforms (e.g., Shiny, Tableau);

(7) Experience in conducting training sessions;

(8) Experience in supervising a small team. Ability to manage a team of 2-3 staff and other program stakeholders at the state level.

Preferred

(9)Experience managing complex data flows;

(10) Experience in communicating scientific and health information to varied audiences;

(11) Experience in using project management platforms such as Monday or Airtable is a plus.

Skills and Abilities:

(1) Demonstrated familiarity with public health systems, health programs, disease surveillance programs, and health and environmental risk assessment;

(2) Understanding of advocacy for evidence-based interventions and how to navigate bureaucratic processes;

(3) Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines. Ability to work independently while coordinating with diverse teams and stakeholders;

(4) Excellent verbal and written communication skills to convey technical information to diverse audiences. Ability to prepare reports and presentations for decision-makers;

(5) Professional oral and written proficiency in English, Hindi, and the state's native language;

(6) Proven ability to interpret public health data, generate actionable insights, and support policy recommendations;

(7) Ability to anticipate challenges and identify obstacles, work with team to develop solutions, and remain flexible with shifting program needs;

(8) Passion for addressing environmental health challenges and improving community well-being;

(9) Solid knowledge of Microsoft Office suite;

(10) Ability to build strong, ongoing, impactful relationships at all organizational levels and across a diverse range of cultural, generational, ethnic, racial, educational, and social backgrounds;

(11) Demonstrated commitment to valuing diversity and contributing to an inclusive working and learning environment.

Working Conditions and Physical Requirements:

(1) This is a remote position; however, the selected candidate must reside in Jaipur, Rajasthan, the designated location of service to attend in-person meetings as required. Preference will be given to candidates who are based in Jaipur, Rajasthan.

(2) Relocation support is not offered for this position; candidates are expected to be based in or able to independently relocate to the role's location.

(3) This vacancy is open to Indian nationals and candidates holding a valid work or residence permit for India.

(4) Willing to travel for in person meetings with government counterparts, partners, and other relevant local stakeholders as required.

(5) State level experience is preferred, particularly in roles involving coordination with government or multi sector partners.

(6) Able to collaborate effectively across time zones, demonstrating flexibility in scheduling and communication.

5. ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

As a two-time Great Place to Work® certified organization, Vital Strategies India is proud to foster a culture rooted in respect, collaboration, integrity, and inclusion. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on any basis protected by country or local laws.

We are committed to maintaining a professional environment where everyone is treated with dignity and where safeguarding is paramount — we uphold zero tolerance for sexual harassment, exploitation, or abuse, and thoroughly vet all final candidates.

The salary range for this position is INR 19,77,500 to INR 24,90,000, complemented by a strong retirement plan, flexible basket reimbursement options, comprehensive healthcare coverage, and paid leave — ensuring our people feel supported, valued, and empowered to thrive both professionally and personally.

6. REFERENCE: SPM-VSISPL-RJ

1/1B, Choudhary Hetram House, Bharat Nagar

New Friends Colony, New Delhi 110 025

Phone Nos.: 011- 4081 9900; 4165 3612

Eligible candidates interested in the position are requested to submit their resumes along with a cover letter, by clicking on the link https://www.samsstc.com/Jobs/job-description/state-program-manager-vital-strategies-india-services-private-limited-rajasthan/725 by or before August 20, 2026.

jobs.title: Senior Medical Coding Analyst
jobs.description:
Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.

Role summary: Ensure accurate, compliant coding that supports revenue cycle performance by driving efficient medical coding operations as a Senior Medical Coding Analyst in Chennai, India (Hybrid). You will apply multi-specialty coding expertise across E/M (outpatient/inpatient), surgery, denial coding, and radiology to support claims accuracy, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement. You will report to the Medical Coding Manager.

Team summary: Job Description
The Senior Medical Coding Analyst is responsible for effective and efficient coding operations by strengthening information flow and workflow execution across medical coding processes. This role supports business operations through consistent coding quality, enhanced operational reporting, and identification of opportunities to improve outcomes within the revenue cycle. You will apply multi-specialty coding knowledge to ensure correct coding selections, support denial prevention and resolution efforts, perform root cause analysis for coding-related issues, and help drive continuous improvements that enhance accuracy, timeliness, and reporting integrity.

Essential Job Responsibilities

  • Apply CPC/CCS (or equivalent) coding standards to code assigned medical records with high accuracy.
  • Code across multi-specialty areas including E/M outpatient, E/M inpatient, surgery coding, and radiology as applicable.
  • Perform denial-focused coding activities by identifying coding drivers that contribute to claim denials and rework needs.
  • Validate documentation sufficiency by ensuring coder selections align to the medical record and coding guidelines.
  • Analyze coding errors and outcomes to conduct root cause analysis and identify recurring issue themes.
  • Coordinate with internal partners to resolve coding discrepancies and support claim correction workflows.
  • Document coding decisions, audit notes, and quality findings in required systems to maintain traceability.
  • Maintain compliance with quality standards, productivity expectations, and operational SOPs.
  • Use AI-enabled assistance to improve coding efficiency by leveraging AI-supported coding suggestions or documentation summaries (where available) and using your CPC/CCS judgment to confirm accuracy and compliance against guidelines and the medical record.

Additional Job Responsibilities

  • Support education and feedback loops by sharing coding learnings from audits and denial trends.
  • Assist with coding guideline clarifications by contributing examples and outcomes from real cases.
  • Participate in quality calibration sessions to align on interpretations and standards.
  • Contribute to operational reporting by supporting quality trend analyses and metric updates.
  • Support process improvement initiatives aimed at reducing denials and coding rework.
  • Review coding-related documentation completeness and propose guidance to reduce recurring gaps.
  • Assist with ad hoc coding/audit requests as assigned.

Expected Education & Experience

  • 3-6 years of experience in medical coding and revenue cycle-related coding workflows.
  • CPC or CCS certification (or equivalent).
  • Healthcare RCM knowledge preferred, including familiarity with how coding impacts claims and remittance outcomes.
  • Experience coding E/M (outpatient and inpatient), surgery, and radiology.
  • Experience with denial coding and/or denial-related coding rework workflows.
  • Ability to perform root cause analysis for coding quality issues.
  • Strong understanding of coding guidelines and compliance expectations.
  • Proficiency in following SOPs and maintaining accurate audit-ready documentation.
  • Ability to work effectively in a hybrid environment based in Chennai, India.

Travel: NA % travel annually.

-

jobs.title: Senior Director - Medical Affairs
jobs.description:
Job Description

Mandate

  • Design fidelity in the clinic
  • Own investigator training on the tissue-state eligibility framework, the structural grading scales, and patient-reported outcome administration, across all participating sites and indications.
  • Build and run the grading calibration and inter-rater reliability programme: reference materials, calibration rounds completed before first patient in, pre-specified reliability thresholds, periodic re-calibration, and ongoing drift monitoring.
  • Own the adjudication pathway for discordant and borderline gradings.
  • Maintain criteria-integrity surveillance: every eligibility decision documented against the framework, every borderline case and deviation escalated.
  • Investigator, expert and institutional engagement
  • Act as principal scientific relationship owner for UAE clinical partners and health-authority stakeholders.
  • Sustain and deepen the established investigator relationships in India and Japan.
  • Build the investigator network for the pre-planned second-stage indication.
  • Evidence and publication strategy
  • Own the publication plan for a study intended to be a landmark first-in-human result, and drive it to delivery.
  • Set congress and scientific-communication strategy.
  • Hold scientific-narrative consistency across every output — abstracts, posters, manuscripts, investigator materials, and health-authority correspondence.
  • Regional medical and access foundation
  • Support the epidemiology and market-access groundwork underway with regional partners.
  • Build the medical foundation for eventual payer and reimbursement engagement across MENA.

Scope boundaries

These are stated up front, deliberately. This role does not own:

  • Clinical operations — regulatory submissions, site contracting and initiation, monitoring, data management and vendor oversight sit with the CRO, under the CEO.
  • Study design — the protocol, endpoints, eligibility criteria and statistical architecture are set and, in material part, filed as intellectual property. This role executes fidelity to the design; it does not redesign it.
  • Intellectual property and regulatory strategy, which sit with the CEO and counsel.
  • Financing and investor engagement.

Requirements

  • Medical degree, with 10+ years in medical affairs and substantial depth in ophthalmology.
  • Demonstrated ownership of multi-site, multi-investigator scientific standardisation or diagnostic-competency programmes — at scale, and with measurable outcomes.
  • Regional medical strategy experience across emerging, Middle East or Asia-Pacific markets.
  • A track record of building durable scientific relationships with academic and government institutions.
  • Willingness to be present in the UAE as the programme requires — including sustained presence around site initiation, investigator calibration, and the first-patient-in period.

jobs.title: State Program Manager-Lead Poisoning Prevention Program-Assam
jobs.description:
1. POSITION DESCRIPTION: State Program Manager, Vital Strategies India Services Private Limited (VSISPL), Assam

2. ORGANISATIONAL AND PROJECT BACKGROUND:

Vital Strategies India Services Private Limited, with a registered office at New Delhi, is a social enterprise that provides technical and management consultancy services to address the leading causes of death, disease or injury and improve health outcomes. It seeks to provide innovative, cost-efficient solutions to global clients that are locally relevant, effective, and enduring by pursuing high-value partnerships and leveraging India's high-quality human capital and technology advantage.

About Lead Poisoning Prevention Program:

Lead poisoning is a widespread but preventable crisis that affects millions—particularly children—leading to severe cognitive, developmental, and lifelong health consequences. Vital Strategies is expanding its program that addresses the issue of lead poisoning in low- and middle-income countries. We plan to build upon existing efforts and interest by collaborating with governmental agencies in more Indian states to strengthen health systems and build local expertise in lead poisoning prevention to enact sound, cost-effective policies to address exposures.

3. JOB PURPOSE:

The State Program Manager will provide technical support in enhancing the state health systems capacity to reduce lead poisoning. The manager will offer epidemiological and programmatic support, including supporting the design, implementation, and monitoring of blood lead surveillance in the state. With support from the team, the State Program Manager will use data to help the government plan, formulate, and enact sound local public health policies. The role involves collaborating with a team of environmental health scientists, epidemiologists, clinicians, public health professionals, statisticians, and partnering with high-level government officials.

Duties and Responsibilities:

(A) Technical and Programmatic Support:

(1)Collaborate with a team to provide technical support in the design and implementation of the lead poisoning prevention program;

(2) Assist in guiding and building the capacity of government and non-government staff to implement the lead poisoning prevention program;

(3) Provide support in the development of a surveillance framework, standardizing surveillance procedures, and obtaining ethical approval;

(4) Train and monitor state, district, and field surveillance teams activities;

(5) Support organizing technical discussions and training for journalists;

(6) Provide support on policy analysis;

(7) Facilitate training sessions for health officials, frontline workers, journalists, and other stakeholders.

(B) Stakeholder Management:

(1)Assist in developing and maintaining partnerships with government and non-government stakeholders across various sectors, including health, environment (such as pollution control board), academic and research institutions, etc;

(2)In collaboration with the supervisor, serve as a Vital Strategies focal point and representative for key state-level stakeholders.

(C) Data Management:

(1)With designated personnel, monitor data collection, ensure data quality, and manage data sets;

(2)Provide on-ground monitoring through regular visits to selected districts;

(3)Work with senior epidemiologists to clean, analyze, and report surveillance data ensuring quality of surveillance data.

(D) Communication:

(1)Create presentations, technical reports, and non-technical summaries for varied audiences, including policy-makers and the general public;

(2) Disseminate and present report findings to stakeholders and promote data use for policy and planning.

(E) Operations and Administration:

(1)Supervise and support a small, dispersed team;

(2)Assist with program start-up, logistics, contracting, expense monitoring, activity reporting, and procurement;

(3)Oversee payment processing for state program team members and vendors, collaborating with the Finance and Operations teams of the Vital Strategies India office;

(4)Communicate regularly with staff assigned to support national heavy metal surveillance and source identification;

(5)Coordinate state activities with the initiative's partner organizations;

(6)Assist with other duties assigned by the supervisor.

4. QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE AND COMPETENCIES:

Qualifications:

Master's degree in public health, epidemiology, environmental science, or related public health field (e.g., biostatistics, demography) or public administration, or MBBS.

Experience:

Required

(1) Minimum six to seven years of relevant experience, of which at least 3 years should be at the state level;

(2) Experience in supporting the design and monitoring of health surveillance programs at the state level or previous experience managing large health-related surveys;

(3) Experience working with government health departments, regulatory bodies, and public health facilities;

(4) Experience supporting the implementation and monitoring of public health programs at the state level;

(5) Experience in designing, managing field data collection, analysis, and reporting;

(6) Experience in using data analytic software (e.g. R, Stata, SAS, Excel) and/or data visualization platforms (e.g., Shiny, Tableau);

(7) Experience in conducting training sessions;

(8) Experience in supervising a small team. Ability to manage a team of 2-3 staff and other program stakeholders at the state level.

Preferred

(9)Experience managing complex data flows;

(10) Experience in communicating scientific and health information to varied audiences;

(11) Experience in using project management platforms such as Monday or Airtable is a plus.

Skills and Abilities:

(1) Demonstrated familiarity with public health systems, health programs, disease surveillance programs, and health and environmental risk assessment;

(2) Understanding of advocacy for evidence-based interventions and how to navigate bureaucratic processes;

(3) Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines. Ability to work independently while coordinating with diverse teams and stakeholders;

(4) Excellent verbal and written communication skills to convey technical information to diverse audiences. Ability to prepare reports and presentations for decision-makers;

(5) Professional oral and written proficiency in English, Hindi, and the state's native language;

(6) Proven ability to interpret public health data, generate actionable insights, and support policy recommendations;

(7) Ability to anticipate challenges and identify obstacles, work with team to develop solutions, and remain flexible with shifting program needs;

(8) Passion for addressing environmental health challenges and improving community well-being;

(9) Solid knowledge of Microsoft Office suite;

(10) Ability to build strong, ongoing, impactful relationships at all organizational levels and across a diverse range of cultural, generational, ethnic, racial, educational, and social backgrounds;

(11) Demonstrated commitment to valuing diversity and contributing to an inclusive working and learning environment.

Working Conditions and Physical Requirements:

(1) This is a remote position; however, the selected candidate must reside in Guwahati, Assam, the designated location of service to attend in-person meetings as required. Preference will be given to candidates who are based in Guwahati, Assam.

(2) Relocation support is not offered for this position; candidates are expected to be based in or able to independently relocate to the role's location.

(3) This vacancy is open to Indian nationals and candidates holding a valid work or residence permit for India.

(4) Willing to travel for in person meetings with government counterparts, partners, and other relevant local stakeholders as required.

(5) State level experience is preferred, particularly in roles involving coordination with government or multi sector partners.

(6) Able to collaborate effectively across time zones, demonstrating flexibility in scheduling and communication.

5. ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

As a two-time Great Place to Work® certified organization, Vital Strategies India is proud to foster a culture rooted in respect, collaboration, integrity, and inclusion. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on any basis protected by country or local laws.

We are committed to maintaining a professional environment where everyone is treated with dignity and where safeguarding is paramount — we uphold zero tolerance for sexual harassment, exploitation, or abuse, and thoroughly vet all final candidates.

The salary range for this position is INR 19,77,500 to INR 24,90,000, complemented by a strong retirement plan, flexible basket reimbursement options, comprehensive healthcare coverage, and paid leave — ensuring our people feel supported, valued, and empowered to thrive both professionally and personally.

jobs.title: Senior Billing Manager
jobs.description:
Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Billing Manager to oversee and optimize our hospital's end-to-end patient billing, medical coding compliance, and insurance claims processing. This role leads the patient accounts team across Inpatient (IPD), Outpatient (OPD), and Emergency departments, ensuring seamless revenue flow, minimal claim denials, strict adherence to healthcare regulations, and a transparent, compassionate billing experience for patients.

Key Responsibilities

Revenue Cycle & Billing Operations

  • Oversee daily billing and collections operations across OPD, IPD, Day Care, and Emergency services.
  • Ensure accurate charge capture for doctor visits, surgical procedures, nursing care, ICU stays, pharmacy, and diagnostic tests.
  • Monitor Cashless/TPA (Third Party Administrator) and government scheme (e.g., Ayushman Bharat/State schemes) billing, approval, and settlement workflows.
  • Lead monthly revenue audit cycles to identify billing leakages, unbilled procedures, and charge code errors.

Insurance & Claims Management

  • Supervise claim preparation, submission, and re-adjudication with private insurance companies and TPAs.
  • Implement robust strategies to reduce claim rejection rates, track aging accounts receivable, and oversee denial management protocols.
  • Coordinate with medical superintendents and doctors to complete necessary clinical documentation for medical necessity approvals.

Patient Relations & Escalations

  • Ensure transparent financial counseling for patients at admission and transparent interim/final bill generation at discharge.
  • Directly handle complex billing disputes, disputed line items, or corporate account queries with sensitivity and speed.
  • Establish clear protocols for advance deposits, estimate generation, and charity/discount approval workflows.

Team Leadership & Regulatory Compliance

  • Mentor and manage a multi-shift team of billing executives, discharge coordinators, and insurance desk personnel.
  • Ensure strict compliance with medical tariff structures, government capping guidelines (e.g., implants, consumables), and hospital accreditation standards (NABH/JCI).
  • Evaluate and optimize Hospital Information System (HIS) software to streamline digital discharge and billing turn-around times (TAT).

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Management, Commerce, Business Administration, or related fields (Master's in Hospital Administration (MHA) / MBA preferred).
  • Experience: 7-12+ years of progressive experience in hospital billing and RCM operations, with at least 3+ years managing a mid-to-large-scale hospital billing team.
  • Technical Skills:
    • Hands-on proficiency in major Hospital Information Systems (HIS) and EMR platforms (e.g., Meditech, Cerner, Napier, Practo, or custom hospital ERPs).
    • Deep knowledge of medical coding standards (ICD-10, CPT) and TPA/Insurance portal operations.
    • Advanced MS Excel proficiency for revenue analytics and aging reports.
  • Key Competencies: High emotional intelligence for patient interactions, strong leadership, deep understanding of healthcare tariff structures, and analytical problem-solving.

jobs.title: Executive Vice President, Evidence
jobs.description:
About Evidence Action

At Evidence Action, we deliver data-driven interventions that transform lives at an unprecedented scale. We identify neglected global health issues and deploy proven solutions, forging healthier futures for generations.

Our model operationalizes leading academic research, including from Nobel-winning economists. We measure progress and outcomes at every stage to ensure we are making a real impact for people living in poverty and suffering from preventable or treatable health issues. Operating across 11 countries, our team of 900+ has reached over 500 million people, working closely with governments to scale these interventions.

  • Deworm the World has delivered over 2 billion treatments, significantly reducing worm prevalence and generating more than $23 billion in lifetime productivity gains
  • Safe Water Now has saved the lives of over 15,000 children
  • Our Accelerator explores untapped opportunities in global health, testing low-cost interventions with the greatest potential to save and improve lives

At Evidence Action, your colleagues are your greatest asset. You will partner with high-caliber colleagues in an environment blending innovation, autonomy, and teamwork. Our team excels in disruptive thinking and believes in rolling up our sleeves to get things done. If you are looking to work flexibly and with purpose, join a team that delivers measurable change for millions.

The Role

Evidence Action was built on the belief that data should drive every decision, from how programs are designed and delivered to how resources are allocated and scaled. Evidence and cost-effectiveness are central to Evidence Action's comparative advantage; they are what makes us credible and distinctive to government partners and donors alike, and this role will shape how that advantage evolves as we grow.

As the Executive Vice President (EVP), Evidence, you will own the strategic growth and transformation of our Monitoring, Learning, and Evaluation teams, our Cost-Effectiveness arm, and our epidemiology capability at a pivotal organizational moment. You will sit at the intersection of technical rigor, organizational leadership, and external credibility, holding overall accountability for the reliability of the evidence that guides how Evidence Action designs, delivers, and scales its programs. Our recent Dispensers for Safe Water update reflects the transparent, evidence-first culture this role will help lead.

This is a role with two connected mandates under one leader. You will lead the generation and use of evidence throughout the program lifecycle in close collaboration with programs, while maintaining an independence in your assessment of evidence, surfacing uncomfortable findings when necessary. Bringing these together in one senior role reporting directly to the CEO gives evidence a genuine, empowered voice in our decision-making.

In this role, you will sit on Evidence Action's Global Leadership Team (GLT), which sets organizational strategy and direction. This is a pivotal opportunity for an executive who can navigate complexity, inspire high-performing teams, and translate evidence into action, driving measurable improvements in millions of lives for years to come.

How You Will Make An Impact

Lead a holistic evidence function

  • Oversee the technical and strategic aspects of our evidence teams, ensuring MLE, cost-effectiveness modeling, and epidemiology connect into a single, coherent picture that informs day-to-day program improvement and major decisions, rather than separate streams of analysis
  • In collaboration with GLT and program leads, set a cross-program evidence strategy, defining the questions Evidence Action is answering across its portfolio, matching the right methodological approaches and connecting evidence to both delivery and organizational learning
  • Serve as a technical thought partner to teams across Evidence Action, making evidence more readily visible and actionable across the organization, evolving our cost-effectiveness tooling to enhance visibility into what drives cost-effectiveness and shortening the feedback loop between realized costs and impact and our projected impact.
  • Champion evidence across a program's lifecycle, ensuring we're designing the right evidence generation to feed lessons into scaling decisions and evolving our cost-effectiveness tools so organizational leaders understand what drives cost-effectiveness and we can actualize modeled impact
  • Institutionalize monitoring and learning (e.g. A/B testing) in programs so performance keeps improving well beyond launch
  • Sharpen where Evidence Action's own evidence generation is uniquely valuable versus where other partners are better placed

Own independent quality assurance

  • Understand how different evidence sources come together across programs to model our impact, and establish and enforce minimum standards for addressing weak evidence, uncertainty, and assumptions in that modeling
  • Design and implement the systems that let us review evidence consistently across our portfolio, including program stage gates and structured evidence and programmatic reviews at key decision points
  • Own data quality assurance so it is structurally independent from evidence generation, setting methodology standards, commissioning re-surveys and integrity checks, and surfacing issues early and transparently
  • Provide evidence-based recommendations that inform program scale-up, ongoing iteration, and wind-down decisions, holding a strong voice in those decisions while partnering with program and regional leaders who bring essential local context

Strengthen technical capability and relieve program teams

  • Build internal technical management capacity that benefit our programs
  • Lead a multi-disciplinary function through consolidation and change, building trust across MLE, cost-effectiveness, and epidemiology teams and bringing our people along through a significant transition
  • Identify where AI and modern data tools can strengthen evidence generation and decision-making at scale

Represent Evidence Action externally

  • Serve as a senior organizational voice on evidence, engaging donors, the board, and technical partners on our evidence philosophy, methodological choices, and standing evaluation arrangements
  • Champion a transparent culture that shares learning; including learning from what does not work, both inside the organization and with the relevant external stakeholders

Who You Are

We are looking for a leader with rigorous technical training who has spent much of their career as a user and steward of evidence in real implementation settings, not primarily as an academic researcher.

Essential

  • The courage to act on evidence. You are willing to surface uncomfortable findings to senior leadership and to recommend a change of course when the evidence calls for it
  • Technical leadership and management at scale. You have led similar technical teams, upholding quality assurance, in low- and middle-income country contexts with a grounding in operational rigor
  • Program-implementation grounding. You pair academic research expertise with genuine operational experience, so you lead as an insider rather than from a distance.
  • Technical credibility and range. A PhD or equivalent quantitative expertise that lets you judge the quality of evidence produced, hold teams to a high technical bar, draw on a range of analytical methods, and speak with authority alongside senior technical staff and external partners. Must have a background in cost-effectiveness or health economics, or the judgment to bring in the right experts
  • A strong leader of teams and change. You can conceptualize change management and bring people along, delegate across a large scope, and build trust across teams and cultures

What this role is not

  • This is not an audit or compliance role. This role is intended to build the systems and structures that reinforce the appropriate generation and application of evidence as programs evolve, so evidence becomes more than just a box we check
  • This is not a publication engine. External research is not the primary goal of this work
  • This is not a remote or distant role. Field presence and proximity to implementation are design requirements

Location

This role location is flexible, though we have a preference for a country where Evidence Action has an office, with India, Kenya, and Nigeria of particular interest.

This role will require approximately 20% travel nationally and internationally as needed.

Benefits

Evidence Action provides a comprehensive benefits package for employees worldwide.

  • Benefits may differ based on country-specific regulations

Benefits include:

Comprehensive health insurance

Pension/ Retirement savings options

Paid leave

Avenues for engagement and recognition.

Compensation is competitive and commensurate with the individual's credentials, experience, and internal pay scale.

Evidence Action is an Equal Opportunity Employer with a commitment to representation and inclusion. All individuals, regardless of personal characteristics, are encouraged to apply.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Product Management
jobs.description:
About Qinecsa Solutions

Qinecsa Solutions is a PE-backed pharmacovigilance SaaS company, purpose-built for the global drug safety market. Our product portfolio spans the full PV lifecycle: Reportum (case intake), HaloPV (end-to-end PV operations), QVW / Vigilance Workbench (signal detection and management — all underpinned by a Trust-Layered Architecture and PV AI Governance Framework that are provisionally filed as proprietary IP.

Our vision — Safety without seams. From molecule to patient, and back — reflects our belief that pharmacovigilance should be a strategic capability, not a compliance cost centre. We are building the platform that makes that vision real

About this Opportunity

Qinecsa Solutions is a purpose-built pharmacovigilance (PV) SaaS company, helping pharmaceutical and biotechnology organizations manage patient safety operations from case intake to signal detection. Our flagship product, Reportum, is the market-leading safety case intake platform — processing adverse event reports at scale, with an AI layer (Reportum AI) that is setting the standard for intelligent, governance-assured automation in pharmacovigilance.

We are looking for a Senior Director of Product Management to help shape the Reportum product strategy and roadmap, in close partnership with the VP of Product. This is a high-visibility role at the heart of Qinecsa's growth strategy — Reportum is one of the commercial anchors of our portfolio, the primary driver of new customer acquisition, and the product through which we are demonstrating what responsible AI in pharmacovigilance looks like in practice.

This is not a maintenance role. You will be joining a strong technical foundation, with a mandate to help take Reportum from a well-regarded intake platform to an indispensable part of the global PV operating model. You will help shape the vision and the roadmap, engage with senior internal and external stakeholders, and help shape

the commercial and strategic narrative along with the VP of Product that positions Reportum as the category leader.

About Reportum

Reportum is Qinecsa's safety case intake platform, used by pharmaceutical companies globally to receive, triage, and process adverse event reports in compliance with ICH E2B and regional regulatory requirements. It handles structured and unstructured data across multiple intake channels — E2B, web, mobile, fax — and routes cases to downstream safety systems including Oracle Argus, ArisGlobal, and Qinecsa's own HaloPV platform.

Reportum AI is the AI layer embedded within Reportum, designed to assist with case triage, narrative extraction, and seriousness assessment. Reportum AI is built on a Trust-Layered Architecture — a proprietary framework co-developed by Qinecsa's product and AI engineering teams that places deterministic safety controls, confidence

gates, and human oversight at the core of every AI-assisted decision. This is Qinecsa's primary AI differentiator in the market and a key area of your ownership.

What You Will Own

Product Strategy and Roadmap

  • Help shape the multi-year product strategy for Reportum and Reportum AI, in close partnership with the VP of Product, aligned to Qinecsa's broader Continuum portfolio vision
  • Help translate market intelligence, customer insight, and regulatory trends into a clear, prioritised roadmap that creates measurable commercial value
  • Help with roadmap governance through the Product Advisory Council (PAC) and Product Strategy Board (PSB), ensuring customer influence is structured and commitments are defensible
  • Position Reportum competitively against Oracle Argus, ArisGlobal (now Dassault), and emerging AI-native entrants

Delivery Execution

  • Own day-to-day backlog management and sprint delivery for Reportum, working directly with engineering and QA to keep releases on track
  • Act as the hands-on product owner for release cycles, including requirements detail, acceptance criteria, and day-to-day triage of delivery issues
  • Partner closely with the VP of Product on prioritization and sequencing, ensuring strategic roadmap decisions translate cleanly into executable sprint plans

AI Product Leadership

  • Own the product definition and governance framework for Reportum AI — Qinecsa's AI-assisted case processing capability
  • Ensure Reportum AI's Trust-Layered Architecture is maintained and evolved in line with emerging regulatory guidance (EU AI Act, FDA-EMA Joint Guiding Principles, CIOMS Working Group XIV)
  • Collaborate with the AI Engineering COE to translate AI capability into validated, commercially deployable product features
  • Support the VP of Product in representing Qinecsa's AI governance approach externally — at industry events, in customer conversations, and in regulatory engagements

Customer and Commercial Engagement

  • Engage directly with stakeholders at pharmaceutical customers and prospects — including design partner conversations, roadmap reviews, and procurement support
  • Work with the commercial team to help develop commercial narratives, RFP responses, and differentiation materials for Reportum
  • Build and maintain relationships with Qinecsa's Product Advisory Council members, running structured feedback cycles that inform roadmap decisions
  • Support customer health and retention by ensuring Reportum delivers measurable operational value and proactive product support

Cross-Functional Leadership and Influence

  • Operate as a senior product authority for Reportum, alongside the VP of Product — a go-to expert for engineering, UX, commercial, and executive stakeholders on matters of product strategy, architecture, and AI governance
  • Mentor and elevate the product thinking of Reportum Product team without formal management accountability — sharing expertise, reviewing roadmap decisions, and raising the bar on product craft across the team
  • Lead major cross-functional initiatives — from new capability launches to integration programs — bringing together engineering, QA, and delivery around the initiatives
  • Represent Reportum and Qinecsa externally at industry events, regulatory forums, and customer advisory sessions, in partnership with the VP of Product

What We Are Looking For

Experience

  • 12+ years of product management experience, with a track record of operating at Senior Director or Principal level as an individual contributor — influencing strategy and leading programs
  • Deep domain expertise in pharmacovigilance, drug safety, or regulatory affairs — you understand ICSR processing, E2B standards, aggregate reporting, and the operational realities of a PV department
  • Demonstrated track record of owning a complex, enterprise B2B SaaS product from strategy through delivery — including roadmap governance, customer engagement, and commercial outcomes
  • Experience leading AI or ML-enabled product development in a regulated environment — with genuine understanding of validation, auditability, and human-in-the-loop design principles
  • Comfortable operating with pharmaceutical VPs and C-suite stakeholders — you have run customer advisory sessions, supported major RFPs, and translated customer insight into product strategy
  • Comfortable operating inside an agile delivery model — running or working closely within sprint cycles, backlog grooming, and release planning, with the judgement to know when hands-on delivery work takes priority over strategic work

Competency Profile

This role maps to Qinecsa's Senior Director (M8/P8) level in our Product Competency Framework. We expect candidates to demonstrate:

  • Domain Expertise at industry-authority level — you are a recognized expert in pharmacovigilance product function and can represent Qinecsa at customer forums, industry events and regulatory forums
  • Product Strategy & Vision at portfolio level — you help the VP of Product set and execute direction across a multi-year roadmap, help weigh revenue implications of prioritization decisions, and define competitive positioning
  • Requirements & Design at architectural scale — you design end-to-end case processing workflows, make cross-system integration decisions, and set the standard for your team's requirements practice
  • Business Impact & Value — you have product P&L thinking, define ROI frameworks for new features, and connect roadmap decisions to ARR growth and customer retention
  • Influence without authority — you lead through expertise, shape product decisions across the organization, and bring engineering, UX, commercial, and leadership stakeholders into alignment without formal people management responsibility
  • Go-To-Market strategy — you help develop and own the GTM narrative for Reportum, in partnership with VP of product, Marketing and commercial team

What Will Set You Apart

  • Prior experience with Oracle Argus, ArisGlobal, or comparable enterprise PV platforms — either as a product leader at the vendor or as a senior operator at a pharma company
  • Understanding of AI governance frameworks in regulated industries and the ability to engage credibly with regulators and customers on responsible AI deployment
  • Experience in a PE-backed or growth-stage SaaS company — you know how to operate with urgency, manage competing priorities, and deliver in a fast-moving environment
  • Familiarity with the Pragmatic Institute product management framework or comparable structured PM methodology

What Qinecsa Offers

  • A high-impact role at the center of Qinecsa's growth strategy — Reportum is one of our commercial anchors, and Reportum AI is our AI flagship
  • The opportunity to help shape what responsible AI in pharmacovigilance looks like — working alongside a world-class AI Engineering team with a proprietary governance architecture
  • Close collaboration with product leadership, with direct exposure to senior leaders andkey customer conversations
  • A collaborative, mission-driven culture where patient safety is the north star
  • Competitive compensation and benefits, commensurate with a senior director role in a PE-backed technology company

Cohere Health's clinical intelligence platform and agentic AI-powered solutions connect health plans strategic goals and providers needs, optimizing the speed, cost, and quality of care. jobs.title: Collateral Management - Senior Associate
jobs.description:
Job Description

Who we are looking for:

We are looking for a candidates with experience in Collateral Management to reduce credit risk by exchanging cash/securities with counterparties. Should have knowledge in calculations based on MTM and results in sending Margin calls. The position will contain a basic training to carry out activities by working both remotely from home and from office.

Why this role is important to us:

Collateral management main focus is to reduce credit risk by exchanging eligible cash or securities between counterparties. The daily calculations are based on MTM of the underlying trades and results in sending Margin Calls, which in turn lead to agreeing transfers. Based on the agreements between our clients and the counterparties the Collateral team in India ensures that all the exposures are fully collateralized and the agreed collateral transactions settle as agreed..

What you will be responsible for: As Senior Associate you will:

  • Margin call processing - Process daily margin calls daily for all agreed clients, who will include banks and fund clients and both cash and security margin calls.

  • Reconcile collateral balances, investigate and solve discrepancies be the main point of contact/ escalations

  • Fails investigation - Checking the cash non-receipt reports and the custody settlement system and initiating correspondence with the client and counterparties

  • Reporting - Generate a variety of reports, which includes client and internal

  • Portfolio reconciliations - Completing any daily or ad hoc manual portfolio reconciliations.

  • Interest Processing - Month end interest statement generation, settling interest, updating interest agreements, and updating and validating interest rates.

Substitutions

Coupon / Maturities

Transformation initiatives

What we value:

  • These skills will help you succeed in this role:

  • Proficient knowledge of MS Excel and Outlook Power Point and Word will be an advantage

  • Proficient knowledge of MS Access and VBA

  • Very good command of English effective communication, ability to write and sing off official documents

  • Experience in finance and custody

  • Knowledge of OTC markets/ derivatives instruments, Collateral Onboarding

  • Numeracy skills attention to details

  • Accuracy and ability to work with tight deadlines

  • Ability to collaborate and teamwork organizational skills supervising group of specialist if need be

  • Self-motivated and reliant, flexible

  • Project Management methodologies would be an advantage

Education & Preferred Qualifications:

  • Graduate and above preferably in Finance

  • B.COM, BBM/BBA. MBA (Finance), M.COM or any degree related to Finance or Commerce

Additional requirements:

  • Certification on NCFM / CISI (Chartered Institute for Securities & Investment)

  • Knowledge on Macros, SQL & MS Access Database queries

Position Summary

The role would be to support Abbott Speciality Care (ASC), plan and execute the strategic initiatives across all affiliates of Abbott in India.

For ASC, the Head GA&SI would proactively assess trends, policies and emerging issues related to price controls, NLEM, localization, taxation etc. Will work with National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority (NPPA), Department pf Pharmaceuticals (DoP), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare etc to develop and implement strategies, policies and actions to effectively address issues that impact all Abbott businesses in India.

The person will be responsible for identifying, developing and executing strategic initiatives across Abbott affiliates to improve market access, engagement with important stakeholders etc.

Key Interfaces

The role will require close engagement across a wide range of internal and external stakeholders ecosystem in order to shape policy, develop strategy, support business priorities and strengthen Abbott standing with regulators, government and state government departments, government procurement agencies (AIIMS, DGAFMS, Railways, CGHS etc), trade associations, foreign missions, think tanks, patient advocacy groups etc in India.

The role will require close engagement across a wide range of internal and external stakeholders ecosystem in order to shape policy, develop strategy, support business priorities and strengthen Abbott standing with regulators, government and state government departments, government procurement agencies (AIIMS, DGAFMS, Railways, CGHS etc), trade associations, foreign missions, think tanks, patient advocacy groups etc in India.

  • Pricing & Finance
  • Regulatory Affairs
  • Commercial leaders
  • Medical Affairs
  • Institution Business
  • Indian Legal Office (ILO)

External Network : Government stakeholders, industry bodies and policy influencers relevant to pharmaceuticals and life Sciences.

Government Stakeholders (not limited to) : National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority (NPPA), Department of Pharmaceuticals, Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, NITI Aayog, Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR), Department of Expenditure, Ministry of Labour & Employment, Ministry of Commerce & Industry, Director General Of Health Services (DGHS), Council of Scientific & Industrial Research (CSIR), Dept. of Biotechnology, DGAFMS, Railways etc

Trade Associations : Confederation of Indian Industries (CII), Federation of Indian Chamber of Commerce & Industry (FICCI), Associated Chamber of Commerce (ASSOCHAM) and bi lateral bodies

Various other Government departments and associations working in the healthcare sector in India.

Core Responsibilities

  • Monitor, assess and communicate legislative, regulatory and policy developments affecting operations, business continuity, supply chain and growth opportunities, translating external developments into clear business implications, risks and actions.
  • Proactively develop and execute an integrated government affairs strategy to shape the expected policy and regulatory changes
  • Represents Abbott's business for, and works extensively with assigned industry groups and associations, including providing input and direction to proactive/reactive responses by associations to industry issues, policy development, etc.
  • Build policy positions, advocacy plans, briefing materials and executive recommendations for senior internal stakeholders and external engagement. Collaborating with other internal colleagues, and industry experts, write policy papers to strategically and positively influence the Abbott operations
  • Develop and manage senior relationships with priority government authorities, regulators, policy influencers and public-sector institutions relevant to Abbott businesses in India, and represent Abbott in the identified policy dialogues, association working groups and external forums.
  • Maintain an effective stakeholder map across central ministries, state governments, pollution control boards, investment-promotion authorities, industry associations, chambers, think tanks and academic institutions relevant to healthcare sector in India
  • Partner closely with business and functional leaders to unlock opportunities that support commercial growth through strategic initiatives, operational continuity, market access, incentives, investment projects and expansion plans, while strengthening relationships with various stakeholders.
  • Support risk prevention, issue management and crisis response planning when policy, regulatory or public-affairs developments may affect business operations, manufacturing continuity and brand equity.

Qualifications

A bachelor's degree in humanities, public policy, international relations, law, business, communications or a related field

Pivotal Experience & Expertise

  • 7-8 years of total experience including experience in government affairs, public policy, corporate external affairs within India, with a demonstrated ability to operate effectively in complex regulatory environments
  • Proven ability to build and execute government affairs and public policy programs that support business operations and growth
  • Demonstrated strength in engaging government agencies, state-level authorities, industry associations and cross-functional internal stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical, writing and executive communication skills, with the ability to produce clear, high value briefings and recommendations for senior leaders.
  • Experience in a multinational corporation operating in India and navigating both local and global stakeholder expectations.
  • Team player who seeks to become an integral part of an industry-leading government affairs group.
  • Strong organizational skills, adept at managing complex array of projects/issues

Premier Research is looking for a Sr. Data Scientist to join our Clinical Data Sciences team.

You will help biotech, medtech, and specialty pharma companies transform life-changing ideas and breakthrough science into new medicines, devices, and diagnostics. What we do is profoundly connected to saving and improving lives, and we recognize our team members are the most valuable asset in delivering success.

  • We are here to help you grow, to give you the skills and opportunities to excel at work with the flexibility and balance your life requires.

Join us and build your future here.

  • Interacts with internal and external project team members, including external data source vendors, across multiple projects.
