jobs.title: Lead Poisoning Surveillance Coordinator
jobs.description:
1. POSITION DESCRIPTION: Lead Poisoning Surveillance Coordinator, Vital Strategies India Services Private Limited (VSISPL), Gujarat

2. ORGANISATIONAL AND PROJECT BACKGROUND:

Vital Strategies India Services Private Limited, is a social enterprise focused on strengthening and revitalizing public health systems to address the leading causes of death, disease, and injury. We deploy our unique world-class technical expertise and global experience to design and support scalable solutions that can bridge the gap between public health needs and their solutions, focusing on rapid, large-scale impact. We leverage our core strengths in the areas of public health intelligence to strengthen the collection and use of data for informed government action, strategic communication to build awareness and behaviour change, institutional strengthening, and innovative financing. In addition to our topical areas of focus – noncommunicable diseases, environmental health and climate change, injury prevention, and social determinants of health we also prioritize work that aims to strengthen the fundamental, foundational dimensions of public health practice that enable governments to tackle and respond to any public health challenge.

About Lead Poisoning Prevention Program:

Lead poisoning is a widespread but preventable crisis that affects millions—particularly children—leading to severe cognitive, developmental, and lifelong health consequences. Vital Strategies is expanding its program that addresses the issue of lead poisoning in low- and middle-income countries. We plan to build upon existing efforts and interest by collaborating with governmental agencies in more Indian states to strengthen health systems and build local expertise in lead poisoning prevention to enact sound, cost-effective policies to address exposures.

3. JOB PURPOSE:

The Lead Poisoning Surveillance Coordinator, seconded into the local state health departments or related health agency located in Gandhinagar, Gujarat, will closely work with the state health department to design, support, and monitor state-wide blood lead surveillance and related activities. This position will provide programmatic and operational support, maintain partnerships with key stakeholders, and plan and organize state workshops.

Duties and Responsibilities:

(A) Stakeholder Engagement:

(1) Serve as a liaison between the government/state health department and Vital Strategies, facilitating communication and collaboration;

(2) Work with appropriate authorities to support the formation of a state technical working group;

(3) Coordinate with all key stakeholders to ensure regular and timely communication and progress of the project.

(B) Technical Support:

(1)Provide technical support for the state technical working group and other key stakeholders to develop a statewide blood lead surveillance framework;

(2)Seek and incorporate technical input from key stakeholders on the surveillance framework and support the standardization of surveillance procedures;

(3) Provide technical assistance to district-level health officials and frontline workers;

(4) Assist in developing state-level strategies and action plans for reducing lead poisoning;

(5) Coordinate and conduct training sessions for health staff, laboratory staff, and field teams on blood lead surveillance procedures.

(C) Program Management and Implementation:

(1) Monitor and oversee district and field surveillance teams, track data collection progress, and identify challenges for efficient implementation;

(2) Conduct field visits for on-ground supervision and to ensure data quality;

(3) Conduct data analysis and prepare presentations, technical and non-technical reports for routine review and decision-making;

(4) Coordinate state and district-level meetings and events (e.g., workshops, webinars);

(5) Support dissemination of surveillance findings to key stakeholders.

(D) Administrative and Operational:

(1) Manage program-related operations by assisting with project start-up, logistics, contracting, expense and activity monitoring and reporting, and procurement activities with support from the associate;

(2) Line reporting through the State Program Manager with technical guidance and direction from Vital Strategies;

(3) Assist with other duties assigned by the supervisor.

4. QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE AND COMPETENCIES:

Qualifications:

Master's degree in public health, Environmental Health Science, Epidemiology, and Health policy, or a related field, or MBBS will be preferred. Candidates with a Bachelor's degree in dental science, Life sciences, or Environmental science with prior experience working in public health programs, government health systems, or environmental health projects, may also be considered.

Experience:

Required

(1) Six to seven years of relevant experience required, with at least 2 years at the state level;

(2) Two or more years of experience in data management and analysis related to public health or environmental health;

(3) Experience working with government health departments, health facilities and ability to navigate government systems;

(4) Experience working with statistical software such as R, SAS, SPSS, Stata;

(5) Experience in conducting training sessions for health officials, laboratory staff, and frontline workers;

(6) Experience in organizing meetings, workshops, and discussions.

Preferred

(7)Proven capacity to work within the state health department and to interact with public servants and heads of department;

(8)Experience in designing or implementing surveillance or statewide health surveys;

(9) Experience in conducting and managing surveillance programs at the state level or experience in managing health-related surveys;

(10) Experience in large health data or data visualization tools;

(11) Experience in using project management platforms such as Monday or Airtable.

Skills and Abilities:

(1) Demonstrated familiarity with public health systems, health programs, and disease surveillance programs;

(2) Strong interpersonal and team-building skills to foster trust, facilitate collaboration among stakeholders, and communicate effectively with interdisciplinary teams;

(3) Proven ability to plan, execute, and monitor public health programs at the state level;

(4) Excellent verbal and written communication skills to engage diverse audiences. Professional oral and written proficiency in English, Hindi, and the state native language.

(5) Ability to interpret public health data, generate insights, and effectively communicate findings with stakeholders;

(6) Strong skills in managing multiple tasks and program logistics. Ability to anticipate challenges and develop solutions. Self-motivated, proactive, and able to work independently while coordinating with multiple teams;

(7) Passion for addressing environmental health challenges and improving community well-being;

(8) Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook).

Working Conditions and Physical Requirements:

(1) This is a full-time position that is expected to eventually be seconded (embedded) within the State Health Department or a relevant health agency in Ahmedabad/Gandhinagar, Gujarat; the timing of this embedding is currently to be determined.

(2) The selected candidate must be based in Ahmedabad/Gandhinagar, Gujarat, to attend in-person meetings as required.

(3) Relocation support is not offered for this position; candidates are expected to be based in or able to independently relocate to the role's location.

(4) This vacancy is open to Indian nationals and candidates holding a valid work or residence permit for India.

(5) The role will involve close, on-site collaboration with the State Health Department and government stakeholders, with some flexibility for remote work as appropriate.

(6) The role requires a willingness to travel within India for in-person meetings and field visits, as well as occasional international travel.

5. ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on characteristics such as race, color, age, religion or creed, gender, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran or military status, marital status, or any other basis protected by country and local laws.

We are proud of our commitment to a professional work environment where everyone is treated with respect and dignity. Vital Strategies India will not tolerate its employees, volunteers, consultants, partners, or any other representative associated with the delivery of its work carrying out any form of sexual harassment, sexual exploitation, or sexual abuse, and thoroughly vets all final candidates.

The salary for this position is in the range of INR 19,77,500 to 24,90,000. To help you stay energized, engaged, and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits, including a strong retirement plan, flexible basket reimbursement option, comprehensive healthcare, and Paid Leaves so you can relax, recharge, and be there for the people you care about.

Takeda is a global, values-based, R&D-driven, top 10 biopharmaceutical leader committed to discover and deliver life-transforming treatments, guided by our commitment to patients, our people, and the planet.

Our Data and Quantitative Sciences group (DQS) is made up of more than 500 quantitative scientists who harness the insight of data and digital to speed the development of highly innovative treatments to patients. These scientists (from quantitative clinical pharmacology, statistics, programming, outcomes research and epidemiology, patient safety & pharmacovigilance, digital strategy, library sciences, and data architecture/governance) bring their expertise to our global program teams and reimagine our disciplines. They work with novel data streams, including real-world data and digital tools, and apply advanced analytics including artificial intelligence and automation.

As part of DQS, the Quantitative Clinical Pharmacology (QCP) Team at Takeda consists of therapeutically aligned teams who drive the clinical pharmacology strategy from pre-FIH through life-cycle management within the global project team. The QCP role works in partnership with the pharmacometrics lead to drive a MIDD path within each project.

jobs.title: Senior Medical Coding Analyst

Role summary: Ensure accurate, compliant coding that supports revenue cycle performance by driving efficient medical coding operations as a Senior Medical Coding Analyst in Chennai, India (Hybrid). You will apply multi-specialty coding expertise across E/M (outpatient/inpatient), surgery, denial coding, and radiology to support claims accuracy, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement. You will report to the Medical Coding Manager.

Team summary: Job Description

The Senior Medical Coding Analyst is responsible for effective and efficient coding operations by strengthening information flow and workflow execution across medical coding processes. This role supports business operations through consistent coding quality, enhanced operational reporting, and identification of opportunities to improve outcomes within the revenue cycle. You will apply multi-specialty coding knowledge to ensure correct coding selections, support denial prevention and resolution efforts, perform root cause analysis for coding-related issues, and help drive continuous improvements that enhance accuracy, timeliness, and reporting integrity.

Essential Job Responsibilities

  • Apply CPC/CCS (or equivalent) coding standards to code assigned medical records with high accuracy.
  • Code across multi-specialty areas including E/M outpatient, E/M inpatient, surgery coding, and radiology as applicable.
  • Perform denial-focused coding activities by identifying coding drivers that contribute to claim denials and rework needs.
  • Validate documentation sufficiency by ensuring coder selections align to the medical record and coding guidelines.
  • Analyze coding errors and outcomes to conduct root cause analysis and identify recurring issue themes.
  • Coordinate with internal partners to resolve coding discrepancies and support claim correction workflows.
  • Document coding decisions, audit notes, and quality findings in required systems to maintain traceability.
  • Maintain compliance with quality standards, productivity expectations, and operational SOPs.
  • Use AI-enabled assistance to improve coding efficiency by leveraging AI-supported coding suggestions or documentation summaries (where available) and using your CPC/CCS judgment to confirm accuracy and compliance against guidelines and the medical record.

Additional Job Responsibilities

  • Support education and feedback loops by sharing coding learnings from audits and denial trends.
  • Assist with coding guideline clarifications by contributing examples and outcomes from real cases.
  • Participate in quality calibration sessions to align on interpretations and standards.
  • Contribute to operational reporting by supporting quality trend analyses and metric updates.
  • Support process improvement initiatives aimed at reducing denials and coding rework.
  • Review coding-related documentation completeness and propose guidance to reduce recurring gaps.
  • Assist with ad hoc coding/audit requests as assigned.

Expected Education & Experience

  • 3–6 years of experience in medical coding and revenue cycle-related coding workflows.
  • CPC or CCS certification (or equivalent).
  • Healthcare RCM knowledge preferred, including familiarity with how coding impacts claims and remittance outcomes.
  • Experience coding E/M (outpatient and inpatient), surgery, and radiology.
  • Experience with denial coding and/or denial-related coding rework workflows.
  • Ability to perform root cause analysis for coding quality issues.
  • Strong understanding of coding guidelines and compliance expectations.
  • Proficiency in following SOPs and maintaining accurate audit-ready documentation.
  • Ability to work effectively in a hybrid environment based in Chennai, India.

Travel: NA % travel annually.

About Athenahealth

We offer IT solutions and expert services that eliminate the daily hurdles preventing healthcare providers from focusing entirely on their patients — powered by our vision to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.

Our company culture:Our talented  employees — or athenistas, as we call ourselves — spark the innovation and passion needed to accomplish our vision. jobs.title: Regulatory Affairs Manager
jobs.description:

Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. A Day in the Life

The Regulatory Affairs function at Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC) supports global regulatory activities that enable the development, registration, and lifecycle management of medical technologies. This team partners with cross-functional stakeholders to develop regulatory strategies, support product submissions, maintain regulatory compliance, and ensure alignment with evolving global regulatory requirements across the medical device portfolio.

This position is based in Nanakramguda, Hyderabad, India and follows a Flexible Work Arrangement model. Limited domestic and international travel may be required to support business objectives, regulatory activities, and stakeholder collaboration.

This people leadership role is responsible for leading a Regulatory Affairs team supporting global medical device regulatory activities. The position oversees regulatory submission planning and execution, drives operational excellence, develops regulatory talent, and partners with cross-functional teams to ensure compliance and successful product lifecycle management. The role combines operational leadership, strategic regulatory guidance, and team development responsibilities within a global environment.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop a Regulatory Affairs team responsible for supporting global regulatory submissions, registrations, renewals, and compliance activities.
  • Oversee the preparation, review, and coordination of regulatory documentation packages to support product approvals and lifecycle management activities.
  • Develop and execute regulatory strategies that align with business objectives and applicable global regulatory requirements.
  • Partner with quality, engineering, clinical, manufacturing, and commercial teams to ensure regulatory compliance throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Monitor changes in global regulatory regulations, standards, and guidance documents and assess business impact.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance regulatory processes, documentation quality, operational efficiency, and compliance tracking systems.
  • Provide leadership during regulatory inspections, audits, agency interactions, and compliance-related activities.
  • Manage team performance, resource planning, talent development, succession planning, and employee engagement initiatives.

Required Qualifications


  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related scientific discipline and 15+ years of regulatory affairs experience within the medical device or pharmaceutical industry.
  • Minimum 5 years of people leadership experience managing medium to large regulatory, quality, or compliance-focused teams.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting regulatory submissions, registrations, compliance activities, and regulatory lifecycle management.
  • Working knowledge of global medical device regulatory requirements and regulatory agency interactions.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills with the ability to collaborate across global cross-functional teams.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Advanced degree in Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Life Sciences, Regulatory Affairs, or a related field.
  • Experience leading global Regulatory Affairs teams within a multinational medical device organization.
  • Demonstrated success driving process improvements, operational excellence programs, and regulatory compliance initiatives.
  • Experience supporting regulatory inspections, audits, and interactions with international regulatory authorities.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience using technology and reporting tools to support regulatory metrics, tracking, and decision-making.

jobs.title: Finance Operations & Automation Manager
jobs.description:
US night shifts 7pm - 4am

Weekends off

Location: Remote (India Based)

Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role

Bikham Healthcare is looking for a highly capable Finance leader who can build and run the financial backbone of a fast-growing global healthcare technology company — from the ground up. This role owns both the operational engine (Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, SaaS vendor payments, collections) and the financial management engine (FP&A, budgeting, forecasting, monthly/quarterly/annual close, internal controls, and reporting) for the organization, while building and leading the team that supports it.

The ideal candidate combines deep finance fundamentals — including SaaS revenue mechanics, forecasting, budgeting, and close discipline — with operational rigor and a builder's mindset toward automation and AI. This is not just a run the numbers role; it's a build the finance function role. This person will establish the checks and balances, systems, and cadence that let Bikham scale with confidence, working closely with the founders, COO, and department leaders across the business.

Required Qualifications
Education

●       Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.

●       MBA (Finance), CA, CFA, CPA, or equivalent qualification preferred.

Experience

●       8–12 years of experience in finance, spanning both finance operations and FP&A/financial management.

●       Experience managing or building a finance team, including hiring and developing team members.

●       Experience owning a monthly/quarterly/annual close process, including reconciliations and reporting.

●       Experience with budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis, ideally including ownership of an annual budget cycle.

●       Experience in a SaaS or subscription-revenue business, with a solid understanding of revenue recognition, deferred revenue, and SaaS metrics.

●       Experience managing Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and vendor payment systems.

●       Experience implementing financial automation tools and internal controls.

●       Experience negotiating vendor contracts and commercial agreements.

Skills & Competencies

●       Strong understanding of financial operations, FP&A, and cash flow management end-to-end.

●       Working knowledge of SaaS finance mechanics: bookings vs. billings vs. revenue, ARR/MRR, renewals, churn, and unit economics.

●       Experience with financial systems, FP&A/reporting tools, and financial automation and AI-enabled tools.

●       Ability to design efficient, well-controlled financial workflows and processes.

●       Strong people-leadership skills, with the ability to build and manage a high-performing team.

●       Strong analytical, negotiation, and organizational skills.

●       Comfortable working in a fast-paced entrepreneurial environment, and equally comfortable bringing structure and discipline to it.

Key ResponsibilitiesFinance Team Leadership

●       Build, structure, and manage the finance operations team as the company scales, including hiring, onboarding, and developing team members.

●       Define clear roles, ownership, and accountability across the finance function.

●       Set the operating cadence, standards, and quality bar for the team's work.

Internal Controls & Financial Governance

●       Design and implement checks and balances across financial processes, including approval hierarchies, segregation of duties, and audit trails.

●       Establish and document finance policies and procedures to ensure consistency, accuracy, and audit-readiness.

●       Proactively identify control gaps and financial risk as the company grows and put safeguards in place before they become problems.

Financial Close & Consolidation

●       Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close process end-to-end, including reconciliations, accruals, and close checklists.

●       Continuously shorten and tighten the close cycle through better process design and automation.

●       Ensure financials are accurate, timely, and audit-ready at every close.

Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) and Forecasting

●       Build and maintain rolling financial forecasts across revenue, expenses, headcount, and cash.

●       Own the quarterly reforecast process, incorporating actuals, pipeline, and business changes.

●       Partner closely with the COO on the company's operating plan, providing the financial modeling and analysis that inform strategic decisions.

Budgeting & Departmental Financial Planning

●       Drive the annual budget planning process end-to-end along with the COO, from timeline and templates through final leadership approval.

●       Work with department leads to establish departmental budgets and track actuals against plan throughout the year.

●       Monitor spending, flag variances, and recommend cost optimization strategies across the business.

Reporting & Metrics

●       Produce clear, recurring financial reporting and dashboards for founders and leadership, including P&L, cash flow, budget-vs-actual, and key SaaS metrics (ARR, MRR, net revenue retention, churn, gross margin, CAC/LTV, and similar).

●       Translate financial data into operational insight leadership can act on, not just numbers on a page.

●       Continuously improve reporting through better tooling, automation, and visualization.

SaaS Revenue Operations & Sales Interface

●       Understand the mechanics of SaaS finance — bookings vs. billings vs. revenue, deferred revenue, and revenue recognition — and apply that understanding across forecasting and reporting.

●       Interface directly with sales leadership on revenue forecasting, pipeline-to-revenue bridges, and renewal forecasting.

●       Partner with sales and customer success on subscription revenue recognition and renewal/churn tracking to keep forecasts grounded in what's actually happening in the business.

Financial Operations Automation

●       Implement automation across Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, close, and reporting workflows.

●       Introduce AI-driven and software-based tools to streamline financial operations and reduce manual, error-prone work.

●       Continuously evaluate and adopt new technology to keep finance operations lean and scalable as the company grows.

Accounts Payable & Vendor Payment Management

●       Manage all vendor payments with a focus on SaaS and technology vendors.

●       Ensure SaaS subscriptions and vendor invoices are paid on time to avoid disruptions.

●       Implement automated approval workflows and payment tracking systems.

●       Maintain transparency and discipline in vendor payment processes.

SaaS Vendor Management & Contract Negotiations

●       Manage financial relationships with all SaaS and technology vendors.

●       Lead contract reviews and commercial negotiations to optimize pricing and terms.

●       Evaluate new vendors from a financial efficiency and ROI perspective.

Accounts Receivable & Revenue Collections

●       Ensure all client invoices are generated and delivered through automated systems.

●       Track invoice due dates, payment cycles, and outstanding receivables.

●       Implement structured AR follow-up processes to ensure timely collections.

●       Improve cash flow management and collection efficiency.

Financial Systems & Infrastructure

●       Implement and manage modern finance and FP&A software, including automation and AI-enabled tools.

●       Build scalable financial systems and processes that support company growth, from a lean startup footprint through more formal, audit-ready operations.

●       Ensure financial processes remain transparent, efficient, well-documented, and easy to hand off or scale.

 Strategic Capital & Investment Awareness

While the primary focus of this role is finance operations and FP&A, the candidate should also maintain awareness of financial markets and investment opportunities. The individual may occasionally assist leadership with insights related to capital allocation, treasury management, and emerging financial opportunities.

What Success in This Role Looks Like in the First 12 Months

●       A functioning finance team is in place, with clear roles and a reliable operating cadence.

●       Internal controls and checks and balances are documented and operating across AP, AR, and close.

●       A clean, reliable monthly close process is running on a predictable timeline, with quarterly and annual close following the same standard.

●       The first full annual budget planning process has been run end-to-end, with department-level budgets in place and tracked.

●       Quarterly reforecasts are a routine part of the operating rhythm, done in close partnership with the COO.

●       Leadership has clear, recurring financial reporting and dashboards, including SaaS metrics, to guide decisions.

●       Revenue and renewal forecasting are running in close coordination with sales.

●       Successful implementation of automation across Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable.

●       Reliable systems ensuring all SaaS vendor payments are tracked and paid on time.

●       Optimization and renegotiation of vendor contracts where possible.

●       Scalable financial infrastructure supporting company growth.

Why Join Bikham Healthcare

Bikham Healthcare is a 20-year-old US and India-based healthcare company operating at the intersection of healthcare, technology, and automation. The company has deep expertise in provider credentialing, insurance enrollments, and revenue cycle management for healthcare organizations across the United States.

The company is now entering an exciting phase with the rapid growth of its AI-powered platform, Provider Passport, which is designed to automate healthcare administration and significantly reduce provider onboarding timelines.

Provider Passport is expected to onboard major health systems in the United States, positioning Bikham as a growing healthcare technology platform.

Provide project related assistance to assigned project teams.; Ensure all work is conducted in accordance with standard operating procedures, policies, good clinical practices and applicable regulatory requirements.; Meeting quality and timeline metrics.;

Essential Functions

  • Complete appropriate role-specific training to perform job duties.;
  • Under supervision, provides study level administrative support to the clinical study management team (examples of such tasks include, but not limited to running system reports, preparing and distributing status reports, creating and maintaining study trackers, follow-up for outstanding issues, etc.).;
  • Under supervision, assist in updating and maintaining systems within project timelines/plans and driving tracking compliance in various systems to enable credible data for analysis.;
  • Perform the activities as per the task list delegated by CMS leads.;
  • Assist CMs in the preparation of i-site pack for their respective sites and countries for assigned studies, by pulling associated reports.;
  • Perform assigned access management related administrative tasks to support team members with project execution, example of tasks includes, but not limited to processing access requests, following up with relevant vendors, etc.;
  • Provide support to technical solution specialist (TSS) on formulations in Excel and on the front-end part.;
  • Periodic review of site level KRIs and historic site performance according to Central Monitoring Plan
  • Facilitating early identification of site-level risk/issue(s) occurring during study conduct and responsible for identification of risk
  • Monitor site performance and make recommendations for timely corrective actions (eg Site Telephone Contact or Triggered Onsite Monitoring Visit)
  • Review the effectiveness of the recommended actions and take appropriate additional actions if no effect is observed
  • Review of the Study Central Monitoring Plan
  • Attend Kick-Off meetings, weekly team meetings, and client meetings, as needed or requested
  • Adhere to the key activities outlined in the SOW as per customer requirements

Qualifications

  • Other Graduate/Post Graduate in Life Sciences or educational equivalent.
  • Requires minumum of 2 years of work experience with minimum 6 months relevant experience.
  • equivalent combination of education, training and experience. Experience level may vary based on customer specific requirements.
  • Basic knowledge of applicable research and regulatory requirements, i.e. International Conference on Harmonisation - Good Clinical Practice and relevant local laws, regulations, and guidelines.
  • Exposure to Microsoft Applications including but not limited to Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills including good command of English language.
  • Effective time management skills.
  • Results and detail-oriented approach to work delivery and output.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with coworkers, managers and clients.
  • Strong listening and phone skills.
  • Good data entry skills.

jobs.title: Sr Business Consultant - WMS Configuration/Implementation - Professional Services
jobs.description:
Overview

Blue Yonder WMS solution expert for transformational projects/programs. Strong domain knowledge in Blue Yonder WMS for solution construct and key contributor to the Change Management

Assists in project planning efforts. Lead customer communication and facilitate business process mapping.

Provide support for client cutover and go-live/Hyper care.

Ability to prepare and deliver presentations for user, management, and executive level audiences.

Conducts/leads business process analysis or design/construction phase of the project that leads to writing functional specifications.

Develops functional specifications for modifications, interfaces, reports and screens that meet the customers business objectives and are of sound design.

 

What You'll Do

  • Strong domain knowledge in Blue Yonder /RedPrairie Discrete WMS solution to construct an overall architecture for current and future customer business needs.
  • Key contributor to the Change Management efforts for global or regional program implementations
  • Provides advice to customers regarding industry best practices and process methodology.
  • Able to ask appropriate questions to assess business needs that fall outside the standard solution, assess integration complexity, architecture constraints.
  • Can demonstrate and facilitate process discussions of product functionality and product architecture (i.e., Show data and process flow from one Blue Yonder solution to another)
  • Design and develop functional specifications for modifications, interfaces, reports and screens to ensure smooth integration between technical and functional business requirements.
  • Lead the project team in preparing Product Requirement Specifications, test plan for modifications.
  • Interact closely with Development services in modification development, quality delivery and organizing demonstrations with customers on modifications.
  • Creates and modifies procedural and system documentation throughout the project.
  • Supports the development and execution of test scripts to ensure Blue Yonder consistently meets the customer's business objectives.
  • Provides level 3 non-technical support during the go-live period.
  • Provides level 3 user support and verifies that the system provides the required business functions and maintains data integrity.
  • Conducts functional analysis sessions with clients and/or the project team to understand the business needs of the client and develops technical solutions to meet those needs. 
  • Provide functional support to the project team, including quality assurance/design review, environment setup, software installation, configuration, report and label generation, operation consulting, troubleshooting, system testing & programming.   
  • Responsible for services delivery of product implementation and related integration.
  • Works as a senior member of a consulting team on product implementation, enhancement, managed services, integration, custom projects either at the customer site or offshore.
  • Handles activities with a diverse scope where analysis of data requires evaluation of identifiable factors.
  • Exercises judgment on methods and techniques for obtaining solutions within generally defined practices and policies.
  • Designs and develops platform workflow/ user interface, integration scripts, ETL mapping, data modeling and data loading.
  • Provides internal training, implementation support activities, or work on internal development projects.
  • Ensures knowledge transfer is conducted with key customer project team.
  • Communicates business cases to Product Management Group and Product Development team regarding customer specific needs related to product functionality and enhancements.
  • Interacts with PMG & PD regarding new releases and new functionality and acts as the liaison to communicate to the rest of the team.

 

What We Are Looking For

  • 4+ Years of corporate experience
  • Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science or Engineering or other relevant discipline.
  • Expertise in technical configuration of WMS product, Solution Integration, Quality Assurance, System Testing, PLSQL, SQL Server, and Performance Tuning.
  • Hands-on Experience on Technical configuration of WMS product (preferably Blue Yonder /RedPrairie WMS), Jasper reports, Nice labels, Pagebuilder and MOCA.
  • Knowledge on interfaces between WMS and ERP/Host, TMS, WLM, T&T, Parcel, 3rd party system that integrates with WMS.
  • Knowledge on integration between WMS and Voice / Material Handling / ASRS systems
  • Ability to resolve complex problems with minimal guidance.
  • Excellent computer skills with in-depth knowledge of operating systems, client/server technology, ERP systems, Integration and Middleware technologies and applications
  • Ability to develop and maintain strong, productive relationships with customers, partners, and consultants.
  • Strong proactive communicator and presenter, able to influence and collaborate at all levels of an organization to maximize problem resolution while effectively presenting information and responding to highly specialized technical questions.
  • Highly developed analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently, effectively, and proactively.
  • Teamwork mentality
  • Contributes to the growth of consulting practice by developing and maintaining practice aids, databases, and best-practice collateral.
  • Ensures compliance with the following internal and external company policies and procedures:  Company project methodology On-time submission of Time, Travel and Expenses report   Company procedures related to travel and expenses.  
  • Skill set and availability requirements as per the organization's needs.
  • Knowledge on Azure fundamentals
  • Provides guidance to Support Services in responding to base technical issues.
  • Understanding and experience with the technical requirements for the product line assigned.
  • Understanding of Database structures. Understanding of various technical platforms and infrastructures.
  • Understands Blue Yonder product suite to convey relationships and touchpoints to the customer.
  • Works with appropriate parties to ensure issues are resolved.
  • Travel readiness based on business needs.

Our Values

If you want to know the heart of a company, take a look at their values. Ours unite us. They are what drive our success – and the success of our customers. Does your heart beat like ours Find out here: Core Values

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

jobs.title: Business Development Manager Pharmaceutical R&D & Testing
jobs.description:
Job Overview

We are looking for a commercially driven Sales & Project/R&D Testing Coordinator to develop business opportunities within the pharmaceutical and life sciences sector.

The role combines B2B business development, sales, client relationship management, technical coordination, and project coordination. The candidate will be responsible for understanding client requirements, identifying relevant pharmaceutical testing and R&D opportunities, coordinating with internal technical teams and laboratories, and converting opportunities into revenue.

The ideal candidate should have experience in pharmaceutical sales, analytical testing services, CRO/CDMO, pharmaceutical R&D, laboratory services, or related life sciences businesses.

Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and develop new business opportunities within the pharmaceutical and life sciences sector.
  • Build and maintain relationships with pharmaceutical companies, R&D teams, QA/QC teams, manufacturing organizations, and procurement teams.
  • Understand client requirements and recommend appropriate testing, analytical, R&D, QA, or regulatory support services.
  • Coordinate with technical, R&D, laboratory, and project teams to understand feasibility, timelines, and requirements.
  • Prepare and coordinate quotations, proposals, commercial discussions, and project documentation.
  • Manage prospects and clients throughout the sales cycle and convert opportunities into confirmed projects.
  • Coordinate projects from initial client requirement through testing/service delivery and closure.
  • Maintain and manage a strong sales pipeline.
  • Track leads, opportunities, proposals, conversions, and revenue.
  • Develop repeat business and maintain long-term client relationships.
  • Achieve defined monthly and quarterly revenue targets.
  • Identify cross-selling and upselling opportunities among existing clients.
  • Maintain accurate records of client communication, requirements, proposals, and project status.
  • Travel for client meetings whenever required.

Services to be Sold / Coordinated

The candidate will work on business generation for pharmaceutical R&D and analytical testing services, including:

  • Assay Testing
  • Dissolution Testing
  • Related Substances / Impurity Testing
  • Microbiology Testing
  • Stability Studies
  • Raw Material Testing
  • Finished Product Testing
  • Water Testing
  • Method Development Support
  • Method Validation Coordination
  • Pharmaceutical R&D Support
  • Pharmaceutical Analytical Testing Services
  • QA / Regulatory Support

Revenue Responsibility

The role has a strong focus on business generation and revenue growth. The candidate will be expected to build a consistent client pipeline and progressively contribute toward approximately ₹10 lakh–₹50 lakh in monthly business, depending on experience, market opportunity, client acquisition, and performance.

The candidate should be comfortable with B2B sales, target-driven business development, negotiation, client acquisition, and converting technical requirements into commercial opportunities.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 2–6 years of relevant professional experience.
  • Experience in pharmaceutical sales, analytical testing services, CRO/CDMO, pharmaceutical R&D, laboratory services, or related life sciences businesses.
  • Understanding of the pharmaceutical testing and R&D ecosystem.
  • Strong B2B sales and business development capabilities.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to understand client requirements and coordinate with technical experts.
  • Strong client relationship management and networking skills.
  • Ability to identify decision-makers and develop long-term client relationships.
  • Strong follow-up and lead-conversion capabilities.
  • Target-oriented and commercially driven approach.
  • Ability to independently develop and manage a sales pipeline.
  • Strong negotiation, presentation, and communication skills.
  • Willingness to work from office and travel for client meetings when required.

Preferred Industry Background

Candidates with experience in the following areas will be preferred:

  • Pharmaceutical Analytical Testing
  • CRO / Contract Research Services
  • Pharmaceutical R&D
  • QC / QA Services
  • Laboratory Testing Services
  • Pharmaceutical Manufacturing
  • API / Formulation Testing
  • Stability Studies
  • Method Development / Validation
  • Regulatory or Quality Support
  • B2B Pharmaceutical Sales

Skills: pharmaceutical b2b sales,testing services,business development,life sciences,sales,client acquisition,testing

*SUMMARY: To co-ordinate and perform processes associated with the configuration, maintenance and validation of databases and database systems and associated applications. *

Responsibilities

_Tasks may include but are not limited to:_

To liaise with relevant staff to determine the allocation of tasks, to establish timelines, to report progress and any issues outstanding.

To assist in training and mentoring Clinical Database Programmers in the configuration of databases and development, testing and running of SAS programs.

To assist in training and mentoring Data Management staff in the specification of databases and SAS programs.

To review specifications for the set-up and modification of project specific data entry software (including edit check specifications).

Review validation plan for edit check and reconciliation check specifications.

Develop, test and run SAS programs for clinical data management. This includes programs for data validation and reconciliation checks, data listings and data transfers.

To configure database/eDC software (both internal and 3rd party) for the use of DM, sponsor and sites.

To perform testing of databases and related applications according to IT and Data Management departmental SOPs, both for initial set-up and maintenance.

To run database upload programs and to process any error reports.

To liaise with 3rd party vendors to resolve issues, implement changes to software.

To liaise with Sponsors or their designates on matters associated with the transfer of electronic data to or from the company, as defined by the Director, Data Management.

To support Data Management in the production and maintenance of system procedures and documentation in accordance with applicable SOPs.

Assist with Quality Assurance and Audit requirements.

Perform other duties as assigned. The duties and responsibilities listed above are representative of the nature and level of work assigned and are not necessarily all-inclusive.

*OTHER SKILLS AND ABILITIES: *

Be able to demonstrate good written and verbal communication skills.

Be able to demonstrate a methodical and logical approach to problem solving and the ability to learn new tasks quickly.

Be able to work with close attention to detail.

Be questioning about the validity of data being entered/extracted.

Be hardworking and efficient.

Possess good team working skills.

Key competencies in customer focus, delivering on commitments, building strong relationships, communicating and influencing, and embracing innovation and change.

The job holder must be computer literate and numerate with a willingness to adapt to various computer systems.

Requirements

Be educated to degree level or relevant experience

At least 5 years experience of Data Management Systems and Software

An understanding of CDISC SDTM standards

Experience of SAS programming language

Promotion to the next level is not automatic based on years of experience. Personnel are evaluated on proven competency, level of responsibility, and ability to work independently.

SUMMARY: Data Product Analyst will manage the lifecycle of our clinical data assets and will treat data not just as a resource, but as a high-quality product that powers our clinical insights and emerging AI initiatives. Data Product Analyst will be responsible for the production-readiness of our data, focusing on data governance and master data management to ensuring that the data products feeding our data intelligence, analytics, Generative AI (GenAI), and Agentic AI systems are governed, reliable, and scalable.

Responsibilities

Tasks may include but are not limited to:

  • Data Governance and Master Data Management (MDM)
    • Act as the custodian of the Master Data Management strategy, ensuring core entities (e.g., sites, patients, investigators) remain consistent across all AI and analytics products.
    • Enforce Data Governance through unified metadata management, ensuring that every data product has clear lineage and strict access controls.
    • Ensure data products comply with global clinical regulations and privacy standards through automated governance checks within the pipeline.
Data Product Strategy and Lifecycle

  • Manage the end-to-end lifecycle of data products, ensuring they are organized and packaged to enable easy access for downstream users.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to define Definition of Done for data assets, incorporating quality, security, and accessibility standards.

DataOps and Pipeline Excellence

  • Oversee the health of the data assembly line, utilizing automated testing and CI/CD principles to ensure continuous delivery of data products.
  • Implement real-time monitoring and observability to detect pipeline anomalies before they impact downstream dashboards, AI models, or other applications.
  • Reduce data debt by standardizing transformation logic and promoting the reuse of modular data components.

Perform other duties as assigned. The duties and responsibilities listed above are representative of the nature and level of work assigned and are not necessarily all-inclusive.

Other Skills And Abilities

  • Cloud Infrastructure: Professional experience within the Azure cloud environment.
  • Data Platform: Experience with data warehouses and/or Databricks.
  • Governance & Lineage: Hands-on experience with Microsoft Purview and/or Databricks Unity Catalog for centralized discovery and access control.
  • MDM: proficiency with Profisee, Informatica, or Ataccama.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Information Systems, or a related technical field.
  • 2+ years of demonstrable experience data governance and/or master data management, preferably within a regulated industry like Life Sciences or Clinical Research.

Promotion to the next level is not automatic based on years of experience. Personnel are evaluated on proven competency, level of responsibility, and ability to work independently.

jobs.title: Lead Corporate Affairs
jobs.description:
About Business

 JOB DESCRIPTION

Adani Group: Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world-class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large-scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG-rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.

NMDPL: Navbharat Mega Developers Pvt. Ltd. (NMDPL) is a Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) formed through a joint venture between the Government of Maharashtra and the Adani Group. It leads the Dharavi Redevelopment Project, aiming to transform one of Asia's largest informal settlements into a modern urban hub with sustainable housing, infrastructure, and economic opportunities.

Job Purpose: The Lead – Corporate Affairs is responsible for supporting government relations, corporate affairs, and regulatory compliance for redevelopment projects. This role involves engaging with government agencies such as BMC and the Collector's Office, assisting with tenant management, and ensuring smooth execution of approvals and permissions. The position also plays a key role in stakeholder management, crisis resolution, and strategic communication to facilitate project execution.

Responsibilities

Lead Corporate Affairs

Government, Railway & Regulatory Liaison

Coordinate with BMC, Collector's Office, Indian Railways, and other authorities to obtain necessary project approvals, including Commencement Certificates (CC) and other regulatory clearances.

Act as the primary liaison with Indian Railways, managing approvals across departments such as engineering, safety, and environment.

Navigate regulatory frameworks to ensure full compliance with applicable laws, policies, and railway-specific mandates.

Maintain up-to-date records of regulatory requirements and approvals.

Environmental & Land Use Permissions

Secure environmental clearances required for redevelopment projects, especially those involving railway land or infrastructure.

Ensure adherence to government-mandated environmental guidelines and sustainability standards.

Manage related documentation and coordinate with environmental regulatory bodies for smooth and compliant project execution.

Corporate Affairs & Internal Coordination

Facilitate effective communication between internal departments and external stakeholders to support corporate affairs objectives.

Provide real-time on-ground updates and strategic input to the Head – GoMH Matters.

Support cross-functional collaboration to streamline redevelopment efforts and approvals.

Land & Data Management

Collect and validate land-related data from government and railway sources to support project planning and decision-making.

Differentiate between legitimate and non-legitimate land claims to ensure fair allocation in redevelopment.

Collaborate with the PMO team to maintain accuracy and integrity of land and compliance data.

Tenant Management & Community Engagement

Support tenant survey execution in collaboration with the Tenant Management and Security teams.

Participate in branding, awareness, and community outreach programs to build trust and understanding among residents.

Assist in implementing skill development and socio-economic initiatives in partnership with HR and local authorities.

Stakeholder & Crisis Management

Build and maintain strong working relationships with key government officials, regulatory agencies, and railway stakeholders.

Address and resolve challenges in acquiring permissions, including bureaucratic delays and legal hurdles, by providing strategic, solution-oriented inputs.

Handle crisis situations involving land acquisition, regulatory bottlenecks, or stakeholder objections to minimize project disruptions.

PMO Team

Tenancy Management Team

Security Team

HR & Skill Development Team

Legal Team

Project Teams

Key Stakeholders - External

Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC)

Collector's Office

Government of Maharashtra (GoMH) Departments

Local Authorities & Urban Planning Bodies

Community & Tenant Associations

Law Enforcement & Security Agencies

NGOs & Social Impact Groups

Indian Railways (Multiple Departments)

Railway Safety & Engineering Authorities

Qualifications

Educational Qualification:

Bachelor's/Master's degree in Business Administration, Urban Planning, Public Policy, Law, or a related field.

Work Experience (Range Of Years)

10-15 Years

Preferred Industry

Experience in government relations, corporate affairs, or land redevelopment in the real estate sector.

Extensive knowledge of Mumbai's regulatory landscape, including BMC policies, land acquisition laws, and redevelopment processes.

jobs.title: Data Monitoring and Ecrf Designer
jobs.description:
Job Description: Data Monitoring & eCRF Design Specialist

Role Overview

The Data Monitoring & eCRF Design Specialist will be responsible for designing, managing, and monitoring clinical trial data systems to ensure accuracy, completeness, and regulatory compliance. The role focuses on eCRF development, data validation, and ongoing data review, while supporting essential medical and regulatory documentation as required.

Key Responsibilities

Data Monitoring & Management

  1. Design, develop, and maintain electronic Case Report Forms (eCRFs) using Zoho Database in alignment with study protocols, CRFs, and regulatory requirements.
  2. Collaborate with clinical operations, investigators, and study teams to understand data collection needs and translate them into user-friendly and compliant eCRF designs.
  3. Perform ongoing data monitoring to ensure data accuracy, consistency, completeness, and timeliness across clinical studies.
  4. Conduct quality checks, query management, and discrepancy resolution in coordination with site teams and internal stakeholders.
  5. Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to eCRF functionality, data flow, and system usability.
  6. Provide controlled access to eCRFs for study teams and support UAT (User Acceptance Testing) and quality reviews.
  7. Ensure adherence to GCP, protocol requirements, and applicable regulatory guidelines in all data-related activities.
  8. Support data lock activities and ensure readiness of clean datasets for analysis and reporting.

Regulatory & Clinical Documentation Support

  1. Support preparation, review, and maintenance of clinical and regulatory documents related to data collection and reporting.
  2. Review clinical documents prepared by internal teams for data consistency, clarity, and compliance.

Collaboration & Project Management

  1. Coordinate with internal teams, sponsors, investigators, and external consultants to align on data requirements, timelines, and deliverables.
  2. Manage multiple studies and data-related tasks simultaneously while maintaining high quality and meeting timelines.
  3. Perform any additional responsibilities related to data management and study support as assigned by management.

Run the Pod

Preferred

  • Systems: Comfortable with billing/EHR platforms and MS Excel for allocation, tracking, and pod-level reporting
  • Notice period: Immediate joiners or candidates on short notice strongly preferred

Performance Expectations

You will be measured on clear, role-specific metrics:

  • Pod resolution / collection rate against target
  • Aged-AR movement (90+/120+) for the pod
  • Pod quality score (QA) and calibration adherence
  • Productivity vs. target, shift adherence, and pod attrition

jobs.title: Associate Data Manager - FS
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Associate Data Manager - FS based in India.

The Associate Data Manager will support the delivery of high-quality clinical trial data across studies within a Functional Services Provider environment.

You will help ensure clinical databases are clean, accurate, consistent, and aligned with study protocols and Data Management Plans.

The role involves reviewing clinical data, identifying discrepancies, managing queries, and supporting database updates throughout the data management lifecycle.

You will also contribute to the development and testing of CRFs, edit checks, and study-specific data listings.

Working with internal teams, clinical sites, vendors, and client stakeholders, you will play an important role in maintaining data quality and study deliverables.

This is a collaborative yet detail-oriented position suited to someone who is analytical, organized, and comfortable managing multiple priorities.

The role is fully remote in India, with fixed working hours and an opportunity to contribute to clinical research that supports the development of new medicines, devices, and diagnostics.

Accountabilities

  • Clinical data review: Review clinical trial data through clinical data management systems (CDMS) and external listings to verify that captured information follows protocol requirements and the Data Management Plan.

  • Query management: Identify problematic or inconsistent data and generate queries for appropriate stakeholders, including investigative sites, vendors, Clinical Research Associates, and client representatives.
  • Query resolution: Review responses for completeness and appropriateness, resolve discrepancies, and update clinical databases as required.
  • CRF and edit check support: Assist with the development of Case Report Forms (CRFs) and edit check specifications in accordance with study protocols.

  • Education: Bachelor's degree or international equivalent from an accredited institution, preferably in a technical, clinical, health-related, or similar field; an equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant experience may also be considered.
  • Clinical data management experience: 3–5 years of practical experience using commercial clinical data management systems and/or Electronic Data Capture (EDC) platforms such as Oracle RDC/Inform, Medidata Rave, DataLabs, or comparable systems.
  • Functional expertise: Proven experience performing the core responsibilities associated with clinical data management, including data review, query management, database updates, testing, and documentation.
  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively with diverse internal and external stakeholders.
  • Technical proficiency: Strong computer skills in a Microsoft Windows environment, including proficiency with Microsoft Office applications such as Outlook, Word, and Excel.
  • Analytical ability: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a methodical approach to identifying discrepancies and ensuring data accuracy.
  • Organization: Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to work independently and manage several projects or priorities simultaneously.
  • Customer focus: Demonstrated ability to support positive customer experiences through effective communication, ownership of deliverables, and consistent, high-quality and timely execution.
  • Adaptability: Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities and able to remain effective while managing multiple deadlines.

jobs.description:
Company Introduction

Availity is one of the leading health information networks in the United States, processing more than 4 billion transactions annually and connecting more than two million healthcare providers and over two thousand technology partners to health plans nationwide. Our teams of technology, business, and customer service professionals in Bangalore, India, are working together to transform healthcare delivery in the United States through innovation and collaboration. Our technologists help develop cutting-edge revenue cycle solutions that help hospitals, health systems, and physicians maximize payments and optimize their workflows.

Availity is a diverse group of people whose talents, curiosity and passion steer the company to create innovative solutions for the US Healthcare industry. If you are a driven, creative and collaborative individual, with exceptional technology skills to drive innovation, we want to hear from you.

Job Description

About Availity

Availity is a leading healthcare technology company focused on simplifying healthcare administration and solving real-world challenges for healthcare providers, health plans, and patients. Our technology helps reduce complexity so providers can spend less time navigating administrative systems and more time focused on patient care.

About Availity India

Availity India is an important part of Availity's global growth journey. Based in Bengaluru, our India teams partner closely with U.S. and global stakeholders across technology, product, operations, customer support, and corporate functions.

Our India organization is being built with a strong focus on ownership, learning, collaboration, engineering excellence, and meaningful business impact. Associates in India have the opportunity to solve complex problems, contribute to global initiatives, and support products and services that are part of the U.S. healthcare ecosystem.

Roles & Responsibilities

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) Engineer to serve as the technical authority for an established AVD environment. This role is engineering focused, responsible for architecture, image lifecycle, automation, performance, security and modernization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, deploy and refine AVD architecture for reliability, scalability, cost efficiency and security. Troubleshoot complex issues (e.g.: user experience, profile issues, connectivity, performance and application behavior).
  • Own and evolve the AVD platform, including host pools, session hosts, scaling, FSLogix and performance optimization.
  • Build, maintain, and optimize golden images (Windows Enterprise multi-session). Manage image pipelines (e.g.: Azure Image Builder, Managed Images / Shared Image Gallery) and ensure image consistency, patching, application delivery alignment and rollback strategies.
  • Engineer AVD infrastructure including VNets, subnets, NSGs, DNS and routing. Partner with network and security teams on traffic flow, access control and optimizations.
  • Define and enforce configuration standards, change control, Windows lifecycle (update rings, feature updates, delivery optimization, etc.) and best practices for global device management.
  • Design, deploy and troubleshooting Intune configuration policies, compliance policies and app deployments. Align Intune policy behavior with AVD session host requirements and troubleshoot policy conflicts and application failures.
  • Drive automation, monitoring and reliability by building scalable solutions with PowerShell, Bicep, Azure Automation and Git; delivering actional reporting via Log Analytics and Power BI. Lead proactive remediations and analytics, participating in incident management and root cause analysis.
  • Provide advanced expertise and mentorship, collaborate with Security on policy design and integration and deliver clear documentation to align stakeholders and achieve measurable results.
  • Understand and integrate Entra ID, Conditional Access Policies and Identity-driven access and device posture considerations. Partner with security teams to align with zero-trust models.
  • Create clear, durable technical documentation (runbooks, architecture diagrams, SOPs) and train support staff on new AVD features, changes and workflows.
  • Participate in On-Call rotation and assist in incident troubleshooting for prompt mitigation of issues.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years in enterprise endpoint engineering or cloud infrastructure, with 5+ years dedicated to AVD in environments of 5,000+ devices (or comparable complexity).
  • Experience with Azure infrastructure services: Intune policy creation and troubleshooting, and golden image creation and lifecycle management.
  • Hands on scripting experience with PowerShell, Bicep and/or terraform. Solid understanding of Azure networking concepts and experience automating cloud platform operations.

Preferred Qualifications

  • AWS experience (virtual desktops, infrastructure or automation) Experience in heavily regulated environments. Certifications in area of expertise: AZ-104 (Microsoft Azure Administrator); AZ-140; AZ-800 / AZ-801; MS102; MD-102

Eligibility

Why Join Availity India

  • Meaningful impact: Work on solutions that help simplify healthcare administration and support better provider and patient experiences.
  • Global exposure: Partner with U.S. teams and leaders while contributing from India to global business priorities.
  • Learning and growth: Be part of a culture that values continuous learning, mentoring, knowledge sharing, and career development.
  • Flexible work experience: Work in a way that supports productivity, collaboration, and team needs across remote, hybrid, and office-based models.
  • Holistic rewards: Benefit from competitive compensation, health and insurance benefits, paid time off, company holidays, leave benefits, Employee Assistance Program support, and learning programs.
  • Inclusive workplace: Join a casual, collaborative, and inclusive environment where associates are encouraged to bring ideas forward.
  • Office experience: For office-based associates, Availity India provides amenities such as coffee and tea, subsidized meals, recreation areas, and eligible night-shift transportation support.

What To Expect From The Hiring Process

Our hiring process is designed to be transparent and engaging. Depending on the role, it may include application review, recruiter discussion, technical or functional assessment, hiring manager interviews, team or leadership conversations, offer discussion, background verification, and onboarding support.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Availity is committed to building an inclusive workplace where all associates feel valued, respected, and empowered to do their best work. We welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds and encourage individuals who are excited by collaboration, innovation, and meaningful impact to apply.

Video Camera Usage

Availity fosters a collaborative and open culture where communication and engagement are central to our success. As a remote first company, we are also camera-first and provide all associates with camera/video capability to simulate the office environment. If you are not able to use your camera for all virtual meetings, you should not apply for this role.

Having cameras on helps create a more connected, interactive, and productive environment, allowing teams to communicate more effectively and build stronger working relationships. The usage of cameras also enhances security and protects sensitive company information. Video participation is required to ensure that only authorized personnel are present in meetings and to prevent unauthorized access, data breaches, preventing social engineering, or the sharing of confidential information with non-participants.

The Clinical Systems & Technology function provides operational leadership for the clinical business ownership of clinical technology, automation, and clinical reporting across the organisation. The role contributes to and helps deliver the clinical roadmap, governance, and adoption of core clinical platforms (including Veeva and Obvio), supports the identification and adoption of clinical AI use cases and contributes to the definition and delivery of standardised, regionalised clinical reporting and KPIs for Clinical Operations.

A key aspect of this role is the ability to work cross-functionally to project manage clinical systems and technology initiatives from requirements through to adoption, coordinating across QA, IT, Biometrics, PM, Medical, BD/OSL, and Operations/Clinical Services leadership.

This position also supports the translation of clinical business needs into IT-compliant technology solutions, helps remove operational inefficiencies, and drives adoption and compliance across clinical systems and platforms.

Responsibilities:

Operations & Governance

  • Support and/or own (depending on level) clinical technology business processes end-to-end, including build, materials, and training.

  • Monitor compliance and contribute to continuous review of operational efficiency across platforms within the function's remit.
  • Partner with QA and IT to support or ensure compliant technology deployment across clinical systems.
  • Translate business needs into IT requirements and solutions, identifying and removing operational inefficiencies across clinical systems and workflows.

AI Tools & Automation (Clinical Use Cases)

  • Lead the identification, prioritisation, and definition of clinical AI use cases in partnership with IT, translating clinical operational needs into clear requirements and ensuring solutions are fit for purpose.
  • Govern the clinical AI and automation roadmap, ensuring initiatives remain aligned to clinical operational priorities and that the pipeline of use cases is regularly reviewed and updated as the capability matures.

Clinical Reporting (Critical)

  • Define and maintain standard clinical reporting requirements and consistent, regionalised KPI metrics for Clinical Operations.

  • Validate, interpret, and govern the use of clinical reporting outputs (e.g., Power BI dashboards) to ensure they meet operational and compliance needs.
  • Drive data-informed decision-making across Clinical Operations by ensuring relevant teams understand and act on standardised clinical reporting.

Business Ownership

  • Support, contribute to, or own (depending on level) the clinical roadmap and strategy for eConsent, ePro, and eCoa, working cross-functionally with Biometrics, PM, and BD/OSL, and partnering with IT on technical configuration and integration.

Operational Scaling & Integration

  • Support the function in enabling regional and global clinical teams to scale effectively for complex, multi-regional studies.

jobs.title: Lab Infrastructure & Operations Technician
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Position Summary

We are seeking a highly organized and hands-on Lab Infrastructure & Operations Technician to manage engineering lab infrastructure, hardware assets, machine provisioning, and inventory operations. The candidate will act as a lab owner, ensuring engineering teams have the required hardware, test systems, and machine configurations to support development and validation activities.

The role requires a combination of IT support, hardware management, lab administration, and coordination with engineering teams for machine setup, maintenance, and infrastructure changes.

In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:

  1. Lab Administration & Ownership

    • Serve as the primary point of contact for engineering lab operations.

    • Maintain overall lab health, organization, and operational readiness.

    • Ensure test benches, development systems, and lab equipment remain functional and available.

    • Coordinate lab infrastructure changes and equipment relocations.

  2. Hardware & Procurement Management

    • Work with procurement teams to identify, order, and track hardware requirements.

    • Manage hardware including:

      • National Instruments (NI) Modules

      • PXI/PXIe Chassis and Controllers

      • Engineering Workstations

      • Test Equipment

      • Network Devices and Peripherals

    • Coordinate with vendors for quotations, procurement, repair, and replacement processes.

  3. Asset & Inventory Management

    • Maintain accurate inventory records and asset tracking databases.

    • Track asset allocation, ownership, utilization, and availability.

    • Conduct regular inventory audits and reconciliation activities.

    • Manage hardware lifecycle from acquisition to retirement.

  4. Machine Provisioning & Maintenance

    • Configure, deploy, and maintain engineering and test machines.

    • Perform machine imaging, reimaging, OS installation, and recovery activities.

    • Install and maintain software tools, drivers, and engineering applications.

    • Troubleshoot hardware and software-related issues.

  5. Engineering & Developer Support

    • Support developers and validation teams with machine setup and hardware requirements.

    • Assist with workstation upgrades and hardware modifications.

    • Support connectivity changes, hardware integration, and test setup requirements.

    • Coordinate and execute machine replacement and upgrade activities.

  6. Infrastructure Support

    • Assist with network connectivity changes and cable management.

    • Support rack installations and hardware setup activities.

    • Maintain documentation related to lab infrastructure and system configurations.

  7. Documentation & Process Improvement

    • Create and maintain SOPs, asset records, and operational documentation.

    • Drive improvements in inventory control and lab management processes.

    • Ensure accurate documentation of hardware configurations and asset movements

Who You Are:

You build partnerships and work collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives. You consistently deliver reliable results, even in a fast-paced environment with competing priorities. You take ownership of challenges, using a hands-on approach to resolve issues and improve processes. You effectively communicate information, maintain organized documentation, and support customers with a responsive and service-oriented mindset.

For This Role, You Will Need:

  • Diploma (NTTF) in Electronics, Computer Engineering, Instrumentation, or a related field or B.E./B.Tech in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Instrumentation, or a related discipline or BCA or B.Sc. in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Experience supporting engineering labs, hardware assets, IT infrastructure, or technical operations environments.
  • Knowledge of hardware inventory management and asset lifecycle processes.
  • Experience with computer hardware troubleshooting and maintenance.
  • Familiarity with Windows operating system installation, imaging, reimaging, and recovery processes.
  • Understanding of engineering lab administration and operational support activities.
  • Ability to coordinate with vendors, procurement teams, and internal stakeholders.
  • Strong documentation, reporting, and organizational skills.
  • Working knowledge of networking fundamentals and connectivity concepts.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and asset management tools.
    Strong problem-solving, prioritization, and customer service skills.
  • Effective verbal and written communication abilities.

Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:

  • Experience working with National Instruments (NI) hardware and related test environments.
  • Familiarity with PXI and PXIe systems.
  • Experience supporting engineering development, validation, or test laboratories.
  • Basic PowerShell scripting knowledge.
  • Understanding of development and test infrastructure environments.
  • Experience managing hardware procurement, inventory audits, and asset tracking systems.
  • Exposure to workstation deployment, hardware upgrades, and lab infrastructure project

Our Culture & Commitment to You:

At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectivesâ€because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams, working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results.

We recognize the importance of employee wellbeing. We prioritize providing competitive benefits plans, a variety of medical insurance plans, Employee Assistance Program, employee resource groups, recognition, and much more. Our culture offers flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave (maternal and paternal), vacation and holiday leave.
