Amazon Alexa is changing how people interact with technology. Alexa+ connects customers to third-party services—booking rides, reserving restaurants, planning travel—through natural voice conversations powered by large language models. Behind every seamless interaction is a quality operation ensuring these experiences work as customers expect.

We're looking for a Senior Program Manager to lead quality programs across the full lifecycle of third-party experiences on Alexa+. You'll own the strategy and execution for pre-launch quality assurance and post-launch monitoring—scaling operations across new experiences, integration patterns, and international markets. You'll drive the adoption of AI-powered investigation tools, build frameworks that connect certification rigor to production quality, and establish the mechanisms that ensure third-party partners deliver experiences customers trust.

Key job responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end quality program strategy spanning pre-launch certification and post-launch monitoring for third-party experiences across multiple integration patterns and international locales
  • Define and operationalize quality lifecycle —establishing SOPs, SLAs, and escalation paths that scale without proportional headcount growth
  • Drive adoption and accuracy improvement of AI-powered investigation tools—setting precision targets, designing audit mechanisms, and managing dependencies with tool development teams
  • Build the 3P partner engagement model—defining communication protocols, fix timelines, and suppression criteria when partners fail to resolve critical defects
  • Establish cross-functional mechanisms with product, engineering, science, and partner-facing teams to route defects to correct owners with actionable evidence
  • Lead international expansion of quality operations—adapting processes, training teams, and validating automation accuracy across new languages and markets
  • Define success metrics, track program health, and deliver quality narratives to senior leadership in weekly and monthly business reviews
  • Manage workforce planning and role transitions within a fixed headcount—optimizing team composition for technical depth and multi-lingual coverage

A day in the life

Your primary focus is making sure third-party experiences on Alexa+ work for customers—across every launch phase, integration type, and market. You review quality dashboards to understand where the biggest customer problems are right now. You will be designing solutions and aligning with UX, Product and Engineering teams on how to improve CX across multiple experiences.

You're operating at the strategic layer. You're preparing the quality narrative for a leadership review—structured as: here's the status, here's what changed, here's why, here's what we need. Beyond the routine, you'll shape how quality scales as Alexa+ expands to new partners, new countries, and new ways of integrating. You own the frameworks that make a small team operate at the scope of a large one.

About The Team

We ensure that every third-party experience on Alexa+ meets the quality bar customers expect—before launch and after. Our team combines quality assurance, production monitoring, and AI-powered automation to detect, investigate, and resolve customer-facing defects at scale. We work across the full lifecycle: certifying experiences pre-launch, monitoring quality in production, and driving fixes through collaboration with internal engineering teams and external partners. We operate across multiple integration types and international markets with a lean team that relies on smart automation and rigorous prioritization. If you want to own quality outcomes for experiences used by millions of customers, and build the systems that make that sustainable, this is the team.

  • 5+ years of program or project management experience

We deliver acute hospital, primary, community and mental health services to a population of over 1.15 million people, and to a wider population of 2.2 million when regional and national services are included.

The Role

The Allergy Service provides primary, secondary and tertiary clinical care for patients with primary allergies. The post holder will work in conjunction with the Clinical Nurse Specialist Team Lead to provide high-quality, patient-centred care to individuals with both short and long-term conditions. The role involves supporting patients throughout their healthcare journey, from investigations and diagnosis through to education and ongoing management of their condition, including the administration of intravenous and subcutaneous injections and infusions. The post holder will provide support to patients and their families in managing lifelong disorders while working autonomously and as part of the wider multidisciplinary team.

Permanent Role

Gartnavel General Hospital

36 Hours Per Week (5 flexible days over Monday to Friday)

jobs.description:
What We're About

Harrison.ai Services, in partnership with Frontier Radiology, is redefining how radiology is delivered by combining leading Radiologists with cutting-edge AI infrastructure to provide consistent, high-quality diagnostic imaging for hospitals, health systems, and their patients.

As a management services organization, we don't just deliver reads, we build the intelligent, scalable infrastructure that empowers radiologists and healthcare providers to thrive together, as part of Harrison.ai's broader mission to transform global healthcare through AI-driven solutions.

About Your Role

The Credentialing Coordinator supports the Credentialing, Licensing & Privileging Manager in ensuring that all radiologists maintain active, compliant state medical licenses, hospital/facility privileges, and payer enrollments necessary to provide teleradiology services without interruption. This role is detail-oriented and deadline-driven, requiring the coordinator to track hundreds of moving credentialing items across multiple states and client facilities simultaneously, escalate risks before they become service gaps, and maintain audit-ready documentation at all times.

This is a support/coordination role — the Coordinator executes day-to-day credentialing tasks, data entry, and follow-up, while the Manager sets strategy, handles complex or escalated cases, and owns final sign-off on privileging decisions.

This is on on-site role in our office in Bangalore and will be required to work US hours.

What You'll Do

  • Prepare, submit, and track new state medical license applications and renewals for radiologists across multiple state medical boards
  • Monitor license expiration dates and initiate renewals within required lead times to prevent lapses
  • Maintain accurate records of license numbers, restrictions by state
  • Assist with initial appointment and reappointment applications for hospital/facility medical staff privileges
  • Compile and submit required documentation (CV, malpractice insurance certificates, references, case logs, health statements) to client facilities
  • Track privileging timelines and escalate delays to the Credentialing, Licensing & Privileging Manager to keep applications moving
  • Conduct or coordinate primary source verification of education, training, board certification, licensure, and work history
  • Support payer enrollment and CAQH profile maintenance/attestation on behalf of providers
  • Query and document results from NPDB, OIG/SAM exclusion lists, and other required databases
  • Maintain credentialing files and databases with current, accurate provider data
  • Generate expiration/renewal reports and dashboards for the Manager; flag upcoming expirations proactively
  • Ensure all files are audit-ready and compliant with NCQA, URAC, Joint Commission, and client-specific standards
  • Provide regular status updates to the Credentialing Manager and flag delays or compliance risks
  • Stay current on state-specific licensing requirements and interstate licensure processes (e.g., IMLC)
  • Support internal and external credentialing audits by pulling documentation on request
  • Follow all HIPAA and confidentiality requirements when handling provider data

What You'll Bring

  • High school diploma or equivalent; Associate's or Bachelor's degree preferred
  • 1–3 years of experience in credentialing, medical staff services, licensing, or healthcare administration
  • Strong organizational skills with proven ability to manage a high volume of deadlines simultaneously
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • High attention to detail and comfort with repetitive, precision-based data work

Nice To Have Skills And Characteristics

  • Certified Provider Credentialing Specialist (CPCS) or working toward certification
  • Experience with multi-state licensing, telemedicine/teleradiology, or locum tenens credentialing
  • Familiarity with the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact (IMLC), CAQH, NPDB, and payer enrollment processes

jobs.title: Solar Site Team Leader
jobs.description:
Company Description

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world.

We believe infrastructure creates opportunity for everyone. Whether it's improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive.

Our clients trust us to bring together the best people, ideas, technical expertise and digital solutions to our work in transportation, buildings, water, the environment and new energy. We're one global team – 47,000 strong – driven by a common purpose to deliver a better world.

Job Description

Job Summary

AECOM is seeking an experienced Solar Site Team Leader to lead the day-to-day Project Management Consultant (PMC) oversight of utility-scale solar EPC package execution. The role serves as the single package-level coordination and integration point for progress, risk, quality, health and safety, commissioning, testing, and HOTO (Hand Over Take Over) readiness activities.

The Solar Site Team Leader is responsible for coordinating multidisciplinary PMC resources, monitoring contractor performance, consolidating site observations into actionable recommendations, and ensuring timely resolution of project constraints to support successful project delivery and commercial operation.

Key Responsibilities

Site Delivery Oversight
  • Lead and coordinate day-to-day PMC activities across solar construction clusters and project work fronts.
  • Manage deployment priorities and resource allocation for PMC discipline engineers and cluster construction managers.
  • Monitor EPC contractor performance against approved schedules, quality standards, safety requirements, and contractual obligations.
  • Support achievement of project milestones and Commercial Operation Date (COD) targets.

Progress Monitoring & Performance Management
  • Review EPC workfront readiness, resource deployment plans, construction sequencing strategies, and productivity performance.
  • Assess schedule progress and identify risks, constraints, and recovery opportunities.
  • Monitor implementation of contractor recovery plans and corrective actions.
  • Validate package-level status updates prior to submission to the Solar Lead and Programme Controls team.

Risk & Constraint Management
  • Identify, assess, and monitor critical package risks, constraints, and interface challenges.
  • Drive closure of high-priority punch points and construction constraints impacting project completion.
  • Develop action trackers and escalation reports for unresolved issues requiring management intervention.
  • Support risk mitigation planning and execution across project stakeholders.

Interface & Stakeholder Coordination
  • Coordinate interactions between EPC contractors, OEMs, client representatives, commissioning teams, and PMC disciplines.
  • Facilitate cross-functional collaboration to address project issues and maintain alignment across all stakeholders.
  • Support integration activities associated with testing, energization, commissioning, and handover requirements.
  • Ensure effective communication of package status, issues, and recommended actions.

Commissioning & HOTO Readiness
  • Support commissioning planning, testing activities, performance verification, and HOTO preparation.
  • Monitor project readiness for energization and operational handover milestones.
  • Review commissioning constraints and recommend actions necessary to achieve readiness objectives.
  • Coordinate resolution of outstanding technical and quality issues affecting handover acceptance.

Reporting & Client Support
  • Consolidate discipline-specific observations and translate them into package-level recommendations.
  • Prepare status reports, escalation notes, and readiness assessments for programme leadership and client review.
  • Provide clear visibility of project performance, risks, constraints, and mitigation plans.
  • Support client governance meetings and project review workshops.

Qualifications

Education
  • Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline from a recognized institution.

Experience
  • Minimum 15 years of relevant experience in utility-scale solar, renewable energy, power generation, or major infrastructure projects.
  • Proven experience in construction management, site supervision, project delivery, or PMC roles on large EPC projects.
  • Demonstrated experience managing multidiscipline site teams during construction, commissioning, and handover phases.
  • Experience working directly with EPC contractors, OEMs, and client organizations.

Additional Information
  • Strong understanding of utility-scale Solar PV systems and associated balance-of-plant infrastructure.
  • Knowledge of construction methodologies, commissioning processes, testing requirements, and handover procedures.
  • Familiarity with project controls, schedule management, risk management, and quality assurance practices.
  • Ability to interpret construction progress, identify risks, and drive issue resolution.

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

About AECOM

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

What makes AECOM a great place to work

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you'll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you've always envisioned. Here, you'll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community - where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

About The Opportunity

A fast-scaling leader in the consumer goods manufacturing sector, we specialize in designing, producing, and delivering high-quality soft plush toys and home décor items for global retail partners. Our merchandising team bridges design, production, and retail strategy—ensuring products are on-trend, cost-optimized, and shelf-ready for mass-market success across India and international markets.

Role & Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end merchandising for soft plush product lines—from concept briefs to final retail execution, ensuring alignment with seasonal trends and retailer demands.
  • Collaborate with design, sourcing, and production teams to translate creative briefs into manufacturable, cost-efficient product specs with clear BOMs and quality benchmarks.
  • Manage vendor relationships across tier-1 and tier-2 manufacturers in India, negotiating timelines, MOQs, and compliance with quality and safety standards (ISO, ASTM, EN71).
  • Develop merchandising calendars and assortment plans that drive category growth, inventory turnover, and margin optimization for key retail accounts.
  • Analyze sales data, market trends, and competitor assortments to adjust product mix, pricing, and promotional strategies in real-time.
  • Oversee pre-production samples, tech packs, and quality audits to ensure final products meet retail buyer specifications and global compliance standards.

  • Soft Plush Manufacturing
  • Merchandising Strategy
  • Product Development Lifecycle
  • Vendor Management
  • Quality Assurance Compliance
  • Assortment Planning
  • Seasonal Trend Forecasting
  • Retail Buyer Communication

Preferred

  • Experience with major Indian toy retailers (e.g., Hamleys, Toys R Us India, Flipkart, Amazon India)
  • Familiarity with international toy safety standards (ASTM F963, EN71, ISO 8124)
  • ERP or PLM systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Arena PLM)

Benefits & Culture Highlights

  • Opportunity to shape global product lines from concept to retail shelf
  • Performance-linked bonuses and career progression paths in a high-growth consumer goods ecosystem

  • Leads the operational execution of the service/sales funnel, ensuring visibility, accuracy, and health across all funnel stages using standardized CRM dashboards.

Job Description

In this role, you have the opportunity to make life better Given the challenges the world faces today, Philips purpose has never been more relevant. Whatever your role, if you share our passion for helping others, you will be working towards creating a better and fairer future for all.

You are responsible for

As Compliance Counsel for the Indian Sub-continent Zone (ISC), you will be responsible for developing and deploying the Zone compliance program and advising the business on legal compliance matters across ISC. You will conduct and coordinate investigations reported through SpeakUp and other reporting channels. You will also help strengthen Philips global Market compliance program by sharing insights and best practices from ISC.

Your key areas of responsibility include:

Compliance program development and implementation

  • Support the Head of Legal and the ISC leadership team in developing the annual Zone compliance program based on local and global priorities.
  • Drive and coordinate the implementation of initiatives included in the annual Zone compliance program, including the ISC Compliance Program 2.0 and India compliance enhancement work. Monitor execution through the ISC Compliance Committee, track agreed remediation actions and maintain appropriate evidence and documentation.
  • Translate identified risks, audit findings and lessons learned into sustainable controls, action plans, monitoring activities and evidence-based reporting.
  • Monitor General Business Principles (GBP) and legal compliance controls, identify deficiencies and follow up on remediation actions.
  • Conduct periodic compliance risk assessments and use the outcomes to shape training, communications, monitoring and risk-mitigation measures.
  • Develop and deliver practical, risk-based compliance training and communications for employees, leaders and relevant third parties.
  • Support compliance due diligence, onboarding and ongoing monitoring of distributors, channel partners, agents, consultants and other third parties across ISC.
  • Promote a strong culture of integrity and help embed compliance requirements in business processes and decision-making.

Legal compliance advice

  • Provide timely and pragmatic advice on legal compliance matters, including:
  • Anti-bribery and anti-corruption
  • Healthcare compliance and interactions with healthcare professionals and government officials
  • Competition and antitrust law
  • Conflicts of interest
  • Gifts, hospitality, sponsorships, grants and donations
  • Third-party compliance risks
  • Export controls, trade restrictions and sanctions

Job Title

Senior Toxicologist

Job Description

Philips is a global leader in health technology, committed to improving billions of lives worldwide and striving to make the world healthier and more sustainable through innovation. Driven by the vision of a better tomorrow.

But it's not just what we do, it's who we are. We are 75,000, wonderfully unique individuals, with two things in common: and a relentless determination to deliver on our customers needs. It's what inspires us to create meaningful solutions - the kind that make a real difference - when it matters most.

The world and our customers needs are changing faster than ever before and while we are proud of what we do already, we know we can do more. That's why we need you, to help us tackle increasingly complex challenges posed by ever evolving health and well-being needs.

In this role, you have the opportunity to:

  • Author scientifically rigorous Toxicological Risk Assessments (TRAs) class II/III medical devices, leveraging analytical and biological testing data to ensure compliance with ISO 10993 and ISO 18562 standards. Support regulatory submissions, design modifications, and field-related issue assessments.
  • Support the design, monitoring, and interpretation of in vitro and in vivo biocompatibility studies, as well as chemical characterization studies, including volatile organic compounds (VOCs) and extractables & leachables (E&L).
  • Collaborate closely with Biological Safety Engineers, Materials Scientists, and other cross-functional stakeholders to evaluate and select safe, optimal materials for the intended patient population.
  • Support regulatory submissions, including drafting strategic responses to agency inquiries and preparing technical reports and documentation for pre-submissions
  • Proactively update and maintain toxicology and biocompatibility-related QSPs, WIs, and templates/forms to ensure alignment with evolving regulatory expectations and internal requirements.
  • Identify opportunities to enhance team capabilities develop and deliver toxicology programs to strengthen competency and foster a collaborative, peer-review-driven team environment.
  • Author and contribute to posters, publications, and manuscripts, and actively represent Philips at scientific conferences and AAMI working groups.
  • This position is based in Pune-India

You are a part of:

Philips is dynamic Healthcare Technology organization that designs and develops life-saving Respiratory Care products. At Philips, we are passionate about improving quality of life with solutions designed around the needs of customers and their patients. Our tradition of innovation, combined with our ability to anticipate market needs, has made Philips a global leader in Respiratory Care

You're The Right Fit If:

  • You hold a Master's degree or Ph.D. in Toxicology, Pharmacology, or a closely related scientific discipline, with at least 5-10 years of relevant experience. Board Certification in Toxicology (e.g., DABT) is highly preferred.
  • You have proven, hands-on experience authoring rigorous Toxicological Risk Assessments (TRAs). Experience with TRAs from industries beyond medical devices is also welcomed.
  • You possess a comprehensive understanding of toxicology principles, risk assessment methodologies, and relevant standards (i.e. EPA, ATSDR, OEHHA, REACH, ICH, CIR, RIFM…) and comprehensive knowledge of ISO 10993, and ISO 18562.
  • You have strong chemistry expertise, enabling clear interpretation of extractables and leachables (E&L) and VOC chemical characterization data.
  • You demonstrate exceptional technical writing with the ability to translate complex analytical and biological data into clear technical memos, scientific publications, and compliant Quality Management System (QMS) documentation (e.g., QSPs, WIs).
  • You bring strong cross-functional project management skills, with a demonstrated ability to independently manage multiple concurrent projects, oversee external Contract Research Organizations (CROs), and effectively communicate toxicological considerations to non-toxicologists and external stakeholders.
  • You are eager to learn and actively foster an environment of continuous learning and improvement
  • Experience leveraging AI tools to improve efficiency and productivity is highly preferred

In return, we offer you:
The ability to collaborate with, learn and grow from colleagues in a highly complex, global organization where you can use your strengths to help drive strategic business initiatives for Philips. Additionally, we provide you a dynamic working environment in an innovative business, paired with a competitive salary, excellent benefits, and a supportive atmosphere where you can sharpen your talents with new challenges and career opportunities.

There's a certain energy when everyone's in the same room that can heighten idea generation and creative friction needed for problem-solving.

jobs.title: Customer Relationship Specialist
jobs.description:
WHO ARE WE

Welcome to the future of Real Estate Transactions!

Ivy Homes is a realty tech start-up redefining how people buy and sell homes. The product is a merger of traditional real estate maturity and cutting-edge technology. With the power of machine learning and engineering, we have a unique advantage that no other company in real estate has.

The problem Ivy Homes is trying to solve is the first of its kind in India; you'll be in the front seat of disruption of real estate using AI/ML/software. With the help of AI & ML, Ivy Homes is using data from various channels across industries to predict the prices of an apartment.

As a nextgen entity, Ivy Homes is building systems for handling millions of GBs of data, which has to be safely stored over the years to find trends in the housing market.

Our core team comprises IIT and IIM alumni with excellent business and technology acumen. We are backed by marquee Venture Capitalists in the ecosystem, including Y-Combinator, Khosla Ventures, Global Founders Capital and Venture Highway. We are expanding our team and looking for enthusiastic people to join us on this journey.

ASSOCIATE - CRM - ROLE SUMMARY

As an Associate in our Customer Relationship Management (CRM) team at Ivy Homes, you will play a pivotal role in managing end-to-end transaction handling and facilitating customer loan processing. You'll be the bridge between our clients and Ivy Homes, ensuring a seamless experience from completing the process for purchasing a property till its sale is completed. Your effective communication, both oral and written, will be vital in assisting clients and ensuring registration is done smoothly.

WHAT WILL YOU DO

End-to-End Transaction Handling: Take ownership of projects from initiation to completion, ensuring all customer requirements are met and projects are executed seamlessly.

Loan Processing Support: Assist customers in processing loans, providing guidance and support by being a bridge between the customers and the Banks.

Communicating with clients: Communicate with clients, both verbally and in writing, to understand their needs, provide updates, and address any concerns promptly.

Data Management: Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of customer interactions and project progress in the CRM system.

Collaboration with clients: Collaborate with internal teams to ensure all customer needs are met and projects are executed efficiently.

Customer Satisfaction: Ensure a high level of customer satisfaction by addressing inquiries, resolving issues, and providing exceptional service.

Liaisoning & Stakeholder Management: Build and maintain strong liaisoning networks with banks, legal teams, government authorities, and other stakeholders to ensure smooth transaction processing and timely closures.

Field Operations & Coordination: Be willing to travel and handle on-ground coordination whenever required for registrations, documentation, banking processes, and overall transaction management to ensure seamless execution.

WHAT DO YOU NEED TO BRING TO THE TABLE

Years of Experience: While prior experience in a similar role in the real estate industry is preferred, it's not mandatory. Experience in customer relationship management and loan processing is a plus. Preferred 1-5 years of experience.

Communication Skills: Proficiency in English is essential, and knowing Hindi, Marathi or any one other language is an advantage. Strong verbal and written communication skills are crucial for effective customer interactions and project management.

Organisational Skills: Good organisational skills to manage projects and customer data efficiently.

Quick Learner: The ability to learn and adapt to new CRM systems and processes.

Team Player: The ability to work collaboratively with multiple stakeholders to ensure customer needs are met.

Detail-oriented: A keen eye for detail to maintain accurate customer records and project documentation.

Customer-Centric: A commitment to providing excellent service and ensuring customer satisfaction.

If you're ready to be a part of a dynamic team in the future of real estate transactions and meet the criteria above, we'd love to hear from you. Join us at Ivy Homes and help us revolutionise the real estate industry in India

jobs.title: Senior Medical Writer- Publications
jobs.description:
Overview


Cactus Life Sciences partners with global biopharma to drive innovation and improve patient outcomes through agile, science-driven medical communications - transforming complex data into actionable insights.
Please note: We are a remote-first organization, and we embrace an accelerate from anywhere culture. You may be required to travel to our Mumbai office based on business requirements or for company/team events.


Responsibilities


  • Use scientific expertise to develop (write, proofread, and data-check) high-quality, client-ready scientific, medical, and educational materials like slides, abstracts, posters, manuscripts, congress and meetings materials, and literature searches and reviews according to client needs with excellent attention to detail under the guidance of the scientific leads.

  • Actively involve in reviewing materials developed by scientific writers to ensure strategic alignment and scientific accuracy as needed and provide clear constructive feedback, support, and supervision to writers. Mentor and train scientific writers by sharing best practices and client preferences, thereby contributing to skill development within the team.

  • Perform as a document specialist, provide intellectual input across document types, and contribute to making cutting-edge research accessible to specific audiences as appropriate, by maintaining current awareness of developments across therapeutic areas or disciplines.

  • Liaise and build trusting and professional relationships with international pharmaceutical clients, healthcare professionals, internal and external stakeholders, including authors, reviewers, and key opinion leaders across therapeutic areas - learning to anticipate their needs.

  • Effectively and proactively communicate with team members, authors/faculty, clients, and vendors.

  • Attend workshops/seminars/trainings to hone your skills and contribute to organizational objectives.

  • Attend client and other external meetings and support senior team members as needed.

  • Apply your scientific and creative knowledge and work closely with client directors in developing ideas and executing effective medical communications initiatives in the digital space, including publication extenders, creation of infographics, interactive assets, website content, patient narratives, and medical information engagement plans.

  • Ensure all materials follow/comply with client requirements/SOPs, style guides, client templates, client preferences (as applicable), and CACTUS internal SOPs. Any updates to either of these items should be made consistently and documents should remain up to date.

  • Share best practices and client preferences, thereby contributing to skill development within the medical communications team.

#LI-Remote


Qualifications and Prerequisites


  • 5+ years of experience in publications within a pharma company or medical communications agency.
  • PhD/MD (Pharmacology) OR PhD (Life Sciences) OR PharmD with a good understanding of clinical research and medical communication.
  • Clear, concise, scientific style of writing, with a high level of attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Ability to adapt writing style to suit different materials and target audiences.
  • Literature reviewing and evaluation capabilities.
  • Very good working knowledge of MS Office and basic knowledge of biostatistics.
  • Shows an eagerness to learn and apply AI tools and technologies.

Application Process


Before applying, please ensure you meet the role requirements listed above and have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is advertised. Our selection process includes two Technical Interviews with the Hiring Manager and peers, and a Technical Assessment, where candidates will have agreed upon timeline to complete the task. The final round will be the HR Interview. All interactions will be conducted virtually via MS Teams.

AI at Cactus Life Sciences
The life sciences industry is undergoing a fundamental shift in how scientific knowledge is created, communicated, and delivered. We are building our work around it.
AI is embedded meaningfully across everything we do, through proprietary platforms purpose-built for life sciences and generative tools that deliver measurable value to our clients. It is core to how we operate, and an expected way of working for everyone who joins us.
We believe in Human-Anchored AI™: whatever your discipline - science, communications, strategy, or operations, you will work in an environment where AI augments your expertise rather than replaces it.
You will build skills that are in genuine demand and still taking shape across the industry. If you are curious and focused on building capabilities for the world where human intelligence meets artificial intelligence, this is where you belong.

Equal Opportunity

Our hiring practices reflect our commitment to providing equal opportunities and creating an environment where everyone can thrive, develop, and succeed.We celebrate the uniqueness of our team members and prohibit discrimination of any kind, based on race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other protected characteristic.


About CACTUS


At Cactus Life Sciences (cactuslifesciences.com), we believe the future of medical communications lies at the intersection of science, technology, and human connection. Headquartered in Princeton, New Jersey, with teams in Switzerland, the United Kingdom, India, and Japan, we help biopharmaceutical organizations redefine scientific exchange-leveraging AI, automation, and innovation while keeping patients at the heart of everything we do.

Our expertise spans medical strategy, scientific content development, and medical education across therapeutic areas and the product lifecycle. By blending scientific rigor, agile operational models, and future-ready technologies, we partner with medical affairs teams to catalyze their transformation, adapt to a changing landscape, and drive meaningful outcomes for healthcare communities worldwide.

jobs.title: Manager - Viral Safety
jobs.description:
Job Description

Primary Job Function:

Experienced Biological Safety expert to independently evaluate the safety of drug products derived from different sources including animal origin. The role requires strong expertise in biological risk assessment, molecular biology, and zoonotic disease evaluation. The candidate will contribute to decision making on product safety, supplier qualification, and mitigation of risks related to infectious agents.

Core Job Responsibilities:

1. Biological Safety Assessment

  • Carry out adventitious agents risk assessments for drug products derived from animal origin.
  • Identify and evaluate risks from viral, bacterial, and prion contaminants.
  • Develop risk mitigation strategies and provide scientific recommendations.
  • Evaluation of the sourcing/manufacturing process changes and subsequent adventitious agent risk for the product.

2. PCR Data Review & Interpretation

  • Review and interpretation of PCR assay data for pathogen detection and clearance.
  • Assess method suitability, detection limits, and data reliability.
  • Collaborate with laboratory teams to troubleshoot and optimize testing strategies.

3. Raw Material Source Qualification

  • Evaluate and approve animal tissue sources based on safety criteria.
  • Review supplier documentation, including:
  • Animal health and veterinary records
  • Traceability and sourcing practices
  • Slaughterhouse and processing conditions
  • Perform risk-based supplier assessments.

4. Zoonotic Risk Monitoring

  • Monitor global and regional disease outbreaks with zoonotic relevance.
  • Assess impact of emerging infectious diseases on raw material safety.
  • Provide timely scientific input during outbreak or risk scenarios.

5. Regulatory Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with applicable global biosafety and regulatory guidelines (WHO, WOAH/OIE, EMA, FDA as applicable).
  • Support preparation of regulatory documentation and responses.
  • Contribute to internal audits and external inspections.
  • Tackle regulatory queries pertaining to biological safety

6. Documentation & Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Prepare risk assessments, technical reports, SOPs, and justifications.
  • Collaborate with R&D, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Pharmacovigilance and Procurement teams.
  • Present scientific findings to internal stakeholders and management.

Supervisory/Management Responsibilities: NA

Direct Reports: No

Indirect Reports: No

Position Accountability/Scope:

  • Accountable for biological safety risk management, adventitious agent assessment, PCR data evaluation, raw material qualification, zoonotic risk surveillance, regulatory compliance, scientific documentation, and cross-functional leadership to ensure patient safety, product quality and regulatory compliance.

Minimum Education:

  • MVSc/PhD in Microbiology, Toxicology, Molecular Biology, Veterinary Science, or related field.

Minimum Experience/Training Required:

  • Advanced degrees in Veterinary Sciences, Microbiology, Lifesciences, Biotechnology, Toxicology, Pharmacology, or a related field at least 10 years of experience
  • Knowledge of biological safety, adventitious agent risk assessment, PCR-based pathogen detection, and zoonotic diseases.
  • Understanding of global regulatory requirements, GxP, quality systems, and risk assessment principles.
  • Experience in supplier qualification, raw material safety assessment, and traceability evaluation.
  • Strong technical writing, documentation, and cross-functional communication skills.

jobs.title: Site Contract Specialist II
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Site Contract Specialist II based in India.

This role supports the successful management and execution of clinical trial site contracts across complex, often multi-country studies.

You will coordinate contracts, budgets, amendments, documentation, and approvals while ensuring timelines and quality standards are consistently met.

Working closely with clinical operations, legal, finance, vendors, investigators, and sponsors, you will help resolve contractual and budgetary issues efficiently.

The position combines contract management, negotiation, project coordination, and stakeholder communication in a fast-paced clinical research environment.

You will also contribute to process improvements, quality assurance, training, and the development of less experienced team members.

Strong attention to detail and an understanding of clinical development and contracting requirements will be essential to keeping studies moving forward.

This is an opportunity to contribute to global clinical programs that help bring important therapies to patients more efficiently.

Accountabilities

  • Manage site contract activities at the project level, coordinating protocol, informed consent, institution, investigator, vendor, consultant, and customer agreement documentation.
  • Support multi-country clinical trial projects by preparing and negotiating site contracts, budgets, amendments, and related documentation under appropriate supervision.
  • Support the development and agreement of country-level contract and budget templates and prepare site-specific agreements from approved templates.
  • Coordinate contract and budget submissions, negotiations, issue resolution, quality control, execution, document archival, and metadata capture.
  • Work closely with contract managers and project team members to actively track and resolve outstanding contractual issues.
  • Monitor contracting milestones against forecasted country and site timelines and maintain accurate, real-time project tracking.
  • Collaborate with legal, finance, clinical operations, vendors, sponsors, investigators, and other internal and external stakeholders to communicate and resolve contractual or budgetary matters.
  • Maintain contract templates, site-specific files, databases, training materials, and project documentation.
  • Provide functional guidance, mentorship, and training to less experienced team members while supporting departmental SOPs and quality standards.
  • Support business development activities and represent site contracting and study start-up functions in internal and customer-facing meetings.
  • Monitor basic financial aspects of assigned projects, identify discrepancies, and escalate issues appropriately.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline contracting and internal processes and introduce practical solutions that improve efficiency and quality.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable SOPs, work instructions, training requirements, and timesheet processes.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Public Administration, Public Health, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience; an advanced degree is preferred.
  • Significant experience in contract management, ideally within a contract research organization, pharmaceutical company, or related clinical research environment.
  • Strong knowledge of clinical development processes, contracting principles, and relevant legal and regulatory considerations.
  • Solid understanding of clinical trials across Phases I–IV, ICH GCP, clinical protocols, and study specifications.
  • Strong knowledge of clinical trial site start-up and contracting processes.
  • Demonstrated project management experience in a fast-paced, complex environment, with the ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities.
  • Strong negotiation, problem-solving, vendor management, and stakeholder-management capabilities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, documentation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and the ability to work effectively with contract and project documentation systems.
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with a strong commitment to quality and compliance.

Job Description In Primary Posting Language (Include Requirements For Education, Experience And Skills)

Specialist, Data Acquisition Enablement Analyst

The Opportunity

  • Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
  • Be part of an organization driven by digital technology and data-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
  • Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats.

Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company's IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.

A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.

Role Overview

The Specialist within the CD&AO Data Acquisition and Enablement team will be responsible for supporting data ingestion planning across various therapeutic areas (oncology, vaccines, chronic care, etc) and across the internal teams within data domains. The incumbent will work on ingestion activities related to the bringing in of new data assets and will report into the Data Acquisition Enablement Leader. This role will provide support in all areas of the data ingestion lifecycle – from idea to implementation – and will be accountable for ensuring key milestones, objectives, and timelines are thought out, communicated, and met.

Key responsibilities include and are not limited to the following

  • Supports all major platforms and markets and responsible for Data Enablement Plan.
  • Work closely with Data Enablement Lead, Data Strategy & Governance, Engineering Team, and Data Domain Owners, as well as other stakeholders to ensure the enablement plan is defined, managed, and communicated.
  • Working in the data launch playbook, ensure each key objective is met and all documentation, requirements, etc. are properly captured, stored, and shared.
  • To understand the Data Platform landscape and offer guidance and expertise on ingestion processes for those platforms.
  • Create and maintain Data Product in Discovery.
  • Ensure a proper hand-off of information once the project has completed.

The Specialist is expected to help facilitate communication between multiple business areas and project leads. Strong communication skills are required for frequent engagement with DHH partners, CD&AO team, business application owners, and outside vendors. This position is also responsible for leading the development of and maintaining business related documentation such as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), business cases, and project status logs/updates.

Qualifications

Education Required – BA/BS in Business Administration, Sales, Marketing, IT or other related fields.

Required Experience

  • Minimum of 3 years experience in Pharmaceutical data, commercial operations, IT operations, or sales and marketing support area.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, detail-oriented, team environment
  • Possess good organization capabilities and exceptional communication skills
  • Flexible to change in process timing and deliverables
  • Technical working knowledge related to database application development (developer or business owner)
  • Proficient in SQL, experience with relational databases (MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle, Redshift or Databricks), solid analytical skills.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience with data lake and/or Data Management
  • Experience with Agile Methodology
  • Vendor management experience
  • Experience with PowerBI

Required Skills

Animal Vaccination, Business Administration, Data Governance, Data Ingestion, Data Management, Data Modeling, Digital Transformation, Global Health, Information Technology Operations, IT Operation, IT Project Lifecycle, Medical Prescriptions, MySQL, Oncology, Quality Management

jobs.title: Quantitative Analytics Manager
jobs.description:
About this role:

Wells Fargo is seeking a Quantitative Analytics Manager.

Wells Fargo is seeking a hands-on Manager for oversight of development of Foundation models as well as Gen AI and Agentic applications supporting the bank across various lines of business.

Model, Methodology and Research (MMR) Team: MMR is a specialized team which supports high priority research and development activities across Front line and second line teams within the bank. Team supports various strategic initiatives including development of Gen AI applications, in-house Large Language models, research for cutting-edge development in the industry, and Agentic development. Team also publish research papers in the top-tier conferences such as NeurIPS or ICLR.


In this role, you will:

  • Manage a team responsible for the creation and implementation of low to moderate complex financial areas

  • Mitigate operational risk and compute capital requirements

  • Determine scope and prioritization of work in consultation with experienced management

  • Participate in the development of strategy, policies, procedures, and organizational controls with model users, developers, validators, and technology

  • Make decisions and resolve issues regarding operational risks and enable decision making in business, product, marketing, or other functional areas

  • Manage a team comprised of quantitative analysts and credit risk analysts

  • Interact with internal and external audit or regulators

  • Manage allocation of people and financial resources for Quantitative Analytics

  • Mentor and guide talent development of direct reports and assist in hiring talent


Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of Quantitative Analytical experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

  • 2+ years of leadership experience

  • Master's degree or higher in a quantitative discipline such as mathematics, statistics, engineering, physics, or computer science

Desired Qualifications:

  • Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence,Engineeringor related quantitative field
  • 5+ years of experience in AI/ML model development
  • 2+ years of experience building Foundation Models, Gen AI and Agentic AI applications
  • Strong quantitative and analytical skills, with the ability to apply data analysis, modeling, visualization, statistics, research, and generative AI to generate insights, adapt quickly, and support innovative solutions.
  • Ability to execute with urgency, apply data and software engineering skills to design, develop, and deliver scalable solutions, and drive operational excellence with strong data management and an enterprise mindset.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to foster an inclusive environment and actively seek, apply, and respond to feedback in collaborative analytical settings.
  • Strong business acumen with a commitment to providing excellent service and supporting data-informed business outcomes.
  • Ability to act with integrity, support risk assessments, and apply risk controls to help manage risk in a disciplined, data-driven environment.

Knowledge and Experience in:

Foundation Model Training

  • Experience with pre-training, supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and post-training methodologies including RLHF, RLAIF, PPO, DPO, and GRPO
  • Training and deploying models in cloud environments, including GCP

Agentic AI

  • Multi-agent architectures and orchestration frameworks likeLangChain,LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Google's ADK,CrewAI
  • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) applications and intelligent agent deployment

AI Infrastructure & Optimization

  • Distributed GPU training
  • Efficient model tuning approaches such asLoRAand PEFT

Job Expectations:

You will be hands-on working and delivering high-impact projects involving foundation models, large language models, multi-agent workflows, retrieval-augmented generation, human-in-the-loop AI, model evaluation, automation, and responsible AI deployment at enterprise scale. In addition, you will also lead a team workingon building Agentic and Gen AI applications.

  • Design, pre-train, fine-tune, and evaluate transformer-based, foundation, and small language models (SLMs).
  • Develop and deploy AI and machine learning solutions across generative AI, agentic systems, and traditional machine learning applications
  • Design and build LLM-powered agents and multi-agent systems capable of planning, reasoning, task orchestration, and human-in-the-loop collaboration
  • Monitor production models and AI systems, evaluating performance, stability, and model drift through testing and analytics frameworks
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, technical experts, and business leaders across the organization
  • Gain exposure to enterprise-scale AI development, governance, and risk management practices
  • Apply AI, machine learning, and generative AI techniques to solve complex business problems.
  • Build andoptimizescalable model training and deployment pipelines.
  • Leverage distributed computing and advanced training techniques to improve model performance and efficiency.
  • Enhance model performance through distillation, quantization, and pruning.
  • Optimizeinference speed, latency, throughout, and cost forproductionAI systems.

jobs.title: Senior Analytics Consultant
jobs.description:
The Consumer Banking Lending (CBL) organization supports the lifecycle management of consumer lending portfolios through data-driven insights, portfolio monitoring, servicing strategy development, operational performance management, and customer experience enhancement.

The team partners closely with business, operations, servicing, collections, technology, and finance teams to deliver actionable analytics that drive portfolio performance, operational efficiency, and customer outcomes across consumer lending products, including Auto Loans.

About this Role

The Consumer Banking Lending Analytics team is responsible for developing analytical solutions and strategic insights that support portfolio management, servicing operations, collections strategies, payment behavior analysis, delinquency management, and overall business performance.

The team is seeking a talented and experienced Senior Analytics Consultant to join the Auto Lending Portfolio & Servicing Analytics Team.

The candidate will provide analytical support across key areas of the Auto lending lifecycle, including portfolio monitoring, customer servicing, payments, collections, deferrals, delinquency management, operational effectiveness, and performance reporting.

This role requires strong business acumen, advanced analytical capabilities, and the ability to translate data into actionable business insights. The ideal candidate will be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, partnering with multiple stakeholders, and driving data-based decision making.

Responsibilities

Execute large and complex analytical initiatives that support Auto Lending portfolio performance and servicing strategy objectives.

Partner with business and operations teams to identify opportunities for improving portfolio performance, customer outcomes, operational efficiency, and servicing effectiveness.

Develop analytical frameworks to assess portfolio trends, customer behavior, payment performance, collections effectiveness, and operational processes.

Build and maintain monitoring dashboards, scorecards, and reporting solutions to track key portfolio and servicing performance indicators.

Analyze asset quality metrics, delinquency trends, payment behavior, roll rates, collections outcomes, customer contact strategies, and portfolio performance across customer, product, vintage, channel, and operational segments.

Develop forecasting and analytical methodologies to support portfolio planning, capacity planning, staffing requirements, collections performance measurement, and business strategy initiatives.

Design, develop, and maintain complex SAS, SQL, Python, and reporting solutions to support portfolio analytics, operational reporting, and business decision making.

Evaluate internal and external data sources to enhance portfolio insights, servicing strategies, and operational effectiveness.

Perform deep-dive analyses to identify emerging trends, operational opportunities, customer behavior patterns, and business improvement opportunities.

Produce monthly, quarterly, and annual performance reporting packages for business leaders and executive management.

Support data governance, data lineage, data quality, and access management initiatives across analytical and reporting environments.

Collaborate with business, operations, servicing, collections, finance, technology, and data teams to deliver analytical solutions and strategic recommendations.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or higher in Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, Finance, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related quantitative field.

4+ years of experience in analytics, portfolio management, servicing analytics, business performance analytics, collections analytics, or related consumer lending functions.

Hands-on experience in at least one of the following areas:

  • Portfolio Analytics
  • Servicing Analytics
  • Collections Analytics
  • Customer Management Strategy
  • Business Performance Analytics
  • Forecasting & Planning
  • Data Management & Reporting

Strong understanding of consumer lending products, portfolio performance metrics, servicing operations, collections processes, and customer lifecycle management.

Advanced proficiency in SAS, SQL, Python, Excel, VBA, Tableau, Power BI, or related analytics and visualization tools.

Experience working with large-scale databases such as Oracle, Teradata, Hadoop, or cloud-based data platforms.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify trends, isolate root causes, and develop actionable recommendations.

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Desired Qualifications

Advanced degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Engineering, Finance, Business Analytics, Data Science, or a related quantitative discipline.

Experience in Auto Lending portfolio management, servicing analytics, collections analytics, or customer management strategy.

Strong proficiency in SAS programming, SAS Macros, SQL, Python, Tableau, Power BI, or other business intelligence tools.

Experience developing executive dashboards, portfolio monitoring frameworks, and operational performance reporting.

Strong project management skills with the ability to prioritize competing priorities and deliver results in a dynamic environment.

Demonstrated ability to influence business decisions through data-driven insights and cross-functional partnerships.

Preferred Candidate Profile

  • Auto Lending experience strongly preferred.
  • Portfolio Management and Servicing Analytics experience preferred.
  • Collections strategy or operational analytics experience preferred.
  • Strong SAS/SQL skills with experience handling large analytical datasets.
  • Experience interacting with business, servicing, and operations stakeholders.

This version should attract candidates much closer to your current CBL Portfolio & Servicing Analytics needs while avoiding a pure credit/risk analytics profile.

23 Aug 2026

The opportunity

We are looking for Marketing Automation Expert who will be responsible for performing the activities related to Brand Marketing and Communications. This individual will support projects involving tactical execution of campaigns end to end, process improvements and educating users on campaign best practices. Must have experience with supporting email marketing campaigns and using various digital marketing tools with a strong interest in data management and analytics. Your Key Responsibilities

  • Work towards organizational objectives along with stakeholders project

Skills And Attributes For Success

  • Experience with marketing automation platform preferably in Adobe Marketo Engage.

  • Proven strong interpersonal with an analytical mindset and problem-solving capability.
  • Familiarity with Agile planning and Agile project management skills.
  • Must be highly organized and self-motivated with a sense of urgency.
  • Knowledge on Microsoft Office suite, especially Excel, PowerPoint and Microsoft SharePoint

To qualify for the role, you must have

  • Any university degree or college diploma in Digital Marketing or a relevant professional experience
  • Min. 8 years of experience in Digital/email marketing Strategic, coordination support role.
  • Strong project coordination skills, including managing internal stakeholder expectations and multiple campaigns
  • Must be a detail-oriented, organized self-starter who can work well within a team, and excel in a fast-paced corporate environment, whilst being able to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Ability to review processes and make suggestions for efficiencies and optimization.
  • Exceptional communication skills - both written and verbal and must be comfortable with presenting to virtual teams.
  • Advanced proficiency with the Microsoft Office suite, especially Excel and Microsoft SharePoint.
  • Functional knowledge of AEM will be an added advantage for this role.
  • Familiarity with complex, multi-national organizations is highly preferred.
  • Ability to translate business needs into technical solutions in MA platform.
  • Adherence to data integrity rules (such as GDPR, CANSPAM) is a must. Specialist knows his customer journeys well-enough to identify every possible opportunity or data breach and the need for appropriate security and get measures in place to safeguard it.

Ideally, you'll also have

  • Strong interest in data management and analytics
  • Storytelling and consulting skills
  • Attention to detail
  • Organized self-starter who can collaborate with a team, and excel in a fast-paced corporate environment, whilst being able to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Adobe Marketo Engage Expert Certification is plus

Technologies and Tools

  • Marketo or any other Marketing Automation platform
  • Workflow management tools eg: Azure boards/Zendesk/Workfront etc
  • Microsoft Office, SharePoint
  • knowledge of working with HTML, CSS, and scripting

What We Look For

  • Strong team contributor
  • Ready to learn and adapt
  • Problem solving skills
  • Stakeholder management
  • Effective communication and consulting

What We Offer

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We'll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

  • Continuous learning: You'll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
  • Success, as defined by you: We'll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
  • Transformative leadership: We'll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
  • Diverse and inclusive culture: You'll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

jobs.title: Data Architect
jobs.description:
Responsibilities :

Design and implement scalable enterprise data architectures to support business intelligence, analytics, and operational reporting. Lead the development of Kimball dimensional models, including star schemas, fact tables, dimension tables, and Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCDs). Create and maintain conceptual, logical, and physical data models using industry-standard data modeling tools. Collaborate with Data Analysts, Data Engineers, Data Governance teams, and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into robust data solutions. Architect and optimize data pipelines for efficient data ingestion, integration, transformation, and storage. Ensure data models align with enterprise data governance, quality, security, and compliance standards. Support real-time and historical analytics by designing scalable and high-performance data warehouse solutions. Drive best practices in data architecture, metadata management, master data management (MDM), and data lifecycle management. Integrate data from multiple enterprise and operational systems, including manufacturing, engineering, ERP, and external platforms. Enable advanced analytics, AI/ML initiatives, and GenAI use cases through well-structured and governed data foundations.

Technical and Professional Requirements:

Strong expertise in Kimball Dimensional Modeling, Dimensional Data Modeling, Star & Snowflake Schemas, Fact & Dimension Tables, SCD, Data Warehouse Design, Data Vault Modeling, and Enterprise Data Modeling. Experience creating Conceptual, Logical, and Physical Data Models using industry-standard methodologies. Hands-on experience with ER/Studio, Erwin Data Modeler, PowerDesigner, or similar data modeling tools. Strong knowledge of Azure Data Factory (ADF), Azure Databricks, Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS), and Data Lakehouse Architectures. Experience designing and optimizing ETL/ELT pipelines, data integration solutions, and data orchestration workflows. Proficiency in SQL and Python for data transformation, automation, and analytics. Experience integrating data using REST APIs and implementing scalable data ingestion frameworks.

jobs.title: Dean - School of Law
skills: Research publications in peer-reviewed UGC-recognized journals
jobs.description:
Position Overview

The Dean / Head of the School of Law will provide academic, administrative, and strategic leadership to the School of Law. The role involves ensuring high standards of legal education, faculty development, academic planning, research, student development, regulatory compliance, and institutional growth.

The Dean/Head will be responsible for maintaining the academic standards of the School in accordance with applicable UGC regulations, Bar Council of India (BCI) requirements, University Statutes/Ordinances, and other relevant regulatory frameworks.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide overall academic and administrative leadership to the School of Law.
  • Develop and implement the School's academic vision, strategic plans, and institutional objectives.
  • Lead curriculum planning, review, and development in accordance with UGC and BCI requirements.
  • Ensure effective delivery of undergraduate, postgraduate, and other law programmes.
  • Supervise and mentor faculty members and promote continuous academic development.
  • Coordinate faculty recruitment, workload allocation, performance evaluation, and development activities.
  • Promote high-quality research, publications, funded projects, conferences, seminars, and collaborations.
  • Encourage interdisciplinary research and collaboration with other schools/departments.
  • Ensure compliance with BCI, UGC, University, and other statutory/regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain academic records, reports, documentation, and regulatory submissions.
  • Monitor student academic performance, discipline, attendance, internships, moot court activities, legal aid initiatives, and placements.
  • Strengthen industry, legal-practice, judicial, corporate, and academic collaborations.
  • Promote moot courts, legal aid clinics, internships, seminars, workshops, guest lectures, and other experiential learning activities.
  • Represent the School of Law before university authorities, regulatory bodies, professional institutions, and external stakeholders.
  • Support accreditation, inspection, ranking, and institutional quality-assurance processes.
  • Facilitate faculty and student participation in national and international academic activities.
  • Ensure effective utilization of academic infrastructure, library resources, research facilities, and other institutional resources.
  • Perform any other academic or administrative responsibilities assigned by the Vice-Chancellor/competent authority.

Eligibility & Qualification

Essential Qualification

  • Ph.D. in Law from a recognized university/institution.
  • Master's degree in Law with the required academic credentials as prescribed for appointment as Professor of Law.
  • Must independently satisfy the applicable Professor eligibility requirements under the relevant UGC Regulations.
  • Minimum 10 years of teaching/research/academic experience as prescribed for Professor-level eligibility.
  • Minimum 10 research publications in peer-reviewed/UGC-recognized journals or as prescribed under applicable regulations.
  • Research Score of 120 or the applicable score prescribed under the prevailing UGC Regulations.
  • Must possess a strong academic and research profile in the field of Law.

BCI Requirement

  • The candidate must be qualified in Law.
  • The Head of the Centre/School of Legal Education must meet the qualifications prescribed by the Bar Council of India for holding the position of Professor of Law.
  • The candidate must satisfy all applicable BCI norms concerning faculty qualifications and academic administration.

Experience

  • Minimum 10 years of relevant academic/research experience, with eligibility for appointment as Professor of Law.
  • Preference may be given to candidates with experience in:
    • Heading a School/Department/Faculty of Law
    • Academic administration
    • University-level committees
    • BCI/UGC compliance
    • Accreditation and quality assurance
    • Research supervision
    • Institutional development
Key Competencies

  • Strong academic leadership and decision-making skills
  • Excellent knowledge of Legal Education regulations
  • Strong understanding of UGC and BCI norms
  • Academic planning and curriculum development
  • Research and publication leadership
  • Faculty mentoring and development
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Institutional coordination and stakeholder management
  • Strategic planning and problem-solving
  • Strong administrative and organizational capabilities

Basis of Appointment

The Dean/Head of School of Law is not ordinarily a separately recruited post under UGC Regulations. The position is generally assigned to a senior academic, typically the senior-most eligible Professor of the Faculty/School, through rotation or nomination by the Vice-Chancellor, in accordance with the University's Statutes/Ordinances.

Accordingly, the person designated as Dean/Head must independently satisfy the applicable eligibility requirements for Professor of Law, in addition to meeting the University's requirements for appointment/designation as Dean/Head.

Tenure: As prescribed by the University's Statutes/Ordinances, typically 2–3 years and renewable.

jobs.title: Operations Manager US Healthcare Services
jobs.description:
About Macro Outsourcing Private Limited

Macro Outsourcing Private Limited (MOPL) is a healthcare business process outsourcing firm supporting US physician practices and ambulatory surgery centers across the full operational stack — not billing alone.

Our service lines include revenue cycle management, provider credentialing and payer enrollment, payer contracting support, eligibility and benefits verification, patient scheduling and referral coordination, clinical support (pre-charting, prior authorization, fax and document management), chronic care and remote monitoring program operations, and compliance and documentation oversight.

We operate as an embedded extension of our clients practices. Our clients administrators and physicians deal with us directly, and our reputation rests on measurable performance and clean, defensible documentation.

The Role

We are hiring a senior Operations Manager to own multi-service delivery across client accounts. This is a broad, hands-on leadership role — you will not be running a single queue. You will be accountable for performance across billing, credentialing, front-office, and clinical support functions simultaneously, and for the quality of what our clients see.

We are specifically looking for someone who already uses AI tools in their daily operational work and can bring that capability to the team.

What You'll Own

Revenue cycle

  • AR inventory, aging prioritization, and escalation of high-dollar and timely-filing-risk claims
  • Denials run as a daily cohort discipline: what got paid, what will get paid, what was denied or written off, and the dollar value behind each
  • Documentation standards on every worked denial — reason, identifiers, action taken, outcome, amount recovered or adjusted
  • Root-cause feedback to the internal team, and avoidable-denial reporting back to the client when the cause sits at their front end

Credentialing and payer operations

  • Provider credentialing, re-attestation calendars, CAQH/PECOS/payer portal hygiene, and roster accuracy
  • Support for payer enrollment, facility credentialing, and contract and fee schedule analysis

Front office and clinical support

  • Eligibility and benefits verification accuracy, scheduling and referral conversion, and no-show/CNS performance
  • Clinical support workflows — pre-charting, prior authorization, referral intake, and document handling

Team and process

  • Daily productivity and quality standards across all functions, with worklog review, EOD consolidation, and one-on-one coaching
  • SOPs, training material, and standardization of what works across accounts rather than leaving it in one person's head
  • Client-facing reporting: collections, AR days, denial rate, first-pass resolution, credentialing status, and productivity by rep

AI-enabled operations

  • Use AI tools to compress manual work — document and EOB extraction, denial classification, reconciliation, SOP drafting, QA sampling, and reporting
  • Write and maintain reusable prompts and workflows the team can run consistently
  • Apply judgment about where AI output must be verified before it touches a claim, a chart, or a client deliverable, and enforce PHI-safe usage
What You Bring

Required

  • 8+ years in US healthcare operations, with at least 4 years managing teams across more than one function
  • Depth in revenue cycle — AR follow-up, denial and appeal workflows, EOB/ERA interpretation, CPT/ICD-10 fundamentals, and payer-specific behavior
  • Working exposure to at least two of: credentialing and payer enrollment, contracting and fee schedules, eligibility verification, scheduling and referral management, or clinical support workflows
  • Experience with US commercial payers, Medicare, and Medicaid
  • Demonstrated practical use of AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, or equivalent) in operational work — you should be able to describe specific workflows you have built or improved with them
  • Practice management and EHR platform fluency
  • Advanced Excel — pivots, lookups, building and maintaining trackers and reporting workbooks
  • Clear written and spoken English; able to hold a call with a US physician or practice administrator without a script
  • Availability to work US business hours

Preferred

  • Gastroenterology, ASC, or surgical specialty experience
  • Experience supporting a practice through an ASC or new service line launch
  • Chronic care management or remote patient monitoring program operations
  • Automation and reporting tooling — Power Query, SQL, Python, or workflow automation platforms
  • Working knowledge of HIPAA safeguards and PHI handling in an offshore delivery setting
What Success Looks Like at 90 Days
  • You know each assigned account's AR, credentialing, and front-office profile by memory, not by report
  • Denial cohorts close daily with complete documentation, and at least one recurring denial cause has been eliminated at the source
  • Credentialing and re-attestation dates are current with no surprises
  • At least one manual workflow has been meaningfully reduced using AI tooling, with verification steps built in
  • Your team's productivity numbers are trustworthy without you reconstructing them
What We Offer
  • Compensation — commensurate with experience
  • Genuine latitude to adopt new tooling — process improvements here get implemented, not filed
To Apply

Send your CV to [HIDDEN TEXT] with the subject line Operations Manager — New Delhi. Please include a short note covering the functions you have managed beyond billing, and one specific example of an operational workflow you have improved using AI tools.

Macro Outsourcing Private Limited is an equal opportunity employer.
