LifeStyles has a history dating back to 1905 when Eric Ansell first started making condoms in Richmond Australia.

Today LifeStyles is a Global leader in the sexual wellness sector, comprising a broad range of condoms, personal lubricants, and other related products and other products in over 60 countries.

The LifeStyles family of brands includes the #1 global non-latex condom brand, SKYN®, Owning a large portfolio of trademarks, LifeStyles manufactures and commercialises its products, under its local heroes such as Mates®, LifeStyles®, Manix®, Unimil®, and Blowtex® and Control. LifeStyles Healthcare was created on September 1, 2017, when the consortium of Humanwell Healthcare & CITIC Capital private equity purchased the Sexual Wellness division from Ansell.

This is an exciting time to join us. We combine century-long history with the opportunity of a new beginning as a stand-alone company - this means a new way of thinking, the opportunity to explore new horizons and the chance to make a mark in an exciting, fresh business.

jobs.title: Associate / Senior Associate, India (Shillong)
jobs.description:
Associate / Senior Associate

About IDinsight

IDinsight is a mission-driven global advisory, data analytics, and research organisation that helps global development leaders maximise their social impact. We tailor a wide range of data and evidence tools to help decision-makers design effective programs and rigorously test what works to support communities. We work with governments, multilateral agencies, foundations, and innovative non-profit organizations in Asia and Africa. Our work spans various sectors, including agriculture, education, health, governance, sanitation, financial inclusion, and others.

We are a team of economists, statisticians, data scientists, data engineers, and data collection experts. Our goal as an organisation is to make sure that data and evidence are used for making decisions -- this is why we invest a lot of time and energy in understanding the institutional constraints within which our partners operate and what decisions they need to take, so that we can focus on generating only that data which is genuinely required to help inform decisions.

IDinsight is committed to non-discrimination in our recruitment, employment practices, and organisational culture, regardless of people's age, disability, gender, gender identity, national origin, race, religion or belief, or sexual orientation, or any other status protected by applicable law.

Our diverse, growing team of roughly 200 outstanding colleagues operates in nearly two dozen countries worldwide. Learn more about our mission and values at www.IDinsight.org.

About our governance portfolio in India

In India, we have worked with several union and state government organisations over the past 13 years. We are currently the M&E partner for Mission Karmayogi, working closely with both the Capacity Building Commission and the Karmayogi Bharat, and have previously worked with NITI Aayog on the Aspirational Districts Program and the National Data Analytics Platform. We also have active engagements with the Planning Departments in different states. In Telangana, we conducted the annual KPI survey for the government, as part of which we have built a representative panel for 50,000 households and used that panel to collect data on health, nutrition, and learning outcomes. In Uttar Pradesh, we are supporting the Planning Department to generate high-frequency estimates of economic activity as well as supporting capacity building efforts in the department. We have supported state governments in similar ways in Punjab, Bihar, Odisha, Delhi and Andhra Pradesh.

About our Associate / Senior Associate Position

We are looking for an Associate / Senior Associate with a proven track record of working with Indian governments. The ideal candidate will bring expertise in public policy, governance reforms, and stakeholder relationship management. In addition, the ideal candidate will have sectoral expertise in health, nutrition or rural development. This role requires the candidate to be based in Shillong, Meghalaya as they will engage extensively with government stakeholders in an embedded manner.

The individual will support a project to help government organisations implement a goal-oriented HR management (GOHRM) approach in priority areas of health, nutrition and rural development. This approach is expected to enable the organisation to link its goals with individual capacity and performance, bringing observability to what each individual needs to do and is able to do. Thus, decision-makers at different levels will be able to effectively identify problems in service delivery and provide targeted support to improve capacity and performance.

More information about this approach is documented here. Given the nature of the GO-HRM initiative, experience in workforce planning, HR process strengthening or performance management in government settings will be a strong advantage. Familiarity with the Meghalaya's administrative context and on ground delivery systems will be desirable.

Key Responsibilities

Managing project team workflow, systems, and deliverables

  • Driving the day-to-day execution of the GO-HRM project in Meghalaya, according to project plans and leading internal coordination efforts for their team; big picture thinking about the project, our impact and higher-level implications of our work
  • Support in the implementation of key GO-HRM activities such as understanding what officials do in their day-to-day roles, assessing their capacity and training needs, helping develop digital data systems and coordinating consultations with departments
  • Update project teams regularly on project progress, key outcomes, and insights to ensure alignment with project priorities
  • Creating client deliverables, including reports, slide decks, and oral presentations that clearly communicates GO-HRM findings and recommendations
  • Use a broad set of data and evidence tools to identify gaps, bottlenecks and support decision making for government partners
  • Developing strategic communications to build awareness of the GO-HRM approach and IDinsight projects and learnings, contribute to sectoral knowledge, and shift the sector towards more evidence-informed policy and practices

Client relationships

  • Work closely with government of Meghalaya officials every day in an embedded manner to support the roll-out of GO-HRM across departments
  • Preparing talking points and presentations for government meetings related to GO-HRM
  • Serve as an important team contact for government officials, building and maintaining strong, trust-based relationships with nodal officers, departmental leaders and field functionaries
  • Coordinate with multiple government departments to ensure smooth implementation and cross-departmental alignment

Organisation building

  • Developing, piloting, and implementing internal systems or other organisational contributions (e.g., event management) for IDinsight, in coordination with functional teams such as Operations, Communications, Finance, etc.
  • Contributing to office life and culture building in Shillong. This can include facilitating All Hands Meetings; leading team building efforts at team retreats; participating in and organizing Social Cultural Committee events.
  • Support organisational knowledge-building by documenting GO-HRM learnings, tools, and implementation processes.

The role is not a typical 9-5 job and can require early mornings and late nights to accommodate client requirements, the time zone differences of a dispersed team, and busy periods within project workflows. IDinsight encourages balance with flexible work hours and wellness benefits, including comprehensive mental health care support and organisation-wide wellness days off. Many find this balance to yield rich professional and personal rewards and, therefore, progress to more senior roles with IDinsight.

Qualifications

  • 2-5 years of relevant work experience, including working with Indian government departments
  • Ability to navigate complex government structures and build trusted relationships with government officials
  • Sectoral experience in health, nutrition, and rural development
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate across multiple departments or government programmes
  • Experience or strong interest in public sector HR processes, workforce planning, or performance management
  • Strong writing skills with the ability to translate technical jargon into well-structured, writing-based deliverables (e.g., policy briefs, project memos, analytical reports, external blog posts, and more)
  • Ability to understand complex concepts and topics quickly even with limited prior knowledge or exposure and a willingness to invest in learning new concepts, skills, and methods without being prompted
  • Strong analytical skills, with exposure to (either via professional work experience or academic coursework) the basics of econometrics, data, and research analysis tools, and quantitative and qualitative research processes or an ability to quickly understand these topics
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, can effectively engage with stakeholders ranging from school children to senior government officials to internal colleagues, and places a high value on being a team player
  • Highly organised, attentive to deadlines, and able to efficiently manage a high volume of work. Past experience in independently managing multiple workstreams is desirable.
  • Demonstrated ability to be a self-starter and fast learner; resourceful and resilient in the face of challenges
  • Comfort operating in an evolving, fast-paced environment where priorities may shift based on government needs
  • Intellectually curious and a willingness to share your opinions with the team, question the status quo, and encourage others to expand their perspectives
  • Embodies our organizational values and demonstrates a steadfast commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion in their daily interactions
  • Deep passion to improve lives around the world
  • Familiarity with Meghalaya's administrative and socio-cultural context as well as working proficiency in commonly spoken languages in Meghalaya like Khasi and/or Garo

Nuts & bolts

Location

Shillong, Meghalaya

Start Date

There is a preference for candidates who can start immediately.

Compensation

Compensation and benefits are commensurate with the qualifications and experiences IDinsight is hiring for. We are especially proud of the people-focused benefits we offer, including comprehensive international health insurance with mental health coverage, paid vacation, sick leave, parental leave, relocation benefits, a travel stipend, technology and work-from-home stipends, a professional development budget, and more.

Specialist Pharmacist – Hospital at Home

NHS Borders is seeking a Specialist Pharmacist – Hospital at Home to lead and deliver a high-quality, safe and person-centred clinical pharmacy service within our Hospital at Home (H@H) team. Working as part of a supportive multidisciplinary team, you will help patients receive hospital-level care in their own home and support safe, effective and cost-effective use of medicines across care settings.

Key responsibilities

  • Provide specialist pharmaceutical advice and medicines optimisation for patients supported by the Hospital at Home service.
  • Undertake pharmacist-led medication reviews and patient consultations (in person, by telephone and/or by video), including polypharmacy reviews.
  • Practise as an independent prescriber (or be willing to undertake prescribing training) to manage a defined patient caseload.
  • Work collaboratively with the multidisciplinary team to improve medicines safety, support safe transfer of care and reduce avoidable admissions/readmissions.
  • Contribute to service development, including medicines-related policies, pathways and governance (e.g. audit, incident learning, antimicrobial stewardship).
  • Support education, training and supervision of colleagues and learners, contributing to the wider pharmacy service.

What we offer

A varied and rewarding specialist role within an innovative community-facing service, with opportunities to contribute to service development, quality improvement and prescribing practice, supported by a collaborative pharmacy and multidisciplinary team.

About The Service

The Pharmacy Department provides secondary care services from Borders General Hospital and delivers primary care services across a range of settings, including GP practices, care homes and patients homes. The Hospital at Home team supports people to transition safely between hospital and home by monitoring treatment and delivering care in the community.

Hospital at Home (H@H) provides hospital-level assessment and treatment in a patient's own home when it is clinically appropriate to do so. The service supports people who would otherwise need admission, or who can be discharged earlier with enhanced support, delivering interventions such as clinical monitoring, symptom management, and administration of medicines (including complex regimens) with clear plans for escalation and follow-up. Care is coordinated across primary, secondary and community services, with a focus on improving patient experience, maintaining independence, and reducing risks associated with hospital stays.

NHS Greater Glasgow and Clyde (NHSGGC) is one of the largest healthcare systems in the United Kingdom, employing approximately 40,000 staff across a wide range of clinical and non-clinical professions and roles. We deliver acute hospital, primary, community and mental health services to a population of over 1.15 million people, and to a wider population of 2.2 million when regional and national services are included.

The Role

An exciting opportunity has arisen for an enthusiastic and motivated Health Visitor to join our Renfrewshire HSCP Children and Families Teams. The post will be based in Paisley. Various days and hours available within the Monday to Friday period. We are fully committed to the key ambition and aims of Getting It Right for Every Child (GIRFEC), to provide children and young people with the best possible start in life. We are passionate around supporting our team members with ongoing opportunities for continued learning and development.

We are fully committed to the key ambition and aims of Getting It Right for Every Child (GIRFEC), to provide children and young people with the best possible start in life. Working as a Health Visitor within the Children and Families Health Visiting team you will provide a high quality, safe, and effective health visiting service in the community, working in collaboration with partner agencies. You will have overall responsibility for the supervision/management of a health visiting caseload, being accountable for the quality of care delivered through robust assessment, referral and communication processes and implementation of evidence-based practice interventions to address need. You should have in-depth knowledge, expertise, proficiency and experience in health visiting, child protection and the GIRFEC/National practice model Framework. Renfrewshire HSCP provides team members with ongoing opportunities for continued learning and development.

It is essential that you are currently a Registered Nurse with the Nursing and Midwifery Council (NMC) and you have a post registration qualification in Health Visiting/Public Health Nursing, and registered on Part 3 of the NMC register.

  • Permanent Contract

  • Various days and hours available within the Monday to Friday period

Key Responsibilities

  • To undertake statutory duties on behalf of NHS Greater Glasgow & Clyde with respect to individual children within your caseload to assess, improve and support the wellbeing of children.
  • To work with all professionals involved with the child or young person and their families to assess, analyse, develop and agree a multiagency child's plan based on the agreed policies and procedures. Implement and monitor the plan to endeavour to ensure the child's needs are met and desired outcomes achieved.
  • To work in partnership with individual children's families, working with other agencies and key stakeholders to ensure that all parties undertake their responsibilities within the agreed plan.

The HV will play a key interagency role in family assessment, planning and delivery of Child Protection services. The HV will participate in regular supervision of child protection cases and work within the child protection policies and guidelines.
  • The HV will be responsible for making professional judgments and decisions about the sharing of information about each child and family. This will require a complex analysis of the level of risk to a child; the reason information needs shared, the conditions for processing under Data Protection law, GDPR and the conditions for sharing in relation to confidentiality law, and the conditions for sharing in relation to human rights (family privacy) law. The HV will follow law and guidance, but will use conservable professional judgment to reach decisions to share or not share information.
  • The HV will deliver the universal pathway to all children on the caseload, to ensure that their health and wellbeing needs are assessed. This will include being responsible for delivery of a suite of developmental and wellbeing assessments, and being highly skilled in the use of validated tools, using a strengths based and empowering approach to the therapeutic relationship working in partnership with families. The HV requires to be an expert in the assessment and analysis of these tool results to ensure that referral to other services is made in a timely fashion to ensure that each child's needs are met.

  • Registered nurse or midwife at degree level or equivalent
  • Post-registration qualification in Health Visiting/Public Health Nursing and be registered on Part 3 of the NMC register
  • Experience of caseload management and planning to meet deadlines
  • Experience of using a strength based approach working in partnership with families
  • Able to use a number of assessment tools used to decide referral pathways

  • Educated to Masters level in a relevant nursing area, or
  • Can demonstrate an equivalent level of knowledge gained through, for example, completion of NES modules on Assessment, Leadership, and Critical Thinking.
  • Can provide advice using significant understanding and application of legislation relating to information sharing, data storage and public protection
  • Knowledge of health and social care pathways related to safeguarding, early intervention and protection
  • Please refer to the job description for further details.

jobs.title: Patient Advocate
jobs.description:
Here at Harris, we have 5 different business verticals, Public Sector, Healthcare, Utilities, Insurance and Private sector, with over 12,000 employees and more than 100,000 customers located in 200 countries around the globe. We need your help to keep growing and we hope you can become an integral part of the Harris family.

Job Description-Patient Advocate (US Healthcare RCM)

Business Unit: Benchmark Solutions

Position Summary

The Patient Advocate serves as a key liaison between patients, healthcare providers, insurance payers, and internal Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) teams. This role is responsible for assisting patients with questions related to medical billing, insurance claims, account balances, payment responsibilities, and claim status while delivering exceptional customer service.

The ideal candidate will have experience supporting U.S. healthcare organizations and possess a solid understanding of the American healthcare system, medical billing, insurance processes, and revenue cycle workflows. Because this role involves direct interaction with U.S. patients, candidates must demonstrate exceptional verbal communication skills with clear, fluent, and professional English-speaking abilities.

Work Mode: Remote

Shift: (Night Shift)

Location: Mumbai(Vikhroli)

Key Responsibilities

Patient Support & Communication

  • Manage inbound and outbound patient communications regarding medical bills, insurance claims, account balances, payments, and reimbursement inquiries.
  • Educate patients on insurance benefits, deductibles, co-pays, co-insurance, and out-of-pocket responsibilities.
  • Provide clear and professional explanations of account activity and available resolution options.
  • Maintain a compassionate, patient-focused approach when handling sensitive financial discussions.
  • Return patient calls and emails within established service-level agreements (SLAs).

Revenue Cycle & Claim Support

  • Research and resolve patient billing and balance concerns by reviewing account notes, claim status, payment postings, and payer communications.
  • Collaborate with Accounts Receivable (AR), Billing, Coding, and Account Management teams to address complex patient issues.
  • Assist with claim follow-up activities, including reviewing claim status and identifying barriers to reimbursement.
  • Support appeals, reconsiderations, and patient correspondence as directed.

Documentation & Account Maintenance

  • Accurately document all patient interactions, account activity, and resolution efforts within Benchmark and other designated systems.
  • Maintain detailed records of patient inquiries, follow-up activities, and account updates.
  • Ensure all account documentation meets company standards for quality, accuracy, and compliance.

Daily & Weekly Responsibilities

  • Monitor patient phone queues and service channels throughout assigned shifts.
  • Respond to patient inquiries and complete follow-up activities within established timelines.
  • Process assigned printing and mailing requests accurately and efficiently.
  • Review outstanding patient issues and coordinate with AR and operational teams for timely resolution.
  • Participate in team meetings, quality reviews, and training sessions.
  • Identify trends in patient inquiries and communicate opportunities for process improvement.

Compliance & Regulatory Requirements

  • Maintain adherence to HIPAA regulations and patient privacy requirements.
  • Follow all U.S. healthcare compliance standards, payer guidelines, and company policies.
  • Maintain awareness of balance billing regulations, patient financial assistance programs, and healthcare reimbursement practices.
  • Complete all required compliance, security, and customer service training programs.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Accounts Receivable, Billing, Coding, Credentialing, and Account Management teams to resolve patient concerns.
  • Escalate payer, coding, or reimbursement issues to appropriate departments when necessary.
  • Support organizational goals related to patient experience, revenue cycle performance, and operational excellence.

Required Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent healthcare revenue cycle experience
  • 3+ years of experience in U.S. healthcare Revenue Cycle Management (RCM), medical billing, accounts receivable, patient services, or related healthcare operations.
  • Experience supporting U.S. healthcare providers, physician groups, hospitals, or healthcare outsourcing organizations preferred.
  • Experience handling patient billing inquiries and insurance-related issues.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with U.S.-based healthcare clients from an offshore delivery center.
  • Familiarity with healthcare practice management systems, EMRs/EHRs, and RCM platforms.
  • Knowledge of denial management, appeals processes, and payer follow-up methodologies.
  • Previous experience in a patient advocacy, customer service, or healthcare call center environment supporting U.S. healthcare operations.

Knowledge & Skills

  • Strong understanding of U.S. healthcare revenue cycle workflows, including:
    • Patient registration and eligibility verification
    • Insurance verification and benefits review
    • Medical billing and claim submission
    • Payment posting and reconciliation
    • Accounts receivable follow-up
    • Denials and appeals management
    • Patient collections and financial responsibility
  • Working knowledge of commercial insurance, Medicare, Medicaid, and managed care plans.
  • Familiarity with medical terminology, CPT, ICD-10, and HCPCS concepts preferred.
  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and customer service skills.
  • Ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities.
Performance Expectations & Key Metrics

  • Deliver professional, empathetic, and patient-centered service.
  • Meet established productivity and quality standards.
  • Maintain accurate account documentation and patient records.
  • Achieve expected call handling, response time, and follow-up metrics.
  • Ensure timely completion of assigned claim, mailing, and patient support activities.
  • Demonstrate strong issue resolution and patient satisfaction outcomes.

Benefits

  • Annual Public Holidays as applicable
  • 30 days total leave per calendar year
  • Mediclaim policy
  • Lifestyle Rewards Program
  • Group Term Life Insurance
  • Gratuity
  • ...and more!

jobs.title: Solar PMC Team Leader
jobs.description:
Company Description

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world.

We believe infrastructure creates opportunity for everyone. Whether it's improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive.

Our clients trust us to bring together the best people, ideas, technical expertise and digital solutions to our work in transportation, buildings, water, the environment and new energy. We're one global team – 47,000 strong – driven by a common purpose to deliver a better world.

Job Description

Job Summary

AECOM is seeking an experienced Solar Site Team Leader to lead the day-to-day Project Management Consultant (PMC) oversight of utility-scale solar EPC package execution. The role serves as the single package-level coordination and integration point for progress, risk, quality, health and safety, commissioning, testing, and HOTO (Hand Over Take Over) readiness activities.

The Solar Site Team Leader is responsible for coordinating multidisciplinary PMC resources, monitoring contractor performance, consolidating site observations into actionable recommendations, and ensuring timely resolution of project constraints to support successful project delivery and commercial operation.

Key Responsibilities

Site Delivery Oversight
  • Lead and coordinate day-to-day PMC activities across solar construction clusters and project work fronts.
  • Manage deployment priorities and resource allocation for PMC discipline engineers and cluster construction managers.
  • Monitor EPC contractor performance against approved schedules, quality standards, safety requirements, and contractual obligations.
  • Support achievement of project milestones and Commercial Operation Date (COD) targets.

Progress Monitoring & Performance Management
  • Review EPC workfront readiness, resource deployment plans, construction sequencing strategies, and productivity performance.
  • Assess schedule progress and identify risks, constraints, and recovery opportunities.
  • Monitor implementation of contractor recovery plans and corrective actions.
  • Validate package-level status updates prior to submission to the Solar Lead and Programme Controls team.

Risk & Constraint Management
  • Identify, assess, and monitor critical package risks, constraints, and interface challenges.

jobs.description:
Here at Harris, we have 5 different business verticals, Public Sector, Healthcare, Utilities, Insurance and Private sector, with over 12,000 employees and more than 100,000 customers located in 200 countries around the globe. We need your help to keep growing and we hope you can become an integral part of the Harris family.

Business Unit: Benchmark Solutions

Work Mode: Remote

Shift Timings: 6.30pm to 3.30am (Night Shift)

Position Summary

Benchmark Solutions is seeking an experienced Account Manager with expertise in U.S. Healthcare Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) to serve as the primary point of contact for assigned provider clients while driving revenue cycle performance and financial outcomes.

This position combines client relationship management with active oversight of assigned accounts receivable performance, operational workflows, and client satisfaction. The Account Manager serves as a trusted advisor to physician practices and healthcare organizations by monitoring key performance indicators, identifying opportunities for improvement, coordinating operational efforts, and ensuring client goals are achieved.

The ideal candidate will possess extensive knowledge of physician practice revenue cycle operations, payer reimbursement methodologies, accounts receivable management, denials management, and healthcare billing processes. Because this role involves direct interaction with U.S.-based healthcare providers and practice leadership, candidates must demonstrate exceptional verbal and written English communication skills.

Performance Expectations

The Successful Candidate Will

  • Support achievement of client A/R reduction goals.
  • Assist in reducing denials and improving collection performance.
  • Ensure timely resolution of client concerns and operational issues.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of client discussions and action plans.
  • Drive measurable improvements in reimbursement outcomes and operational effectiveness.

Core Responsibilities

Client Relationship Management

  • Identify root causes of denials, payment variances, and A/R delays and coordinate corrective action plans.
  • Escalate reimbursement concerns and collaborate with operational teams to drive resolution.

  • Coordinate resolution of escalated payer issues, denials, appeals, reimbursement challenges, and high-priority client concerns.

jobs.title: CS&D Senior Principal Engineer - Systems - CTI MD Tech (LRL)
jobs.description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it's work worth doing. If you're driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.

LRL takes potential marketable products from Research through product registration and approval, enabling MDU's business needs of the future through information and technology solutions. Within this portfolio, Clinical Supply & Delivery (CS&D) owns the systems and platforms that move investigational drug product — from packaging and labeling through distribution and fulfillment — to clinical trial sites, reliably, compliantly, and on time for trial execution. The CS&D Senior Principal Engineer - Systems is a senior individual contributor who owns hands-on technical delivery for these platforms — designing, building, and directly implementing integration patterns, data pipelines, and platform components that translate portfolio direction and roadmap decisions into production systems.

Path/Level: R4 (CS&D Senior Principal Engineer - Systems)

This role is structured as roughly 75% hands-on technical execution — architecting and directly implementing platform components, data pipelines, and integrations — and 25% technical leadership, mentorship, and design guidance for R2/R3 engineers. This is a senior individual-contributor position: candidates should bring sustained, current hands-on engineering depth alongside strong architectural judgment, and should expect to remain an active technical contributor throughout the role.

Key Responsibilities

Hands-On Engineering & Implementation (75%)

  • Platform Build & Implementation — design, build, and directly implement production components for CS&D's clinical supply chain systems — integration layers, data pipelines, APIs/microservices, and cloud infrastructure — including critical or complex components, in close collaboration with R2/R3 engineers.
  • Data Platform Engineering — build and maintain cloud-native data warehousing, ETL/ELT, and data lake/lakehouse solutions across AWS and Databricks/Delta Lake; make and implement database architecture decisions — relational vs. NoSQL vs. NewSQL selection, schema design, partitioning/sharding, indexing, and performance tuning.
  • Integration & API Engineering — build API and microservices integration patterns for data access and cross-system integration; implement monitoring, alerting, and observability for data pipelines; diagnose and resolve pipeline failures and performance bottlenecks.
  • AI/Agentic System Build — design and build agentic workflows, LLM integration and orchestration, RAG and vector-store implementations, and AI governance/guardrails; develop and validate proofs-of-concept ahead of production adoption.
  • Governance, Risk & GxP/GCP Compliance Implementation — implement audit-readiness, security, and change-control practices in code and infrastructure; produce architecture documentation supporting audit, inspection, and CSV readiness.
  • Business & Product Partnership — partner with architects, product managers, and business stakeholders to translate business goals into technical solutions; validate technical feasibility through hands-on spikes and prototypes.

Technical Leadership & Architecture Guidance (25%)


  • Architecture Direction — provide design direction and integration patterns for R2/R3 engineering teams, informed by direct, current experience building comparable systems.
  • Code & Design Reviews / Mentorship — conduct code and architecture reviews; mentor engineers through pairing, technical guidance, and shared problem-solving; champion engineering excellence and consistent design standards.
  • Decision-Making (Implementation-Scoped) — hold design and integration decision authority for the systems owned; approve implementation-level architecture and integration patterns used by R2/R3 teams; escalate — rather than unilaterally resolve — platform-architecture, investment-level, or cross-portfolio risks to CS&D architecture leadership.
  • India-Based Technical Leadership — represent CS&D engineering in relevant technical forums; build shared ownership and accountability between the India team and global stakeholders; strengthen India's role as a technical design and engineering center for the platforms owned.
  • Talent Development — contribute to hiring and technical talent planning for the engineering teams, including evaluation of candidates technical depth.

Technical & Strategic Expertise Areas


Cloud-Native Data Platform Architecture (AWS: S3, Redshift, RDS/Aurora, DynamoDB, Glue, DMS, Lambda, EMR, Athena, API Gateway, Step Functions, EventBridge, CloudFormation, CDK, IAM, VPC, CloudWatch)

  • Data Lake / Data Warehouse / Lakehouse Design
  • Databricks / Delta Lake
  • Database Architecture & Design (relational and NoSQL, indexing, partitioning/sharding strategy)
  • Agentic/AI System Design & Build (LLM orchestration frameworks, RAG, vector databases, LLMOps and AI observability)
  • Enterprise Architecture Frameworks (TOGAF, ArchiMate, C4 model)
  • CI/CD & DevOps (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins)
  • Infrastructure as Code (CloudFormation, Terraform, CDK)
  • API & Microservices Design
  • SQL & Dimensional Data Modelling (Redshift, Oracle, SQL Server)
  • Monitoring, Alerting & Observability
  • Streaming Platforms (Kafka, Confluent, AWS MSK)
  • Security & Compliance Architecture (GxP, GCP, CSV)
  • Cost Optimization (FinOps) & Disaster Recovery/Business Continuity Design
  • Front-End & Back-End Development

Basic Qualifications


  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 12+ years of hands-on experience in data engineering, data architecture, or enterprise data platform roles, with a sustained, current track record of designing and implementing production systems.
  • Strong AWS expertise with hands-on experience across: Data Storage & Warehousing (S3, Redshift, RDS/Aurora, DynamoDB); Data Processing & Integration (Glue, DMS, Lambda, EMR, Athena); API & Orchestration (API Gateway, Step Functions, EventBridge); Infrastructure (CloudFormation, CDK, IAM, VPC, CloudWatch).
  • Strong SQL and data modelling expertise (dimensional modelling, star/snowflake schemas) across Redshift, Oracle, and SQL Server platforms.
  • Strong experience with CI/CD pipelines for data platforms (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins) and Infrastructure as Code (CloudFormation, Terraform, or CDK).
  • Current, hands-on coding proficiency across front-end, back-end, and AWS cloud development, with the ability to build, debug, and deliver production systems directly.
  • Ability to speak in specific, concrete detail about systems designed, technical trade-offs made, and outcomes delivered.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and lead technical discussions through hands-on pairing and code review, without requiring a formal people-manager structure.

Additional Qualifications / Competencies


  • Experience in regulated industries (healthcare/pharma, finance, government) with compliance requirements.
  • Experience with clinical data, life sciences, or statistical computing domains.
  • Hands-on experience designing and building AI/agentic systems personally — including LLM orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, AutoGen, or similar), vector database and RAG architecture, and MLOps/LLMOps pipelines using AWS services such as SageMaker.
  • Familiarity with data governance and metadata management frameworks.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity, translating architecture-level decisions into working systems under evolving requirements.
  • A portfolio of shipped technical work, relevant open-source contributions, or verifiable examples of production systems delivered end-to-end is a plus.

jobs.title: Data Scientist f Submission Data and Content Generation & Reuse (AIDCG) - Pharma R&D
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Job Description
The Lead IT Data Scientist is responsible for architecting, leading, and delivering advanced AI and data science solutions that address complex business and scientific challenges within Pharma R&D. This role serves as a technical leader, guiding the design, development, deployment, and governance of enterprise-scale AI/ML systems while mentoring junior data scientists and driving innovation across the organization.

Operating in a highly regulated GxP environment, you will lead the development of next-generation AI-powered platforms and specialized autonomous agents supporting Analytical Data Scientists across the clinical data lifecycle. The role requires deep expertise in Generative AI, Agentic AI frameworks, multi-agent orchestration, Graph-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG), Large Language Model Operations (LLMOps), and AI platform engineering. You will define technical strategy, establish best practices, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure scalable, compliant, and business-aligned AI solutions.

Description Of The Area
The Clinical Submission Data and Content Generation & Reuse function focuses on transforming the creation, management, and reuse of clinical data and regulatory submission content through advanced digital capabilities and AI-driven automation. The organization develops structured content management platforms, reusable data and content assets, and intelligent agent ecosystems that support clinical submissions, regulatory compliance, and scientific communication.

The team is at the forefront of leveraging Generative AI, Agentic Workflows, Knowledge Graphs, and advanced analytics to improve quality, accelerate submission timelines, and enable data-driven decision-making across the clinical and regulatory landscape.

Job Responsibilities
  • Scope / Content Leadership
  • Lead the architecture, development, and deployment of enterprise-grade AI/ML solutions and agentic systems
  • Drive multiple strategic data science initiatives simultaneously, ensuring alignment with business priorities
  • Define technical standards, reusable frameworks, and best practices for AI and machine learning development
  • Design and implement enterprise-wide data science frameworks, governance models, and best practices to ensure consistency, scalability, and operational excellence across AI initiatives
  • Mentor and guide data scientists, fostering technical excellence and innovation across the team
  • Lead complex data science projects end-to-end, from problem definition and solution design through deployment, adoption, and measurable business impact
  • Accountability / Problem Solving
  • Solve highly complex and ambiguous business problems using advanced statistical modeling, machine learning, and generative AI techniques
  • Design and implement sophisticated multi-agent workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph and AWS AgentCore
  • Lead development of intelligent automation solutions including autonomous code reviewers, clinical workflow copilots, AI-driven debugging assistants, and submission content generation agents
  • Drive model validation, monitoring, explainability, and AI governance practices in regulated environments
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Partner with senior business leaders, clinical experts, statisticians, and technology teams to identify strategic opportunities for AI adoption
  • Translate complex analytical concepts into actionable business insights for executive and non-technical audiences
  • Influence key stakeholders on AI strategy, roadmap prioritization, and solution adoption
  • Work closely with senior leadership to inform, shape, and influence strategic business decisions through data-driven insights, advanced analytics, and AI-enabled recommendations
  • Impact / Strategy
  • Define and execute the technical roadmap for advanced analytics, Generative AI, and agentic AI capabilities within the function
  • Lead high-impact projects that directly influence organizational objectives, innovation initiatives, and operational efficiency
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend scalable solutions that advance business transformation
  • Complexity / Product Size
  • Work with large-scale clinical, regulatory, and enterprise datasets across structured and unstructured formats
  • Design scalable AI architectures supporting production-grade solutions with high reliability and compliance requirements
  • Drive optimization of existing models and establish frameworks for continuous improvement and performance monitoring
  • Business / Technical Ability
  • Demonstrate deep expertise across multiple AI/ML domains including predictive modeling, NLP, knowledge graphs, GraphRAG, and agent-based systems
  • Apply strong software engineering principles to develop secure, scalable, and maintainable AI products
  • Lead technical decision-making related to model architecture, framework selection, cloud infrastructure, and deployment strategies

Qualifications
Education / Experience


  • Master's or PhD in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Artificial Intelligence, Bioinformatics, Mathematics, or related quantitative discipline
  • 8-12 years of experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Advanced Analytics, or similar domains
  • Proven experience leading end-to-end AI/ML initiatives from ideation through production deployment and business adoption
  • Extensive experience leading complex data science projects from end-to-end and delivering significant, measurable business impact
  • Demonstrated success in delivering enterprise-scale solutions that influence strategic business outcomes
  • Proven track record of partnering with senior executives and business leaders to drive data-informed strategic decision-making
  • Experience mentoring data scientists and providing technical leadership across cross-functional teams
  • Experience working within regulated environments such as Pharmaceutical, Healthcare, Life Sciences, or other compliance-driven industries is preferred

Technical Skills
Programming & Data Engineering


  • Expert-level proficiency in Python for AI/ML development, agent orchestration, backend services, and automation solutions
  • Strong hands-on expertise in R for clinical statistical programming, NextGen programming frameworks (e.g., Admiral), and analysis workflows
  • Working knowledge of SAS and clinical programming standards is desirable
  • Strong understanding of software engineering concepts, APIs, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, GitOps, and testing frameworks

Generative AI & Agentic Systems

  • Deep expertise in Large Language Models (LLMs), Prompt Engineering, Fine-tuning, Agentic AI, and AI application architecture
  • Extensive experience with LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AWS AgentCore, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, and Model Context Protocol (MCP)
  • Proven experience designing multi-agent architectures, autonomous workflows, reasoning systems, and human-in-the-loop AI solutions
  • Strong understanding of AI safety, governance, observability, evaluation frameworks, and responsible AI practices

RAG, Knowledge Graphs & Search

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Job Title: Regional Medical Expert (RME), Neurology

Reporting & Function

  • Function: Medical
  • Reporting Line: Reports to the Medical Chapter Lead
  • Location: Delhi/Mumbai & Bangalore/Chennai
  • (Dedicated in-field, 60-70% travel time)

The Opportunity

The Regional Medical Expert is a trusted, externally focused, scientifically grounded partner within our customer engagement model. By building and maintaining deep and trusted connections with key customers over a meaningful period of time, you will generate impact by anticipating and proactively optimizing medical practice, ensuring that Roche is a preferred partner in neurology. Your role is designed to maximize medical and scientific activities to accelerate the delivery of our pipeline, differentiate our portfolio based on data, and drive strategic advocacy, community engagement, and access to our neurology portfolio.

As the Regional Medical Expert (Neurology), you are responsible for:-

  • Contributing with Medical Expertise
  • Medical Expertise: Proactively contribute strong scientific, medical, and therapeutic area expertise within neurology to inform the differentiation of our pipeline and portfolio
  • Shape Strategy: Lead the medical part of the integrated strategy, shape a scientifically sound and differentiated value story locally, and reflect an end-to-end business perspective that pulls through the strategy with impact
  • Proactive Customer Engagement & Insights
  • Proactive Targeted Medical Engagement: Execute an HCP and account engagement plan aligned with cluster and pan-India medical strategy. Spend the majority of your time proactively engaging with external customers, KOLs, and other key stakeholders as partners in full strategic and operational alignment with other in-field roles
  • Medical Partnership & Education: Build peer-to-peer scientific relationships with HCPs, KOLs, and relevant neurology specialists. Provide current, high-quality Medical Education and support advisory boards, scientific meetings, and institutional forums. Conduct high-quality, non-promotional Scientific Exchanges to foster physician confidence
  • Insight Generation: Systematically identify, capture, analyze, and translate external scientific and clinical practice insights from the field. Share these strategic, actionable recommendations directly with internal stakeholders, including DAMLs, MEs, and MCL
  • License to Operate & Operational Excellence
  • Adherence to Standards: Ensure all activities, including customer engagements and research projects, are conducted in strict compliance with Roche SOPs, UCPMP, local regulations, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), and Good Pharmacovigilance Practice (GVP)
  • Evidence Generation
  • Evidence Strategy Implementation: Collaborate with DAMLs and MEs to proactively identify local differentiating evidence gaps and facilitate real-world evidence (RWE) opportunities, including registries, observational studies, and externally submitted Investigator-Initiated Studies (IIS)
  • Clinical Development Support: Support the identification and assessment of potential trial sites and active investigators. Collaborate closely with Clinical Operations to provide proactive input on feasibility and strategic site selection to aid in clinical study execution

Who You Are:

  • Education: Advanced degree (MBBS, MD, PharmD, PhD, or MPharm) with a strong scientific foundation
  • Experience: 2–4 years experience in Medical Affairs, clinical practice, or a related field. Prior field-based/MSL experience is preferred. Prior exposure to neurology, specifically multiple sclerosis, is highly advantageous
  • Knowledge: Deep understanding of clinical research, RWE, and the Indian healthcare environment. High willingness to travel (60-70% field time)
  • Language: Fluency in English is essential

Core Competencies & Ethical Mindset:

  • Customer Focus: Prioritizes the needs of patients and customers (HCPs/TAEs), ensuring all actions drive value and satisfaction
  • Strategic Acumen: Ability to think strategically, act with autonomy, and thrive in complex, cross-functional team environments
  • Digital Literacy: Possesses a basic level of AI literacy and a learner mindset that proactively integrates digital tools. Ensures human-in-the-loop oversight of AI-derived content
  • Collaborative Networker: Collaborates effectively as part of a multi-skilled team (squad) and proactively shares expertise across the organization to remove silos
  • Growth Mindset & Curiosity: Demonstrates enthusiasm for continuous learning, learning agility to build deep disease knowledge quickly, and a strong solution-finding mindset
  • Assertive Communication: Excellent ability to articulate complex medical context, conduct credible scientific discussions with HCPs, and build trust on a peer-to-peer level
  • Entrepreneurial Mindset: Takes calculated risks, challenges the status quo, and proposes pragmatic, value-adding solutions without compromising Roche's license to operate. High discipline in execution and insight documentation
  • Value Creation: Focuses efforts on the added value, sustainability, and impact brought to patients and society within the ecosystem

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Mgr
jobs.description:
Own Every Moment at NetApp

At NetApp, your ideas power innovation. We lead in intelligent data infrastructure—delivering unified storage, integrated data services, and solutions that help organizations unlock the full potential of their data, from AI to multicloud.

Ready to innovate and contribute to our path to $10B Here, you'll collaborate with passionate teams, tackle real-world challenges, and see your impact in how customers transform and grow. If you're ready to bring curiosity, creativity, and drive to every moment, NetApp is where your journey begins. Join teams that innovate to elevate, drive results, and excel together across every function.

Job Summary

As a Senior Technical Program Manager for NetApp ONTAP Infrastructure, you will own and lead complex, cross-functional engineering programs from definition through release. You will partner with engineering, product management, quality, lab, and hardware teams to set goals, clarify features, manage timelines, mitigate risk, and deliver high-quality capabilities across ONTAP infrastructure modules—including filesystem infrastructure, storage services, data management, encryption, metadata services, and storage efficiency. You will operate independently in a fast-paced, matrixed environment, driving outcomes with minimal day-to-day supervision and escalating when leadership alignment is needed. With strong technical depth and clear communication, you will connect execution to company priorities, drive quality through measurable KPIs, and uplevel status to senior leadership.

Job Requirements

  • Own end-to-end delivery of ONTAP infrastructure programsfrom planning through validation, release readiness, and handoff spanning filesystem infrastructure, storage services, data management, encryption, metadata services, and storage efficiency.
  • Operate independently with strong judgment: define next steps, drive cross-team progress, and escalate decisions that require leadership input.
  • Apply technical depth to understand architecture, dependencies, and tradeoffs in enterprise storage and filesystem platforms; resolve cross-team blockers with engineering and architects.
  • Run programs in waterfall, Agile, or hybrid models adapting plans and milestones to team maturity and release constraints.
  • Partner with Product Management on scope, success criteria, timelines, and alignment before engineering commitment.
  • Build and maintain integrated plans (milestones, dependencies, resources, risks); proactively mitigate schedule, scope, and quality issues.
  • Tie program work to ONTAP, Core Data Foundation, and broader business priorities so teams understand strategic context and tradeoffs.
  • Drive quality initiatives with KPIs (defects, escapes, coverage, release readiness, SDL compliance) and use data in leadership reviews.
  • Engage and align stakeholders across engineering, QA, security, lab, hardware, operations, and support; secure and track commitments.
  • Coordinate lab and hardware needs for test infrastructure through the program lifecycle.Lead multi-team, cross-functional enterprise software programs of significant scope and complexity; depth of experience matters more than a specific team-size threshold.
  • Present executive-ready status, risks, and options to directors, VPs, and senior leaders.Ensure SDL activities and sign-offs are planned and completed in step with release milestones.Influence without authority in a matrixed organization; improve efficiency through practical process and tooling (Jira, dashboards, automation).

Education

  • B.E/B. Tech/BS or M.Tech/MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 10+ years in technical/engineering program or release management on complex enterprise software programs.
  • Preferred: Storage, filesystem, or platform infrastructure experience is a plus; quality engineering and SDL familiarity; PMP or equivalent is a plus.

At NetApp, we embrace a hybrid working environment designed to strengthen connection, collaboration, and culture for all employees. This means that most roles will have some level of in-office and/or in-person expectations, which will be shared during the recruitment process.

Equal Opportunity Employer:

NetApp is firmly committed to Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) and to compliance with all federal, state and local laws that prohibit employment discrimination based on age, race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, religion, disability or genetic information, pregnancy, protected veteran status, and any other protected classification.

Why You'll Thrive at NetApp

At NetApp, you won't wait for the perfect moment—you'll make it. The early planning, the extra thought, the bold idea that turns good into great: That's how our people operate and how we continue to push the boundaries of data infrastructure.

NetApp is the trusted partner for organizations transforming data into opportunity. As the only enterprise-grade storage service natively embedded in Google Cloud, AWS, and Microsoft Azure, we empower customers to run everything from traditional workloads to enterprise AI with unmatched performance, resilience, and security.

Our culture

We celebrate mold breakers, bold thinkers, and problem solvers. We reward initiative, impact, and ownership. We provide flexibility so you can balance professional ambition with your personal life. Here, differences are not just welcomed—they drive everything we do.

If you're ready to innovate, rise to the challenge, and own every moment - make your next move your best one. Apply now.

Submitting an Application

To ensure a streamlined and fair hiring process for all candidates, our team only reviews applications submitted through our company website. This practice allows us to track, assess, and respond to applicants efficiently. Emailing our employees, recruiters, or Human Resources personnel directly will not influence your application.

AI Disclosure

For select roles, some stages of our hiring process may use artificial intelligence tools to help evaluate applications and candidate selection. These tools support—rather than replace—human decision-making.

Description

Grocery Catalog Operations and Intel (GCOI) is responsible for catalog data management across Amazon Fresh, Whole Foods Market, and Grocery Partnerships businesses. The team ensures product catalog accuracy, completeness, and compliance across online and in-store grocery platforms, directly impacting customer experience, search relevance, and supply chain efficiency. GCOI manages over 100 operational workstreams spanning new item setup, catalog defect resolution, attribute validation, and merchant onboarding support.

The Catalog Specialist executes catalog data management workflows that keep grocery product information accurate and complete. You will process daily operational tickets involving new item creation, product attribute corrections, listing defects, and catalog configuration exceptions generated by automated systems. Your work directly determines whether customers see correct product information (titles, images, temperature handling, barcodes, pricing units, expiry dates) when shopping across Amazon's grocery platforms.

Key job responsibilities

Execute catalog operations including new item setup (ASIN creation, offer activation, attribute population), defect remediation, and listing adjustments across Whole Foods Market, Grocery Partnerships, and Fresh programs

Process tickets generated by catalog automation systems (CIPS, CAMS, auto-cut workflows) where configuration exceptions, attribute validation failures, or rule threshold breaches require manual investigation and resolution

Validate and correct product attributes including temperature ratings, expiry information, barcode assignments, GL/PT classifications, product dimensions, and brand data per established SOPs

Investigate catalog discrepancies by cross-referencing internal tools, supplier data, and upstream/downstream systems; escalate with supporting context when resolution requires cross-team involvement

Support new merchant onboarding by processing bulk catalog loads, validating listing quality, and resolving launch-blocking defects within committed timelines

Maintain operational trackers, SOP documentation, and audit trails to ensure process traceability, team alignment, and compliance with business standards

Track and report progress on assigned tasks, collaborating with manager and peers to unblock dependencies and meet weekly/monthly goals within defined SLAs

Participate in team meetings, syncs, and reviews by providing status updates, sharing insights from ticket patterns, and helping identify recurring issues that can be addressed through process improvements

  • Experience with Microsoft Office products and applications
  • Experience with Excel

jobs.title: Project Leader- Healthcare (MedTech)
jobs.description:
ABOUT US:  

Bain & Company is a global consulting firm that helps the world's most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 61 offices in 39 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.

In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN plays a critical role in supporting Bain's case teams globally to help with analytics and research across all industries, for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property.

 

WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH:

This is a full-time position based in Bain's Gurugram office and forms an integral part of the Healthcare & Life Sciences Centre of Expertise (HLS CoE). The HLS CoE provides specialized support to global consulting teams across the healthcare and life sciences value chain, enabling clients to make strategic business and investment decisions. The team partners closely with case teams as a thought-partner, delivering high-quality, industry-specific analytical products and expertise to address the most critical strategic questions facing Bain's healthcare clients.

The HLS practice serves leading organizations across Pharmaceuticals, MedTech, Providers, Payers, Global Health, and Digital Health. As part of the HLS CoE, you will collaborate with teams across all major regions (EMEA, Americas, and APAC) in a fast-paced, dynamic environment—working closely with global Bain teams to deliver impactful results for our clients.

Role:

We are looking for a high performing Project Leader to lead a team of 3-4 members focused on MedTech (Medical Devices, Equipment's, OEMs, Distribution etc.) as a subsector with HLS. A Project Leader (PL) is responsible for ensuring high quality delivery of projects while building strong client relationships and providing day to day coaching and mentoring to team members. The PL works with his/her team to build direction and work-plan, approach to problem solving, hypothesis generation by leveraging the research toolkit. 

 In this role, you will lead a team comprising Associates and Analysts to deliver high-impact, client-ready proposals, case specific outputs, and go-to-market materials. You will also support the development of intellectual property (IP), thought leadership, and Bain's internal capabilities. The role requires strong problem-solving skills, understanding of healthcare landscape, and the ability to manage multiple stakeholders across levels. The PL is also expected to participate in office initiatives such as recruiting, training, and business strategy.

Key responsibilities

jobs.title: SME, CDISC & eSubmission Standards
jobs.description:
Sun Pharma is looking for an experienced SAS Macro Developer to join our team. The primary responsibilities of this role will be to develop and maintain SAS macros to support our SDTM (Study Data Tabulation Model), ADAM (Analysis Data Model), and TLF (Tables, Listings, and Figures) programming efforts, which are critical components of the drug development process.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and implement reusable SAS macros to streamline SDTM, ADAM, and TLF programming workflows
  • Collaborate with SAS programmers, Biostats and subject matter experts to understand business requirements and translate them into efficient macro solutions
  • Demonstrate a strong understanding of the drug development process and the role of SDTM, ADAM, and TLF standards in regulatory submissions
  • Develop macros to automate and standardize SDTM programming tasks, such as data transformation, variable derivation, and metadata generation
  • Maintain a good working knowledge of SDTM and ADAM standards to ensure macros are aligned with industry best practices
  • Optimize macro performance and ensure they are scalable and maintainable
  • Thoroughly test macros to validate functionality and identify/resolve any issues
  • Document macro code, usage, and best practices for knowledge sharing
  • Provide training and support to other team members on leveraging the developed macros
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest SAS macro language features and techniques
  • Will occasionally need support study team in with study SDTM/ADaM and TLFs Programming

Qualifications

  • Education: BSc or equivalent with research experience, and/or MS (Computer Science, Bioinformatics, or Related field). Master's Degree preferred.
  • Minimum 7 years of experience in SAS programming, with a strong focus on macro development in Clinical development with strong knowledge of CDISC ADaM and SDTM, ICH Statistical and Clinical Report Guidelines
  • Experience in the pharmaceutical, healthcare, or life sciences industry is highly preferred
  • Experience with R programming is highly preferred

Required Skills

  • Proficient in writing complex, dynamic SAS macros using macro language features such as macro variables, macro functions, and macro conditional logic
  • Demonstrated understanding of the drug development process and familiarity with CDISC SDTM, ADAM, and TLF standards
  • Experience in designing modular, reusable, and maintainable macro solutions for SDTM programming tasks
  • Knowledge of Software Development Life(SDLC) cycle process
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills to identify and resolve macro-related issues
  • Excellent communication skills to collaborate with cross-functional teams
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team

jobs.title: Team Assistant
jobs.description:
Job Description

American Express's Global Financial Crimes Surveillance Unit (GFCSU) and the US Investigations Unit (USIU), within Global Financial Crimes Compliance (GFCC), in partnership provide end-to-end support and oversight of global financial crimes investigations. In conjunction with GFCC partners, the GFCSU and USIU develop and implement automated transaction monitoring rules, reports, and other processes designed to identify activity potentially indicative of criminal behavior.

The GFCSU and USIU also investigate potentially suspicious financial activity and, when appropriate, file suspicious activity reports (SARs) with the Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN), which is part of the U.S. Department of the Treasury, and/or refers matters to internal compliance partners for review and reporting globally. In addition, the GFCSU and USIU manage risk associated with politically exposed persons and persons and entities on core sanctions and risk lists through regular screening, and manage risk associated with improper payments that could be indicative of bribery, corruption, or other illicit activity by reviewing internal American Express payments and expenditures.

The GFCSU and USIU together perform a critical role in ensuring that American Express complies with all applicable laws and regulations, including the Bank Secrecy Act (BSA), the USA PATRIOT Act, and the Foreign Corrupt Practices Act, and provides law enforcement with key information for the investigation and prosecution of money laundering and terrorist financing, credit card fraud, identity theft, and other criminal activity.

The successful candidate will work in our hub in Gurgaon (India) to mitigate risk to the American Express enterprise through research and analysis of financial activity for suspicious patterns along with the review of records. Candidates must be flexible and willing to change responsibilities to meet business needs, should be comfortable reading and reviewing records from US jurisdictions, and be able to work with various teams across American Express, including US & International Market Compliance Officers, line of business representatives, and project teams, among others.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct investigations across different GFCSU workflows: AML, EDD, Screening and Anti-Corruption.
  • Strong research, report/narration writing, and analytical skills across different GFCSU workflows: AML, EDD, Screening and Anti-Corruption.
  • Reviewing and dispositioning Transaction Monitoring, Screening and EDD alerts,
  • Demonstrate a keen attention to detail in investigation, analysis, and report/narration writing.
  • Meet performance expectations: productivity and quality goals.
  • To develop and maintain an adequate knowledge of the financial crime environment.

Qualifications

  • Excellent verbal and written communications skills
  • At least two years of analytical or investigative experience, preferably within the financial crimes, AML, risk, threat analysis, or fraud fields.

  • Ability to synthesize large amounts of information such as transaction data and identify key trends.
  • Ability to work efficiently and independently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Incumbent should be flexible to work in rotational shift environment. Shift window is 24*7 with rotational week offs.

  • Certification in Compliance, AML or Financial Crime related fields.

jobs.title: Quality Controller (Jewelry Manufacturing)
jobs.description:
Company Description Voylla, founded in 2013, is India's largest fashion jewelry destination, combining a strong online presence with over 250 retail stores across the country. The brand is known for high-quality, finely crafted jewelry offered at accessible price points, drawing inspiration from traditional art and crafts to create contemporary designs. Voylla's versatile collections are designed to suit diverse styles and occasions, aiming to offer something for every customer. The company's core team brings extensive experience in technology, retail, and operations, and includes professionals from leading institutes such as Carnegie Mellon University, IIM, IIT, NIT, and NIFT. This blend of creative and technical expertise supports a fast-growing, innovation-focused work environment.
Role Description The Quality Controller (Jewelry Manufacturing) role at Voylla is a full-time, on-site position based in Jaipur. The role involves inspecting jewelry pieces at various stages of production to ensure they meet defined quality standards for craftsmanship, materials, finishes, and durability. The Quality Controller will document inspection results, identify defects or non-conformities, and coordinate with production teams to implement corrective actions. Daily responsibilities include monitoring adherence to quality procedures, supporting internal audits, and maintaining clear records and reports for quality-related metrics. The role also involves collaborating with supervisors and team members to reinforce best practices and contribute to continuous improvement in manufacturing processes.
Qualifications
  • Candidates should possess strong skills in Quality Control and Quality Assurance to evaluate jewelry products and ensure consistency with standards.
  • Candidates should possess experience in Quality Management and Auditing to support process improvements, compliance, and documentation.
  • Candidates should possess Training skills to guide production teams on quality requirements and support ongoing skill development.
  • Prior experience in jewelry manufacturing, fashion accessories, or precision manufacturing environments is highly beneficial.
  • Attention to detail, strong observational skills, and the ability to identify and classify defects accurately are essential.
  • Good communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively on the shop floor and with cross-functional teams.
  • Organizational and documentation skills to maintain records, reports, and quality checklists in a structured manner.
  • Relevant diploma or degree in manufacturing, quality, jewelry design, or a related field is preferred, along with knowledge of basic safety and compliance standards.

We are seeking an experienced Salesforce Functional Consultant to join our dynamic team as a permanent, full-time employee, also acting as Product Owner for TaskRay, our Professional Service Project/Task management application within the Salesforce ecosystem. This role owns the functional design and business process side of the broader Salesforce platform, translating global sales operations needs into configured, scalable solutions, while also owning the TaskRay product backlog and prioritization that guides the development team's delivery on that application. The ideal candidate brings deep functional expertise in Salesforce and CRM-driven sales processes, strong business analysis skills, Agile product ownership experience, and the ability to lead process improvement independently. This role partners closely with global IT and the development team to ensure solutions are grounded in sound process design, data models, and industry best practices, and that TaskRay delivery stays aligned with business priorities.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

  • Translate business requirements into functional solution designs, applying Salesforce and industry best practices
  • Provide expert guidance on Sales operations/CRM features, capabilities, and how business processes connect across systems
  • Design solutions that align with business needs and translate them into functional requirements for the development team
  • Analyse current business workflows and systems to identify areas for improvement and automation
  • Lead requirements-gathering workshops and produce business process maps, user stories, and functional specifications for the development team to build against
  • Partner with developers to validate that delivered solutions meet the functional intent and business requirement
  • Troubleshoot complex issues from a functional/business-process perspective, working with the development team on root cause and resolution
  • Stay current on managed application features, Salesforce platform releases, and industry trends relevant to sales operations
  • Lead change management activities, including UAT planning, training, and adoption support, through to go-live
  • Conduct periodic process and application health checks and provide recommendations for optimization
  • Provide post-implementation functional support, triaging and resolving process-related issues
  • Create detailed solution design documentation, including process flows, data models, and system/data touchpoints at the functional level

Product Owner Responsibilities (TaskRay)

  • Own and prioritize the TaskRay product backlog, balancing business value, urgency, and dependencies
  • Translate functional requirements for TaskRay (templates, resource planner, automations, project workflows) into well-formed user stories and acceptance criteria for the development team
  • Act as the primary point of contact between business stakeholders and the development team on TaskRay scope, priority, and trade-off decisions
  • Participate in and help facilitate Agile ceremonies for the TaskRay workstream, including backlog grooming, sprint planning, sprint review, and retrospectives
  • Define sprint goals and maintain a release roadmap for TaskRay in partnership with global IT and delivery teams

  • Ability to make prioritization trade-offs and communicate them clearly to both business stakeholders and delivery teams
  • Experience defining and tracking KPIs, and leading quarterly business reviews with cross-functional stakeholders

Preferred Skills

  • Experience as a TaskRay Functional Consultant: gathering onboarding/post-sale process requirements, configuring TaskRay templates, resource planner, and automations, and mapping customer-facing project workflows through configuration
  • Working knowledge of the TaskRay data model (Projects, Templates, Tasks, Resources) sufficient to advise on functional design and configuration options

  • Knowledge of change management principles
  • Familiarity with process improvement methodologies (Six Sigma, Lean, etc.)

  • Understanding of service and application lifecycle management
  • Determines and develops approaches to complex business process/system assignments
  • Leads business-process-related projects, applying in-depth experience to influence outcomes
  • Solves complex problems independently, drawing on in-depth process and platform experience
  • Recognized internally as an experienced practitioner in Salesforce functional/business process design

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree, or equivalent experience
  • Typically 6–7 years of relevant experience in Salesforce business analysis, functional consulting, or CRM process design
  • Strong understanding of project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, etc.)

Desired Qualifications
