Job Description:

The Future Begins Here:

At Takeda, we are leading digital evolution and global transformation. By building innovative solutions and future-ready capabilities, we are meeting the need of patients, our people, and the planet.

Bengaluru, the city, which is India's epicenter of Innovation, has been selected to be home to Takeda's recently launched Innovation Capability Center. We invite you to join our digital transformation journey. In this role, you will have the opportunity to boost your skills and become the heart of an innovative engine that is contributing to global impact and improvement.

At Takeda's ICC we Unite in Diversity:

Takeda is committed to creating an inclusive and collaborative workplace, where individuals are recognized for their backgrounds and abilities they bring to our company. We are continuously improving our collaborators journey in Takeda, and we welcome applications from all qualified candidates. Here, you will feel welcomed, respected, and valued as an important contributor to our diverse team

About the role :

You will lead platform delivery and operational ownership for Shopfloor Workflow Digitalisation solutions within the Takeda portfolio, with a focus on plant and laboratory transformation through electronic logbooks, electronic forms, and digital workflows. You will help shape the strategy, governance, lifecycle management, and multi-site adoption of the OpsTrakker platform, ensuring delivery and run operations align with business needs, quality expectations, validation requirements, and compliance standards.

In this role, you will connect local site needs with technical delivery and operational support, drive sustainable platform adoption across multiple locations, and ensure effective governance across service performance, vendors, licensing, financial planning, and continuous improvement. You will also help to identify & implement opportunities to leverage artificial intelligence and innovative digital capabilities to improve process design, support effectiveness, and operational execution.

How you will contribute:

  • Lead the Workflow Digitalisation initiative that supports digital transformation at plant and laboratory level, including electronic logbooks, electronic forms, and digital workflow adoption.
  • Own the platform operating model for OpsTrakker across the full lifecycle, including build, run, and continuous improvement activities. You will be responsible to ensure stable, compliant, and business-aligned service delivery across the Takeda site network.
  • Own the governance process for digitalization of use cases as well as roadmap planning, standards, release management, change control, and multi-site rollout of the OpsTrakker platform.
  • Partner with key stakeholders (business, quality, validation, others) to define solution scope, align priorities, support implementation decisions, and ensure the platform continues to meet evolving business and compliance needs over time.
  • Lead business-facing aspects of platform deployment and ongoing adoption, including stakeholder communication, user community engagement, change adoption, and coordination with local sites and central teams.
  • Guide requirements intake, process mapping, user stories, acceptance criteria, testing, and user acceptance testing for paperless solution delivery, ensuring alignment with validation requirements, business processes, and operational support needs.
  • Ensure appropriate operational ownership across the software development lifecycle, including demand intake, solution design alignment, release readiness, deployment coordination, service transition, handover to support, and ongoing operability of the platform.
  • Manage budget-related activities for the platform and associated initiatives, including planning, forecasting, cost oversight, resource alignment, and support for investment and prioritization decisions.
  • Coordinate and govern external vendors and partners to support both delivery and run operations, including performance management, issue resolution, service expectations, and continuous improvement.
  • Oversee license management activities for the platform and related components, including usage transparency, access alignment, optimization opportunities, and support for compliance and cost control.
  • Ensure platform operations remain aligned with applicable GxP, data integrity, documentation, access control, and audit readiness requirements.
  • Ensure platform operations are delivered within the global DD&T process & tool framework
  • Use artificial intelligence and digital tools to identify opportunities for process improvement, reduce manual effort, improve support effectiveness, and enhance the way paperless solutions are delivered, governed, and operated.
  • Manage and develop team members, set clear goals, coach performance, and support effective ways of working across the team.

Skills and qualifications:

Required:

  • Experience with the OpsTrakker platform or a similar paperless solution platform is a strong advantage
  • Proven experience within paperless manufacturing or laboratory transformation initiatives, including electronic forms, electronic logbooks, and digital workflows.

  • Knowledge of Industry 4.0, digital manufacturing, and integration concepts such as manufacturing execution systems, historians, industrial internet of things, or automation.

jobs.title: Senior Analyst Commercial Analytics
jobs.description:
By clicking the Apply button, I understand that my employment application process with Takeda will commence and that the information I provide in my application will be processed in line with Takeda's Privacy Notice and Terms of Use. I further attest that all information I submit in my employment application is true to the best of my knowledge.

Job Description:

OBJECTIVES / PURPOSE:

We are seeking a strong Senior Analyst to join Takeda's GCC Commercial Insights & Analytics (I&A) organization in India. This role carries significant individual analytical ownership, bridging execution-level work with emerging stakeholder-facing responsibilities. The Senior Analyst is a critical analytical contributor who drives the quality and depth of insights delivered to global brand teams and begins to shape the analytical direction of assigned workstreams.

  • Own and independently deliver a portfolio of mid-to-high complexity analytical workstreams that directly inform global brand strategy, performance management, and commercial execution across assigned brands and indications.
  • Apply advanced proficiency across pharmaceutical commercial data sources — including patient-level claims, EMR, specialty pharmacy, and sales data across multiple markets — and analytics tools to generate decision-ready insights with clear business implications.
  • Design and execute patient journey analyses, HCP segmentation models, performance deep-dives, and competitive assessments that provide actionable, evidence-based recommendations to global I&A brand leads and commercial partners.
  • Serve as an emerging analytical thought leader within the GCC team — contributing to methodology development, analytical best practices, and the informal mentoring of Analyst colleagues.

ACCOUNTABILITIES:

Brand Analytics and Insight Generation:

  • Own end-to-end delivery of assigned performance analytics workstreams, producing reports and dashboards that track brand KPIs — including patient shares, new starts, source of business, adherence, and HCP engagement — across global, regional, and country levels.
  • Integrate and analyze diverse commercial data sources across markets — including real-world data (claims, EMR/EHR, lab data), specialty pharmacy data, sales data, and channel data — to generate comprehensive patient and HCP insights that support brand strategy and launch readiness.
  • Develop and maintain business rules for processing raw patient-level data, leveraging a deep understanding of data nuances, commercial context, and market knowledge to ensure analytical accuracy and consistency.
  • Conduct advanced, self-directed exploratory data analysis (EDA) and opportunity prospecting — moving beyond basic pulls (counts, topline, segmentation, time trends) to surface non-obvious commercial opportunities and hypotheses.
  • Lead custom reporting and complex ad hoc analysis requests with independent hypothesis formulation, rigorous methodology, and well-documented, insight-rich outputs.

Patient / HCP Cohort Development and Segmentation:

  • Build and maintain patient and HCP cohorts using standard business rules and deterministic logic, ensuring definitions are clinically sound, reproducible, and aligned with brand and indication requirements.
  • Develop advanced cohort and segmentation approaches — including cluster and probabilistic models — to support more sophisticated patient/HCP targeting, prioritization, and micro-segmentation for global brand teams.

Data Operation and Automation:

  • Perform basic ETL to acquire, clean, transform, and structure raw data from multiple sources into analysis-ready datasets.
  • Develop and help orchestrate data pipelines that support recurring analytics and reporting, improving reliability, scalability, and reproducibility of team deliverables.
  • Proactively identify and implement opportunities to automate and scale recurring reporting and analytical workflows, improving efficiency and reproducibility.

Data Visualization and Reporting Excellence:

  • Design and maintain Tableau or Power BI dashboards and reporting tools that clearly communicate brand performance trends, patient funnel dynamics, and field force activity to global stakeholders.
  • Establish KPIs and metrics — including patient shares, duration of therapy (DoT), adherence rates, source of business, and campaign effectiveness — and monitor their performance across global markets, regions, and channels.

Stakeholder Collaboration and Communication:

  • Partner with GCC Managers and global I&A brand leads to clarify analytical requirements, align on deliverable scope, and communicate progress proactively.
  • Synthesize findings from multiple data sources into cohesive, decision-oriented analytical stories with clear so what implications and actionable recommendations tailored to global brand and commercial audiences.
  • Provide informal mentoring and quality guidance to Analyst I and Analyst II colleagues, reviewing their outputs, explaining methodological choices, and supporting their professional development.
  • Contribute to team knowledge management by documenting analytical methods, data source guides, and reusable query libraries.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & EXPERIENCE:

Education:

  • Bachelor's Degree required in Statistics, Data Science, Life Sciences, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.
  • Master's degree or MBA in a relevant analytical or business field is strongly preferred.

Experience:

  • 4–5 years of experience in pharmaceutical commercial analytics or healthcare analytics, with demonstrated independent ownership of analytical deliverables.
  • Deep working knowledge of pharma commercial datasets across markets patient-level claims (e.g., IQVIA, Komodo Health, Symphony Health), specialty pharmacy, EMR, and sales data is required.
  • Hands-on experience with data beyond claims is strongly preferred, including lab data, EMR/EHR, medical and regulatory coding systems (e.g., ICD, procedure/reimbursement codes), public datasets (e.g., government and financial), and research literature sources such as Citeline and PubMed.
  • Proficiency in coding techniques such as SQL, SAS, R, or Python for data manipulation and workflow automation; advanced Excel skills required.
  • Familiarity with API programming to acquire data via formal APIs, and with using GenAI tools (e.g., Claude Code) as a coding partner to accelerate analytical work.
  • Strong experience with Tableau or Power BI for performance and brand analytics dashboard development.
  • Working knowledge of Databricks or cloud-based analytics platforms.
  • Experience supporting global or regional brand teams or cross-functional analytics programs is strongly preferred.

Skills & Competencies:

  • Advanced Commercial Data Analysis —:Independently designs and executes complex analyses using multi-source, multi-market pharma commercial datasets; interprets results with strong domain context.
  • Data Pulls & Exploration —:Progresses from basic data pulls (counts, top-line, segmentation, time) to advanced, self-directed EDA and opportunity prospecting.
  • Cohort Development & Segmentation —:Builds deterministic, business-rule-based cohorts and advances toward probabilistic and cluster-model approaches for patient/HCP targeting.
  • Data Operations —:Performs basic ETL and develops/orchestrates pipelines to produce reproducible, analysis-ready data.
  • Technical Proficiency —:Advanced SQL; working Python/R; API programming for data acquisition; uses GenAI as a coding partner; growing fluency in Databricks or cloud platforms.
  • Data Storytelling —:Translates complex findings from multiple data sources into executive-ready narratives with explicit business implications and clear recommendations.
  • Stakeholder Communication —:Communicates analytical findings persuasively to global I&A leads and cross-functional partners; adapts framing to both technical and commercial audiences.
  • Automation & Efficiency —:Proactively identifies and implements workflow improvements using code, pipelines, or process redesign.
  • Informal Mentorship —:Provides practical guidance to junior analysts on analytical techniques, data interpretation, and quality standards.
  • Problem-Solving —:Frames ambiguous business questions into structured hypotheses; comfortable navigating complexity and data limitations.

Intangible Skills:

  • Curiosity —:Naturally inquisitive; digs beneath surface results to understand the why behind the data.
  • Confidence —:Willing to take a point of view, defend analytical choices, and engage senior stakeholders.
  • Reflective —:Reviews own work critically, learns from feedback, and refines methods over time.
  • High Risk Tolerance —:Comfortable experimenting with new methods, tools, and approaches under ambiguity.
  • Organized —:Manages multiple workstreams, timelines, and documentation with discipline and structure.
  • English Fluency —:High command of written and spoken English for clear communication with global stakeholders.

TAKEDA LEADERSHIP BEHAVIORS:

In alignment with Takeda's Values-Based Culture, this role requires demonstration of the following leadership behaviors

  • Act with Integrity —:Deliver accurate, transparent work and take full responsibility for quality.
  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally —:Contribute positively to GCC and global team workflows and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Drive Accountability —:Take ownership of all assigned tasks and deliver on commitments.
  • Embrace Learning —:Continuously build analytical and domain capabilities through feedback and self-driven development.

Job Title: Associate

Department: Real Asset – Alt Credit

About Business line/Function: The Real Asset team will focus on Securitized & Structured Assets (SSA) Portfolio Management Support; Insurance Linked Securities (ILS) - Portfolio Data Analytics; Corporate Credit (CC) - Leverage Loan Fund Reporting; Credit (CC) – Leverage Loan Database Management; specifically in support of Structured Finance functions.

Position Purpose: The role provides operational support for Alternative Credit Insurance and Corporate Credit, focusing on monthly fund reporting and GRM/Markit compliance through multi-source data collation and quality assurance. Additionally, they manage the MAIA database by coordinating with vendor teams to ensure the accurate creation and maintenance of instruments and issuers.

Responsibilities

  • Fund Reporting: Manage end-to-end production of monthly CRDB reports for active funds.
  • Data Collation: Aggregate complex data from BNY Mellon, Corporate Credit IT, Bloomberg, and the MAIA tool
  • Reference Data Management: Maintain and update static reference files to ensure report accuracy
  • Compliance & Uploads: Produce consolidated monthly files for all funds and upload them to Markit to meet GRM requirements
  • Quality Assurance: Perform thorough quality checks on all final output files to ensure data integrity and compliance
  • Instrument Lifecycle Management: Coordinate the creation of new loan instruments in MAIA via the DALI and State Street teams
  • Data Validation: Verify instrument details against Investment Notes and update critical characteristics such as Covenant Type and Recovery Rate
  • Issuer Maintenance: Identify missing issuers in MAIA and facilitate their creation using Bloomberg data
  • Database Oversight: Conduct D+1 verification to ensure all instruments and issuers are correctly reflected in the system
  • Ad-hoc Support: Deliver additional regular reports and operational support for the Corporate Credit team

Key Role Responsibilities

  • Proficiency in data manipulation, VLOOKUPs, and pivot tables for collating large datasets
  • Experience with Bloomberg and Markit (essential for data sourcing and reporting
  • Understanding of data quality controls and the importance of audit trails in financial reporting
  • Ability to meet strict monthly reporting deadlines and D+1 turnaround times
  • Attention to detail for performing control checks and ensuring that complex financial data is uploaded without error
  • Capability to cross-reference multiple data sources (S&P, Bloomberg, Investment Notes) to resolve discrepancies
  • Compliance with local and global regulations and market standards
  • Flexibility to handle a wide variety of ad-hoc requests and varying reporting requirements for different clients
  • Ensure adherence to internal risk and control frameworks, participating in internal/external audits and various internal control testing

Technical & Behavioral Competencies

  • Analytical mindset with the ability to perform control checks, investigate discrepancies and escalate appropriately
  • Advanced Excel (pivot tables, Power Query, VBA) and strong data-management experience
  • Ability to liaise with multiple internal and external parties
  • Strong organisational and attention-to-detail orientation; capable of managing competing deadlines
  • Ability to investigate data gaps independently and escalate issues only after thorough investigation
  • Very rigorous and strong organizational competencies
  • Taking initiatives & service-orientated mentality
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and good listening skills
  • Determined to facilitate situations in-order-to achieve results
  • Shift timing – 12:30 PM IST to 10:30 PM IST (09:00 AM to 07:00 PM Europe time)

Specific Qualifications

  • A previous experience in a similar role is mandatory
  • Strong understanding of Asset Backed Securities
  • Proficiency with applications - Bloomberg, INTEX

Technical Skills

Skills Referential (Required knowledge, skills and abilities)

  • Advanced Excel (pivot tables, Power Query, VBA)
  • strong data-management experience
  • Proficiency with applications - Bloomberg, INTEX
  • Strong understanding of Asset Backed Securities

Behavioral Skills

  • Very rigorous and strong organizational competencies
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and good listening skills
  • Ability to liaise with multiple internal and external parties
  • Education Level: Degree qualified in Business, Finance, Accounting or related discipline is preferable.
  • Having market related qualifications such as CPA, CFA qualifications

Location: Chennai/ Mumbai

About BNP Paribas Group

BNP Paribas is the European Union's leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group's commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.

About BNP Paribas India Solutions

Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union's leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best-in-class solutions.

Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

At BNP Paribas, we passionately embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees are valued, respected and can bring their authentic selves to work. We prohibit Discrimination and Harassment of any kind and our policies promote equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants, irrespective of, but not limited to their gender, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, colour, national origin, age, religion, social status, mental or physical disabilities, veteran status etc. As a global Bank, we truly believe that inclusion and diversity of our teams is key to our success in serving our clients and the communities we operate in. jobs.title: Staff Engineer, Software Test
jobs.description:
Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

Environmental Conditions

Office

At Thermo Fisher, our mission is to cure cancer with genomic data. It is a close-knit, collaborative, cross-functional setting where we believe none of us is as smart as all of us and we each have something valuable to contribute toward our goal. The software services team is tasked with applying industry best practices to the design, development, and deployment of world-class software products. We are looking to hire individuals with experience with software development and test engineering in clinical and research settings, and who can help us solve the next wave of technical challenges using the latest cloud-based, big-data, and rich analytics toolsets.

We are seeking enthusiastic Leader in Software Verification and Validation who will define scope, design, for automated and manual tests for highly advanced bioinformatics software. We require strong coding skills as well as a solid understanding of Quality Assurance principles and Continuous Integration methods. You will drive writing positive and negative smoke and regression test scripts to test product functionality and integration with dependencies. You will drive strategies for test APIs, user interfaces, web services, and/or web apps and write performance, load, and stress tests.

You are excited and passionate about participating in an Agile/SCRUM setting to meet and exceed customer expectations and continuously drive towards quality improvements. You like the idea of partnering with users and other team members to brainstorm the best possible approaches to validating systems. You welcome the challenge of working in a fast-paced, discovery-oriented environment and will be genuinely excited about the prospect of creatively exercising your problem-solving skills continuously to ultimately improve the human condition.

Essential Functions:

  • Develop and implement software testing Strategy, Methods and Best Practices that allow high quality NGS analytics and instruments software products to be designed, developed, and released into the regulated in-vitro diagnostics/ medical device space.
  • Lead and mentor a group of bioinformatics and software test engineers.
  • Establish software quality standards and KPI metrics to actively measure software and bioinformatics product quality. Implement software quality tracking tools and methodologies to provide on-going visibility and action during software product development lifecycle.
  • Single point of contact while working with external partners to deliver state of the art Software products in market.
  • Partner with software and bioinformatics leadership, functional and project managers to identify appropriate scope of software testing, verification and validation required for a project and managing the overall testing activities for projects.
  • Partner with internal and external stakeholders to drive the requirements for regulated assays and software. Help software development team to understand the complex informatics and visualization requirements leading into design implementation
  • Mentor and guide engineers, conduct test case reviews, and foster a culture of domain/engineering excellence
  • Work closely with product managers, UX designers, and stakeholders to translate requirements enabling clear test planning and execution
  • Strategic thinker who is able to identify and mitigate risks witn complete ownership.
  • Proven ability to work well with senior leadership.
  • Believe and work on do it right at first and own any deviations and effectively able to drive improvements with proven results.
  • Experience working in a fast paced, dynamic environment.

Minimum Qualifications (must have):

  • Masters/PhD preferred or Bachelors with minimum 10+ years of work experience and strong track record of industry productivity
  • 08+ experience performing software verification and validation testing, preferably in the medical device/ biotech space
  • Strong understanding of NGS-based regulated software, IVD assay development practices and informatics data analysis pipelines.
  • Strong leadership abilities and extensive experience managing the activities of software quality engineering and assurance teams. Experience leading cross-functional, multi-site teams preferred.
  • Practical experience as a leader in the use of modern software development methodologies/ processes with an ability to direct the use of resources to meet department goals
  • Good understanding in design control for regulated products (e.g. US-IVD, IVD-D, IVD-R, China and Japan regulations) and knowledge of applicable regulations and standards used in IVD and medical device software development (e.g. ISO 13485, IEC 62304, and 21 CFR 820).

About The Program

An international non-governmental organization (INGO) is seeking eligible candidates for the position of Senior Program Coordinator based in Pune. The Senior Program Coordinator will be responsible for end-to-end management of laboratory operations for Acute Febrile Illness (AFI) and Acute Diarrheal Disease (ADD) surveillance, ensuring high-quality implementation across patient enrolment support, specimen collection, transport, laboratory processing and testing, reporting, and data management.

About The Position

The Senior Program Coordinator will provide overall technical and operational leadership to ensure that the laboratory functions uninterrupted, adheres to approved protocols and diagnostic algorithms, meets turnaround time (TAT) expectations, and complies with quality management and biosafety standards. The Senior Program Coordinator will work closely with clinicians, surveillance teams, the designated laboratory, and the IDSP Metropolitan Surveillance Unit (MSU) and Central Surveillance Unit (CSU) teams to strengthen laboratory support for AFI and ADD surveillance and ensure surveillance outputs are timely, complete, and usable for public health action.

Responsibilities

  • Laboratory Operations and Technical Oversight
  • Perform specimen processing and testing in alignment with standard protocols and defined diagnostic algorithms.
  • Oversee all project-related laboratory activities, including patient enrolment, specimen collection workflows, transport, receipt, processing, testing, validation, and reporting.
  • Ensure implementation of approved SOPs, diagnostic algorithms, and laboratory workflows for AFI/ADD surveillance.
  • Ensure quality, accuracy, and timeliness of testing and results.
  • Review and validate results prior to reporting, ensuring completeness, consistency, and compliance with protocol requirements.
  • Ensure appropriate specimen storage, referral (if required), and disposal in line with protocols and institutional requirements.
  • Quality Management and Biosafety Compliance
  • Ensure adherence to laboratory quality systems, including internal quality control procedures, documentation, traceability, and corrective action processes.
  • Ensure compliance with biosafety requirements, standard precautions, and biomedical waste management as per institutional and regulatory norms.
  • Data Management, Documentation, and Reporting
  • Ensure accurate and timely completion of all project documentation.
  • Maintain all registers/logs for specimen receipt, processing, testing, and storage.
  • Ensure data entry systems (registers and/or electronic platforms) are used consistently, and that records are complete and auditable.
  • Ensure test reports are generated and shared in a timely manner through the appropriate platform(s) and with authorized stakeholders as per reporting workflows.
  • Ensure data confidentiality, ethical compliance, and adherence to project data protection requirements.
  • Team Supervision, Capacity Building, and Performance Management
  • Conduct on-the-job training for the lab technicians
  • Provide day-to-day supervision and mentorship to laboratory technician(s)/ assistant(s) and other supporting staff, ensuring role clarity and accountability.
  • Plan staff rosters and ensure adequate coverage for peak workloads and continuity of operations.
  • Coordination, Stakeholder Engagement, and Communication
  • Coordinate with clinicians and surveillance teams to ensure smooth enrolment and specimen flow, minimizing missed cases and improving completeness.
  • Participate in review meetings; provide regular progress updates, including operational metrics (e.g., enrolment numbers, specimen volumes, positivity trends, TAT, data completeness, stock status, and key issues).
  • Escalate critical issues (e.g., stock-outs, equipment failure, major delays, data discrepancies) promptly with a clear mitigation plan.
  • Inventory, Equipment, and Logistics Oversight
  • Oversee inventory planning and ensure uninterrupted availability of consumables, reagents, kits, and PPE; prevent stock-outs through timely forecasting and requisitioning.
  • Ensure equipment readiness, calibration/maintenance schedules (where applicable), and basic troubleshooting coordination with relevant teams/vendors.
  • Ensure appropriate cold chain systems, storage capacity, and transport logistics are functional and monitored (e.g., temperature logs where required).
  • Project Timeliness and Troubleshooting
  • Ensure laboratory activities are completed in accordance with project timelines and deliverables.
  • Identify operational bottlenecks (laboratory, logistics, staffing, equipment, data flow) and implement corrective measures to restore performance.
  • Perform any other project-related tasks as assigned by the Supervisor or Nodal Officer.

Required Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Microbiology, Laboratory Sciences, or a related field.
  • Minimum 3–5 years of relevant experience in diagnostic laboratory settings, including responsibility for supervision or coordination of laboratory operations.
  • Strong understanding of microbiology/serology workflows and laboratory documentation practices.
  • Experience in Public Health Labs or Management of projects is desirable.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and maintain high-quality outputs under operational constraints.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) and comfort with electronic data/reporting platforms.

Skills And Competencies

  • Strong communication, coordination, and supervisory skills.
  • Proficiency in Marathi and English (reading, writing, speaking), Hindi.
  • Willingness to travel locally as required for coordination, supervision, training, or operational troubleshooting.

Role Overview

Working with the business the Data Governance Analyst will support core elements of our data governance capability – the business glossary and data catalogue in Microsoft Purview, data lineage and a data quality framework that moves us from finding problems in reports to preventing them at source.

jobs.title: Commodity Research Analyst - Demand
jobs.description:
Job Purpose and Impact

The Commodity Research Analyst (Demand) will conduct complex trading analytics efforts focused on Grains and Oilseeds Markets with specific focus on the livestock and feed markets. In this role, you will analyse short- and long-term livestock growth trends, margins, inventory, supply and demand fundamentals, industry developments, and government policy changes, with a particular focus on the dairy and poultry sectors in India.

You will translate livestock market insights into feed-volume forecasts, assess industrialization in the feed sector as a driver of growth, and combine feed-formulation models with industry intelligence to develop dynamic, tradable demand forecasts. The role will support trading, risk management, and asset-utilization decisions across global and local markets.

Key Accountabilities

  • Develop and execute models and tools to forecast prices, demand, relative value, and global market trends.
  • Analyse short- and long-term livestock growth, margins, and inventory, with a focus on the dairy and poultry sectors.
  • Translate livestock and feed-formulation insights into dynamic, tradable feed-volume and commodity-demand forecasts, considering feed-sector industrialization.
  • Analyse demand, pricing, and supply fundamentals across Corn, wheat, oilseeds, DDGS, and other grain and oilseed by-products.
  • Produce weekly supply-and-demand and price updates; assess India's government policies, industry developments, capacity expansion, and competitive dynamics.
  • Partner with traders, commercial teams, analysts, and stakeholders to develop market scenarios, provide actionable insights, support data and technology initiatives, and resolve issues independently.

Qualifications

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent experience, with a minimum of three years of relevant work experience.
  • Knowledge of trading, risk management, economics, and commodity supply-and-demand fundamentals, including agricultural commodity markets.
  • Strong analytical reasoning and collaboration skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information, derive accurate insights, and build consensus with global teams and local stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree with proficiency in modelling, coding, data science, and big data management, including experience developing supply-and-demand forecasts, price models, scenario analyses, or other trading analytics.
  • Knowledge or experience in feed formulation, feed-sector industrialization, particularly in India.

jobs.title: Senior Salesforce Administrator
jobs.description:
A Little About Us

Enboarder is the world's first agentic AI employee journey platform, unifying onboarding, enablement, mobility, and offboarding into a single experience layer.

With AI Assistants and AI Agents working together, Enboarder empowers HR leaders to deliver structured, personalized employee experiences at scale while freeing HR from administrative work. Enterprises like Deloitte, ING, T-Mobile, andCisco use Enboarder accelerate time-to-productivity, reduce attrition, and unlock HR capacity

The result: engaged managers, supported employees, and measurable business impact.

Role Summary

Enboarder is seeking a motivated and results-driven Senior Salesforce Administrator to join our Revenue Operations team, reporting to the Sr. Director of Revenue Operations. This pivotal role will focus on optimizing and managing our Salesforce instance and integration architecture to deliver reliable systems, clean data, and scalable processes that support pipeline generation, customer growth, and operational efficiency. If you are an experienced Salesforce professional who thrives on improving business processes and collaborating with cross-functional teams, we would love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

  • Platform Ownership & Best Practices: Serve as the go-to technical resource and subject-matter expert on Salesforce best practices, staying ahead of new platform capabilities and applying them to continuously improve our systems and processes.
  • Configuration and Customization: Customize Salesforce to meet business requirements, including the creation of custom objects, fields, validation rules, workflows, page layouts, and record types.
  • CPQ Administration: Own configuration and maintenance of Salesforce CPQ — including price books, product bundles, discount schedules, quote templates, and approval workflows — to support accurate, scalable quote-to-cash processes.
  • Automation & Process Optimization: Design, build, troubleshoot, and optimize Salesforce Flows and other automation to streamline and scale business processes as requirements evolve.
  • Solution Delivery: Translate business requirements into scalable Salesforce solutions — owning scoping, design, and partnering with stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance throughout project execution.
  • GTM Systems Integration: Maintain and support integrations between Salesforce and the broader GTM technology stack (e.g. HubSpot, Planhat, Gong, ZoomInfo, etc.), ensuring reliable data sync and system performance across the revenue organization.
  • User Enablement & Support: Provide enablement and day-to-day support to end users — including triaging and resolving CPQ / Opp-related issues, and other ad hoc requests from sales reps — to ensure teams are proficient in Salesforce and can fully leverage its capabilities.
  • Data Management & Governance: Ensure data integrity through data cleansing, de-duplication, and regular data maintenance activities, including regular account and contact association audits to maintain consistent, reliable data across Salesforce and connected systems.
  • Reports and Dashboards: Create and manage reports, dashboards, and analytics that provide visibility into funnel performance, ARR, and other key GTM metrics across sales, marketing, and customer success.
  • User Management & Security: Create and manage user profiles, roles, and permissions to ensure appropriate access levels and data security.
  • Documentation: Maintain detailed documentation of Salesforce configurations, automation, and business processes to support knowledge continuity.

Required Qualifications


  • Experienced Salesforce Administrator (likely 5+ years experience) with demonstrated ability to own and deliver complex projects independently
  • Salesforce Administrator certification and Salesforce Certified CPQ Specialist certification required; Advanced Administrator certification strongly preferred
  • Strong experience designing, building, troubleshooting, and optimizing Salesforce Flows
  • Proven experience with administrating and configuring Salesforce CPQ
  • Previous experience in the Software industry with solid understanding of ARR/Subscription business model and sales processes
  • Experience in integrating Salesforce with sales, marketing and customer success platforms (e.g. Slack, HubSpot, Gong, Planhat)
  • Experience managing Salesforce sandboxes and release processes, including Change Sets, sandbox refreshes, and org migrations
  • Experience with data management and integration concepts and data security best practices
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to effectively convey technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders

Nice To Have


  • Platform App Builder and/or Platform Developer I Certifications
  • Experience developing for the Salesforce Platform (Apex Controllers, Triggers, Batch APEX, Visualforce, SOQL, SOSL, Lightning Web Components, and other Salesforce programmatic solutions)

Interested in Joining the Team


Great, apply now! Someone from our team will reach out to you about the next steps.

The Enboarder team is made up of people who excel in a wide variety of disciplines. Each member of our team brings their unique perspective and passions to everything we do. We encourage you to apply even if you don't feel that you meet every single requirement. We're eager to meet people that believe in our mission and can contribute to our team in a variety of ways—not just candidates who check all the boxes. We want our employees to feel comfortable expressing their true selves and to come, stay, and do their best work with us. We hope you're feeling excited about the opportunity to join our team!

Creating a safe and inclusive workplace is critical to the success of Enboarder and of our employees. It's our aim to recruit, hire, and promote without bias against race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. As we learn and grow we're committed to ensuring that these ideals are at the forefront of everything we do. All information collected during our application and interview process will be stored in accordance with the Privacy Act 1988 and Australian Privacy Principles.

Please reach out to [HIDDEN TEXT] if you have any questions or concerns.

jobs.title: Senior Analyst- Skills and learning operation
jobs.description:
We are looking for a digitally savvy and operations-focused Learning Operations Associate to support the administration, governance, and continuous improvement of GSK's enterprise learning ecosystem, including SuccessFactors Learning, Degreed, ServiceNow, and connected learning technologies.

This role is critical in ensuring seamless governance, learner experiences, operational excellence, data accuracy, compliance, and scalable learning operations across global teams. The ideal candidate combines LMS expertise, analytical thinking, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills with an ability to operate in a fast-paced digital environment.

The incumbent is expected to demonstrate a high degree of ownership and accountability, leading end-to-end delivery of learning solutions from needs identification through deployment, adoption, and continuous improvement

Key Responsibilities

Learning Administration & Analytics (≈50%)

  • Manage end-to-end learning administration activities across SuccessFactors Learning (including myLearning/myLesson) and Degreed/Blend LXP platforms.
  • Configure and maintain LMS entities including items, curricula, assessments, instructors, user accounts, and user access, ensuring data integrity and compliance with standards.
  • Execute learning assignments, removals, completions, governance transactions, and bulk learning operations (including connector files) with high accuracy and adherence to defined SLAs and quality criteria.
  • Support deployment and lifecycle management of digital learning content, including multilingual course launches, external learning offerings, and Global Mandatory learning modules; provide hyper care and handle related learner queries.
  • Own service tickets in ServiceNow for training administration activities, ensuring timely resolution of learner and stakeholder requests and effective management.
  • Create, maintain, and enhance reports and dashboards (e.g., compliance, periodic and customized reports) via myLearning, ServiceNow, and GLMS ODS report views to provide actionable insights to business units and leadership.
  • Support quality assurance, release testing, and validation activities across learning technologies, integrations, and governance transaction processes.
  • Monitor automation and bot performance, identify operational risks/issues, and coordinate resolution with technical teams; record and track learning history through standardized processes

Governance, Operations & Delivery Excellence (≈50%)

  • Ensure compliance with defined learning standards, governance frameworks, and reporting requirements across all supported platforms and processes.
  • Establish and manage structured workflows (intake, review, deployment, governance cycles) aligned to defined SLAs; ensure turnaround timelines are met and communicated effectively to stakeholders.
  • Own end-to-end delivery of learning deployments and global launches, coordinating across curation, content creation, pathway build, technology, and vendor teams to ensure timely, high-quality outcomes.
  • Take accountability for delivery outcomes, ensuring alignment to SLAs, quality standards, risk management requirements, and business impact; handle escalations and drive corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
  • Perform quality checks of missed VOC and SLA tickets in line with the QC framework and use findings to drive continuous improvement.
  • Identify, support, and drive process optimization and automation opportunities in partnership with COE/Technology Managers and other global stakeholders.

Learner Experience & Stakeholder Partnership

  • Embed learner-centric design principles and design thinking methodologies to enhance usability, engagement, and effectiveness of learning journeys and pathways.
  • Gather and incorporate learner and stakeholder feedback (e.g., via 5Di or equivalent frameworks) to continuously improve learning experiences and service quality.
  • Optimize content structuring, tagging, and user journeys within learning platforms to make learning more discoverable and intuitive.
  • Stay updated on emerging trends in digital learning, including AI in L&D, and recommend practical applications for Skills & Learning Operations.
  • Provide consultations to business stakeholders for setting up learning journeys for new joiners, tool access, and other onboarding needs; partner with global stakeholders to improve processes and operational efficiency.

People Leadership & Community Support

  • Upskill Training Coordinator (TC) teams to enable businesses to be more self-sufficient in managing their learning operations.
  • Assist the TC community with daily queries and organize / facilitate regular TC drop-in sessions to share updates, best practices, and guidance.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline (e.g., Business, HR, Learning & Development, Information Systems, or related field) or equivalent experience.
  • 5 - 8 years of experience in Learning Operations, LMS Administration, or Learning Support.
  • Experience supporting enterprise learning platforms in a global environment.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  • SuccessFactors Learning Administration experience or certification.
  • Exposure to myLearning, Degreed, or Learning Experience Platforms (LXPs).
  • Experience in reporting, governance operations, or learning analytics.
  • Understanding of digital learning ecosystems.
  • Experience working in global, matrixed environments.

Technical & Digital Skills

  • Hands-on experience with LMS/LXP platforms such as SuccessFactors Learning, Degreed, or equivalent enterprise learning technologies.
  • Experience working with ServiceNow or ticket-based support environments.
  • Strong reporting and data management skills using Excel, LMS reporting tools, and dashboards.
  • Understanding digital learning operations, governance, compliance, and learning lifecycle management.
  • Familiarity with automation, system testing, and release validation processes is preferred.

Core Professional Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capability with attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage high-volume operational activities with accuracy and speed.
  • Excellent stakeholder communication and coordination skills.
  • Strong prioritization and time management in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to identify operational risks and implement practical solutions/workarounds.
  • Continuous improvement mindset with focus on learner experience and operational excellence.

Skills

Case Management Software, Continual Improvement Process, Data Analysis, Digital Fluency, Employee Experience, Learning Management Systems (LMS), Problem Solving, Program Delivery Management, Project Management

Why GSK

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we're committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Are you ready to turn complex healthcare data into decisions that accelerate access to life-changing medicines Based in Chennai, you will join a high-performing analytics team that partners closely with commercial leaders to sharpen strategy, improve execution, and ultimately benefit patients.

In this role, you will convert real-world data into clear, actionable insights that guide how we invest, prioritize, and grow across our brands.   • Collaboration and Influence: Partner with cross-functional teams to align on hypotheses, stress-test findings, and drive adoption of insights in planning and field execution.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identify capability gaps, automate manual work, mentor peers, and contribute to a shared library of models, features, and templates that raise the bar across the team.
  • Delivery Excellence: Prioritize and manage multiple projects, meet timelines with clarity on risks and dependencies, and deliver outcomes that directly support business goals.

Essential Skills/Experience

  • Quantitative Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university is required in one of the following or related fields: Engineering, Operations Research, Management Science, Economics, Statistics, Applied Math, Computer Science or Data Science. An advanced degree is preferred (Master's, MBA or PhD).
  • 2+ years of experience in Pharmaceutical / Biotech / Healthcare analytics or secondary data analysis.

  • Expertise in managing and analyzing a range of large, secondary transactional databases is required.
  • Statistical analysis and modelling background.
  • ML a plus.
  • Statistical Analysis & Modelling: Design of Experiments, Time Series, Regression, Applied Econometrics and Bayesian methods.
  • Data Mining, Predictive Modelling & Machine Learning algorithms.
  • Optimization & Simulation.

Desirable Skills/Experience

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. jobs.title: Procurement Specialist - Finance
jobs.description:
About Signant Health

At Signant Health, we help bring life-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.

Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.

If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.

About The Role

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Procurement Specialist to manage day-to-day tactical buying activities. This role is responsible for releasing purchase orders, conducting spend analysis, resolving supplier queries, and ensuring the timely and cost-effective procurement of goods and services. The ideal candidate has hands-on ERP experience, strong analytical skills, and excellent communication abilities to work effectively with internal stakeholders and external suppliers.

Key Accountabilities -

  • Handle tactical buying activity for low-value/spot purchase items, ensuring quick turnaround while maintaining compliance with procurement policy.
  • Release purchase orders (POs) accurately and in a timely manner based on approved requisitions.
  • Monitor PO status from creation through delivery, ensuring timely fulfillment and updating records as needed.
  • Conduct spend analysis to identify trends, cost-saving opportunities, and areas of non-compliance.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for supplier queries related to orders, pricing, delivery schedules, and invoicing discrepancies.
  • Maintain accurate procurement records and ensure data integrity within the ERP system.
  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders (requisitioners, finance, warehouse/receiving) to resolve order or delivery issues.
  • Maintain catalogs for items sourced through p-card program.
  • Administer p-card purchases for compliance with procurement policy.
  • Track key procurement metrics such as on-time delivery, cost savings, and quality.
  • Support supplier onboarding, maintenance of vendor master data, and basic vendor performance tracking.
  • Assist with invoice matching and resolution of discrepancies between POs, receipts, and invoices.
  • Prepare regular reports and summaries using Excel, Word, and PowerPoint for management review.
  • Ensure compliance with company procurement policies, procedures, and approval workflows.
  • Identify process improvement opportunities within tactical buying and order management workflows.

Knowledge, Skills & Attributes

Essential:

  • 3–5 years of experience in procurement, purchasing, or supply chain operations, with a focus on tactical/operational buying.
  • Hands-on experience with NetSuite or other ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics) for purchase order management and reporting.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, formulas, data analysis), Word, and PowerPoint.
  • Strong written and oral communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally with suppliers and internal stakeholders.
  • Solid understanding of procurement processes, including requisition-to-PO and PO-to-invoice workflows.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy in data entry and order processing.
  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills, particularly around spend and cost analysis.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Finance, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

Desirable:

  • Experience with NetSuite specifically is a plus.
  • Familiarity with procurement KPIs and spend analytics tools/dashboards.
  • Experience working in a multi-supplier or multi-site procurement environment.
  • Knowledge of basic contract terms and purchasing compliance requirements.

KEY COMPETENCIES

  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Customer-service orientation toward internal stakeholders and suppliers.
  • Sound judgment and integrity in handling supplier relationships and confidential pricing information.
  • Adaptability in a dynamic, fast-paced procurement environment.
  • Team player with the ability to also work independently on assigned tasks.

Why Signant Health

At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission.

We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo.

If you are looking for purpose-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it.

At Signant Health, accepting difference isn't enough — we celebrate it, we support it, and we nurture it for the benefit of our team members, our clients, and our community. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer, committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. Prior to their start date, all new hires are required to be verified through a thorough background check and identity verification to confirm eligibility for employment.

Unsolicited resumes submitted by agencies or third-party recruiters directly to hiring managers or any Signant Health employee will not be considered and will not obligate Signant Health to any fees or terms associated with the submission.

Company Description NeuroSphere Global is a network dedicated to brain health and wellness, focused on making brain care simple, practical, and empowering. The organization connects experts, resources, and communities to support people of all ages, from those aiming to sharpen their minds to individuals living with stroke, dementia, or other neurological conditions. Through education, neuro coaching, brain-friendly exercises, support groups, and digital tools, NeuroSphere Global enhances access to sustainable brain health solutions. Its mission is to provide a safe, inclusive space for knowledge, care, and connection, helping each person strive for the best possible quality of life. Team members collaborate across disciplines to deliver evidence-informed, person-centered brain health programs.

Role Description This is a part-time hybrid role for an Occupational Therapist based in Mumbai, with a combination of on-site sessions and some work-from-home tasks. The Occupational Therapist will assess clients with neurological and cognitive challenges, develop individualized intervention plans, and implement therapeutic activities to improve daily functioning and independence. Responsibilities include conducting structured therapy sessions, documenting progress, collaborating with neurologists, psychologists, and coaches, and educating clients and caregivers on practical strategies for home and community environments. The role also involves contributing to group programs, workshops, and digital resources, ensuring interventions are aligned with NeuroSphere Global's brain health framework. The Occupational Therapist will participate in interdisciplinary case discussions, maintain ethical and professional standards, and support a culture of empathy, safety, and inclusion.

Qualifications

  • Candidates should possess strong Occupational Therapy skills, including assessment, intervention planning, and evidence-informed rehabilitation for neurological and cognitive conditions.

  • Candidates should possess excellent Communication skills to interact with clients, families, and colleagues, and to deliver education and counseling in a clear, respectful manner.

  • Additional beneficial skills include experience with neuro rehabilitation, familiarity with digital health tools, cultural sensitivity in diverse communities, and the ability to work independently in a hybrid setting.
  • Strong organizational skills, accurate clinical documentation, and commitment to continuous learning and professional development are expected.

jobs.title: Cloud Operations Engineer - Technology R&D
jobs.description:
About Signant Health

At Signant Health, we help bring life-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.

Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.

If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.

About The Role

As a member of Cloud Operations team at Signant Health, the Cloud Operations Engineer will collaborate with development, release, and application teams to install, configure, deploy and manage infrastructure, application components and services in customer environments to ensure they are highly available, scalable and sustainable. You will also work with Apps Integration and the DevOps teams to identify and resolve issues and improve the overall Support Process.

What You Will Do

  • Automation for tasks like deployment of servers and application software across environment, alerts via scripting.
  • Troubleshoot to identify root cause and work towards faster work-arounds and resolution of reported issues
  • Quickly & effectively utilize existing tools and utilities to improve troubleshooting process in the long run
  • Ensure the stability and availability of Application operation components running on Public Clouds.
  • Participate in 24x7 on-call rotation to support production environments and shift work.
  • Control infrastructure costs by continually looking for opportunities to right-size servers and services
  • Migrate on-premises workloads to the cloud (AWS/Azure)
  • Respond to alerts of application instability, identifying root cause and corrective actions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • BS degree in Computer Science or related discipline
  • At least 3 years experience in a modern software development environment that is Agile and incorporates DevOps practices. Hands on experience with DevOps Tools like Jenkins, Artifactory, Maven, Git, BitBucket, TFS
  • Experience with cloud platforms like AWS and Azure; experience in Python, Terraform, PowerShell
  • Experience in containerization and orchestration (kubernetes) and configuration management using Ansible
  • Experience with Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment
  • Hands-on experience in Linux/Windows server operating systems, and Web Server technologies including IIS, Tomcat, WebLogic, WebSphere and Apache Web Server
  • Knowledge of relational databases including SQL Server, Oracle, Postgres or MySQL
  • Proven ability to work in a team-oriented environment, providing back-up support to team members & establishing/maintaining effective work relationships with co-workers within and across functional areas.
  • Experience setting up and configuring monitoring systems.
  • Ability to work independently.

Desired Qualifications

  • 5+ years experience in a modern software development environment that is Agile and incorporates DevOps practices
  • Experience migrating on-premises workloads to the cloud (AWS/Azure)
  • Hands-on experience with enterprise web server technologies such as WebLogic and WebSphere
  • Availability to participate in a 24x7 on-call rotation and shift work to support production environments
  • Willingness to undertake international or domestic travel on a need base

Why Signant Health

At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission.

We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo.

If you are looking for purpose-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it.

At Signant Health, accepting difference isn't enough — we celebrate it, we support it, and we nurture it for the benefit of our team members, our clients, and our community. Prior to their start date, all new hires are required to be verified through a thorough background check and identity verification to confirm eligibility for employment.

Unsolicited resumes submitted by agencies or third-party recruiters directly to hiring managers or any Signant Health employee will not be considered and will not obligate Signant Health to any fees or terms associated with the submission.

jobs.title: Head
jobs.description:
1. Job Purpose

To lead and drive the engineering reliability strategy across all PIL manufacturing units, ensuring zero safety incidents attributable to equipment condition, maximizing asset uptime, and optimizing lifecycle costs. This role is accountable for embedding a proactive maintenance culture, ensuring 100% statutory compliance, and horizontally deploying reliability best practices across the organization to achieve world-class manufacturing standards.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Safety & Compliance (Non-Negotiable)

  • Zero Accidents: Achieve and sustain zero reportable accidents caused by equipment or system condition failures.
  • Safety Tagging: Ensure all safety-critical equipment and systems are identified, documented, and tagged per Standard Operating Procedures (SOP).
  • Inspection & Auditing: Conduct regular field inspections to verify that maintenance practices for safety-critical equipment strictly adhere to laid-down standards.
  • SOP Development: Develop, deploy, and continuously improve SOPs, Work Instructions (WI), and Inspection/Test/Preventive Maintenance (ITPM) checklists for safety-critical assets across all PIL units.
  • Statutory Compliance: Monitor and guarantee 100% statutory compliance for all equipment registered under applicable statutory and regulatory bodies.

B. Preventive & Predictive Care

  • Maintenance Strategy: Define and ensure a robust maintenance strategy exists for all manufacturing equipment at every PIL plant.
  • Annual Planning: Plan and oversee the flawless execution of annual Preventive Maintenance (PM), Predictive Maintenance (PdM), and instrument/equipment calibration schedules per the PIL maintenance strategy.
  • System Audits: Conduct systematic audits of engineering systems compliance at PIL plants, identifying gaps and tracking them to closure.
  • Hazardous Area Integrity: Ensure strict flameproof integrity checks and audits in all hazardous areas with flammable atmospheres.
  • Asset Inspection: Oversee the inspection of safety-critical vessels, piping, and structures at predefined frequencies, executing corrective work to restore them to original design status.
  • Spares Management: Direct Unit Engineering Managers (UEMs) to routinely review and update critical spares lists, ensuring availability to eliminate unplanned downtime.
  • Bad Actor Management: Drive the Bad Actor program, delivering reliable technical solutions to eliminate repeat failures and implementing preventive actions across all sites.
  • RCA & CAPA: Lead the review and improvement of Breakdown Root Cause Analyses (RCAs), ensuring horizontal deployment of corrective actions across the organization.

C. Engineering Reliability (Lifecycle Management)

  • Design Review: Review the design basis of critical equipment at the inception stage, ensuring procurement and installation meet reliability, maintainability, and local regulatory requirements.
  • Quality Assurance: Ensure new installations strictly follow the Quality Assurance Plan (QAP), Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT), installation verification protocols, and Handover/Takeover (HOTO) procedures.
  • Performance Assurance: Provide the necessary systems and comprehensive documentation to guarantee equipment performance (safety and reliability) before regular operation commences.
  • Zoning Compliance: Verify that all new equipment complies with hazardous area zoning classifications.
  • Lifecycle Optimization: Lead lifecycle management initiatives to proactively identify low-reliability assets and execute strategic replacement/upgrade plans before failure occurs.

D. People Development & Culture

  • Capability Building: Cultivate deep reliability expertise and a proactive maintenance culture within engineering, reliability, and project teams.
  • Skill Gap Analysis: Identify technical skill gaps among the workforce; upskill and reskill staff to enable advanced asset management techniques.
  • RBTM Compliance: Ensure all maintenance personnel are trained per the Role-Based Training Matrix (RBTM); monitor yearly training plans and drive strict compliance.
  • Leadership & Inspiration: Inspire teams to shift from reactive to proactive maintenance, championing asset reliability improvements at every level.

E. Coordination & Best Practices

  • Project Integration: Provide critical reliability inputs during project scope definition, execution, and commissioning discussions, including Pre-Startup Safety Reviews (PSSR).
  • Fabrication Oversight: Ensure rigorous quality monitoring during the fabrication and installation phases of critical systems.
  • Seamless Handover: Oversee the comprehensive handover of new plants and equipment, guaranteeing the receipt of complete and accurate drawings, manuals, and documentation.
  • KPI Governance: Actively participate in IRM (Incident Review Meetings) and Functional Review Meetings (FRM); drive the implementation of assigned Maintenance Indices (MI), Key Indicators (KI), and maintenance KPIs.
  • Budgeting: Collaborate closely with UEMs and Cluster Engineering Heads (CEHs) to forecast and budget for end-of-life equipment replacements and major reliability upgrades.

4. Qualifications & Experience

Education:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, or Instrumentation Engineering (Master's degree in Reliability Engineering or Management is highly preferred).

Experience:

  • 15–18 years of progressive experience in Engineering, Maintenance, and Reliability within a large-scale manufacturing environment (preferably Chemicals, Paints, Pharmaceuticals, or FMCG).
  • Minimum 5–8 years in a senior leadership role managing multiple manufacturing units or a corporate reliability function.
  • Proven track record of managing statutory compliance (e.g., Factory Act, Boiler/Pressure Vessel regulations, Hazardous Area certifications).

Certifications (Preferred):

  • Certified Maintenance & Reliability Professional (CMRP).
  • Certified Reliability Engineer (CRE).
  • Six Sigma Black Belt / Lean Manufacturing certification.

5. Key Competencies & Behavioral Traits

  • Strategic Thinking: Ability to balance long-term lifecycle planning with day-to-day operational pressures.
  • Analytical Rigor: Deep expertise in RCA, FMEA, and statistical analysis of maintenance data.
  • Regulatory Acumen: Strong understanding of local and national safety/statutory frameworks.
  • Influential Leadership: Capable of inspiring UEMs, CEHs, and shop-floor teams to adopt reliability-first mindsets.
  • Change Management: Experience in driving cultural shifts from reactive maintenance to proactive/predictive care.
  • Financial Acumen: Competence in CAPEX/OPEX budgeting for large-scale asset replacements.

The role requires strong technical knowledge of fabrication processes, welding, metallurgy, inspection techniques, documentation, and quality assurance practices, along with the ability to coordinate effectively with engineering, production, procurement, clients, third-party inspection agencies, and certification bodies.

Quality Assurance & Inspection:

  • Ensure compliance with ASME, ASTM, EN, ISO, IS, IBR, client specifications, and internal Quality Management System (QMS) requirements.
  • Perform quality inspections across all manufacturing stages, including raw material receipt, fabrication, fit-up, welding, NDT, heat treatment, pressure testing, final visual & dimensional inspection, surface preparation, painting, packing, and preservation.

Quality Documentation:

Engineering & Material Control:

  • Review engineering drawings, BOMs, material specifications, and project requirements to ensure compliance with applicable codes and latest revisions.
