jobs.title: Associate Engineer - Digital & Drw Mgmt
jobs.description:
What's The Role

Technical Asset Support (TAS) is a key enabler for the accelerated delivery of Shell's Asset Management System and will help us to reach our ultimate potential in Downstream Manufacturing, Integrated Gas and Upstream. TAS provides high quality and cost-competitive technical resources who are not physically present at site yet are an integral part of asset teams delivering value through end-to-end SEAM / AMS work processes.

As an Associate Engineer - Digital & Drw Mgmt, you will support engineering document and drawing management in the energy industry by reviewing redline markups, updating and quality-checking technical drawings and documents, and ensuring compliance with document control standards. It requires experience with AVEVA P&ID, MicroStation, EDMS, and SharePoint, along with the ability to interpret P&IDs, isometrics, and other engineering drawings, manage metadata, validate data quality, and support intelligent P&ID conversion and maintenance activities.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Review red line markup (RLM) changes in technical drawings, collaborating with team members, incorporating revisions, and contributing to overall work quality. Work in EDMS (Doc Management tool).
  • Proficient in interpreting and understanding corrections, redline markups, and updates across related engineering drawings.
  • Proficient in AVEVA P&ID as an end user with strong practical working experience.
  • Ability to read, understand, and interpret P&IDs, Isometrics, Plot Plans, and General Arrangement (GA) drawings.
  • Strong knowledge of AVEVA P&ID application, including object attributes, relationships, and validation checks.
  • Generate and analyze engineering reports, line lists, equipment lists, valve lists, and other project deliverables from the AVEVA P&ID database.
  • Ability to identify, analyze, and resolve AVEVA P&ID application issues related to drawing connectivity, database attributes, validation errors, and reporting inconsistencies.
  • Experience in preparing engineering documentation, drawing evidence, and technical records to support Root Cause Analysis (Why-Why Analysis) and incident investigations.
  • Developed automated workflows and reports to enhance engineering productivity and data integrity.
  • Experience working in critical assessment and quality review environments, ensuring high accuracy and compliance.
  • Hands-on experience in conversion projects from non-intelligent (legacy) to intelligent P&IDs, including data structuring and tagging.
  • Ability to analyze, extract, and interpret reports generated from AVEVA P&ID for quality control and data validation.
  • Good understanding of engineering data consistency, tagging philosophy, and metadata management within P&ID systems.
  • Interpret and validate Process & Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs) based on process engineering principles, plant operations, and maintenance requirements.
  • Identify discrepancies between P&IDs, PFDs, Isometrics, Cause & Effect diagrams, and other engineering documents.
  • Perform engineering data validation to ensure compliance with asset tagging standards, drawing standards, and engineering best practices.
  • Understand process flow, equipment functions, piping systems, control philosophy, and instrumentation represented in P&IDs.
  • Analyze the impact of proposed changes on equipment, piping systems, instrumentation, and associated engineering data.

What You Bring

  • A graduate engineering degree with 3+ years of relevant industry standard experience in combination of Process, mechanical, instrumentation & electrical disciplines.
  • Ability to work effectively under pressure during peak workloads and provide flexible support across related processes within team scope.
  • Hands-on experience with AVEVA P&ID and MicroStation is mandatory.
  • Performed data validation, consistency checks, and quality assurance of P&ID deliverables.
  • Support Team Leads with drawing-related queries and technical support needs, including training site staff on software and request tools, and assisting with pilot tests and demonstrations.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to deliver analytical solutions are essential.
  • Strong stakeholder management and time management skills are required.
  • Candidates should demonstrate strong learning agility and a growth mindset.
  • Excellent communication skills and a quick learner. Be a good team player. Ability to prioritize and ensure delivery of priorities for the area of responsibility. Flexible and adaptable to change, with a track record of demonstrating initiative, analytical capabilities and problem-solving.
  • Ability to apply engineering best practices, codes, and standards to identify issues, recommend improvements, and implement solutions.
  • Excellent stakeholder management with business interface exposure
  • Strong interpersonal leadership skills are critical due to the requirement for effective communication of complex issues across multiple offices and teams.
  • Ability to adapt to changing priorities and manage multiple projects and programs simultaneously.
  • Ability to independently, resourcefully, and creatively research and implement new solutions.
  • Ability to engage and effectively communicate at all levels inside and outside Shell and within different cultural settings.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, ability to challenge and ability to build internal and external relationships based on trust and to integrate across multiple functions.
  • Competitive applicants will have a proven track record of delivery in Asset and/or Project.
  • While the hubs will remain the core locations for SEAM, we will continue to use a distributed working model. This means that our preference is to appoint the best candidate for the job on local terms working virtually from their base country.
  • This role does not require global travel but may require flexibility in working hours to support collaboration across time zones, influence stakeholders, and drive business performance. Such flexibility will be considered with sensitivity to diverse family circumstances.

What We Offer

You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You'll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You'll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself.

  • Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.
  • Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead.
  • Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices.
  • Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise.
  • Achieve your balance in a values-led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.
  • Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply.
  • Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and
  • international teams.
  • Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes.

Description

TOC (Transportation Operation Center) is the central command and control center for Transportation Execution across the Amazon Supply Chain network supporting multiple geographies like NA, India and EU. It ensures hassle free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, TOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem solving TOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data.

Overall, TOC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon's ability to serve its customers on time.

Purview of a Trans Ops Specialist

A Trans Ops Specialist at TOC facilitates flow of information between different stakeholders (Trans Carriers/Hubs/Warehouses) and resolves any potential issues that impacts customer experience and business continuity. Trans Ops Specialist at TOC works across two verticals – Inbound and Outbound operations.

Inbound Operations deals with Vendor/Carrier/FC relationship, ensuring that the freight is picked-up on time and is delivered at FC as per the given appointment. Trans Ops Specialist on Inbound addresses any potential issues occurring during the lifecycle of pick-up to delivery.

Outbound Operations deals with FC/Carrier/Carrier Hub relationship, ensuring that the truck leaves the FC in order to delivery customer orders as per promise. Trans Ops Specialist on Outbound addresses any potential issues occurring during the lifecycle of freight leaving the FC and reaching customer premises.

A Trans Ops Specialist provides timely resolution to the issue in hand by researching and querying internal tools and by taking real-time decisions. An ideal candidate should be able to understand the requirements/be able to analyze data and notice trends and be able to drive Customer Experience without compromising on time. The candidate should have the basic understanding of Logistics and should be able to communicate clearly in the written and oral form. Trans Ops Specialist should be able to ideate process improvements and should have the zeal to drive them to conclusion.

Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To

  • Communication with external customers (Carriers, Vendors/Suppliers) and internal customers (Retail, Finance, Software Support, Fulfillment Centers)
  • Ability to pull data from numerous databases (using Excel, Access, SQL and/or other data management systems) and to perform ad hoc reporting and analysis as needed is a plus.
  • Develop and/or understand performance metrics to assist with driving business results.
  • Ability to scope out business and functional requirements for the Amazon technology teams who create and enhance the software systems and tools are used by TOC.

We are seeking a Director, Patient Safety Medical Writing to join our team. As a Director, Patient Safety Medical Writing, you will provide operational leadership for your assigned area within the Patient Safety department, ensuring quality and compliance across operations, medical writing, project management, or quality pillars. This position plays a key role in managing team development, quality initiatives, compliance activities, and process improvements while collaborating across teams to maintain and enhance Patient Safety standards. jobs.title: LEO Support Quality and Continous Improvement Manager, Leo Customer Support
jobs.description:
Description

Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

We are seeking a Leo Support Quality Manager to define and lead the quality assurance function for Amazon Leo's Customer Experience & Support organization. This role owns the end-to-end quality framework spanning both B2B (Enterprise Partner, Telco, B2B2X) and B2C (Direct-to-Consumer) support channels. You will establish the standards, measurement systems, and continuous improvement programs that ensure every customer and partner interaction meets Amazon's bar for excellence.

The ideal candidate is a certified Six Sigma Black Belt with deep experience driving quality transformation in complex, multi-channel support environments — ideally within the SATCOM or ISP/Telco industry.

Note : This position may require access to information, technology, or hardware that is subject to export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR) and the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). Employment in this position is contingent upon obtaining any required export licenses or other approvals from the United States government. As such, the successful candidate must be eligible to obtain any necessary export licenses or approvals based on their nationality, citizenship, and any other factors considered by the applicable export control regulations

Key job responsibilities

Directly evaluate and improve the quality of support interactions including satellite network troubleshooting, connectivity diagnostics, account management, and service configuration support delivered to Leo customers. Establish mechanisms to systematically identify and drive resolution of repetitive or serious customer support problems. Simplify and reduce operational expenditure through quality-driven process optimization.

Quality Framework Ownership: Define, implement, and govern the end-to-end quality assurance framework across all support tiers (Tier 1–3), channels, and customer segments (B2B and B2C). Establish scoring rubrics, calibration cadences, and audit methodologies aligned to customer experience outcomes.

Six Sigma & Continuous Improvement: Lead structured improvement programs using Six Sigma (DMAIC/DMADV), root cause analysis, and statistical process control. Identify systemic defects in support processes and drive measurable reductions in defect rates, repeat contacts, and escalations.

KPI Definition & Governance: Define and track quality KPIs including Quality Assurance scores, Critical Error Accuracy, First Contact Resolution, CSAT/NPS correlation to quality, and cost-of-poor-quality metrics. Establish governance through regular operational reviews, trend reporting, and executive dashboards.

Voice of Customer Integration: Partner with Voice of Customer and Customer Insights teams to connect quality findings with customer sentiment data. Translate feedback signals into actionable quality improvement initiatives.

Calibration & Standardization: Drive calibration programs across internal and outsourced support teams to ensure consistent quality evaluation. Establish and maintain quality standards documentation, scoring guidelines, and training feedback loops.

Support for Technical & Partner Channels: Develop quality standards tailored to technical support interactions (network troubleshooting, integration support, API/tooling assistance) for Enterprise Partner (B2B2X), Telco, and SATCOM customers — ensuring technical accuracy and resolution quality are measured alongside soft skills.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Training, Content, Operations, and Product teams to close quality gaps. Influence support tooling, knowledge management, and workflow design based on quality insights.

Vendor & Outsource Quality Management: Establish quality contractual requirements, monitoring frameworks, and performance management processes for outsourced support partners. Drive accountability through data transparency and joint improvement plans.

Strategic Roadmap: Create the quality program roadmap; influence senior leadership on investment priorities, technology enablement (speech analytics, AI-assisted QA), and resource allocation through data-driven business cases.

  • 5+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
  • 5+ years of team management experience
  • 5+ years of cross functional project delivery experience
  • 5+ years of program or project management experience
  • Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
  • Six Sigma Black Belt certification

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership

jobs.title: Engineer - Quality Management
jobs.description:
Department

Quality Control

Reports To

Manager / Quality Head – Quality Control

Location

JSW Cement Limited, Nandyal

Shift

Shift cum General Shift

Job Purpose

To perform chemical analysis of raw materials, fuels, clinker, cement and other process samples using laboratory analytical instruments, ensuring timely and accurate results to support process control and maintain product quality. The Chemist is responsible for laboratory testing, equipment maintenance, quality assurance activities, and compliance with safety and quality management systems while working in both shift and general shift schedules.

Key Roles & Responsibilities

  • Chemical Analysis
  • Perform routine chemical analysis of limestone, laterite, bauxite, iron ore, raw meal, kiln feed, clinker, gypsum, fly ash, slag, pozzolana, cement, coal, pet coke, AFR, and other raw materials.
  • Carry out analysis using XRF, wet chemistry, titration, gravimetric methods, and instrumental techniques.
  • Prepare fused beads and pressed pellets for XRF analysis.
  • Verify analytical accuracy using certified reference materials (CRMs).
  • Ensure timely reporting of laboratory results.
  • Quality Control
  • Monitor chemical parameters including:

○ Lime Saturation Factor (LSF), Silica Modulus (SM), Alumina Modulus (AM)

○ Free Lime, LOI, Insoluble Residue

○ CaO, SiO₂, Al₂O₃, Fe₂O₃, MgO, SO₃, Na₂O, K₂O, Chloride

  • Compare analytical results with quality control limits.
  • Immediately report abnormal results to Production, CCR and Quality Management.
  • Assist in process adjustments to maintain consistent clinker and cement quality.
  • XRF Laboratory Operations
  • Operate and monitor XRF spectrometer.
  • Perform daily calibration and standardization.
  • Prepare calibration samples and conduct drift correction and performance verification.
  • Troubleshoot basic instrument issues.
  • Coordinate with service engineers for preventive maintenance.
  • Wet Chemistry
  • Conduct wet chemical analysis as per SOPs.
  • Prepare and standardize laboratory reagents.
  • Perform volumetric and gravimetric analysis.
  • Validate XRF results through wet chemistry when required.
  • Sample Preparation
  • Receive and identify production samples.
  • Dry, crush, pulverize, sieve and homogenize samples.
  • Operate sample preparation equipment safely.
  • Prevent sample contamination and mix-up.
  • Physical Testing Support
  • Assist in cement physical testing, including:

○ Blaine Fineness, Residue / Sieve Analysis

○ Initial & Final Setting Time, Soundness

○ Mortar Compressive Strength, Standard Consistency, Density (as required)

  • Data Management & Documentation
  • Record laboratory data accurately in LIMS, ERP or laboratory registers.
  • Prepare daily, weekly and monthly laboratory reports.
  • Maintain calibration records, QC charts and analytical logs.
  • Ensure traceability of all laboratory samples and results.
  • Instrument Maintenance
  • Perform daily instrument health checks and monitor laboratory equipment performance.
  • Maintain calibration schedules.
  • Coordinate preventive and breakdown maintenance.
  • Ensure availability of laboratory consumables and chemicals.
  • Quality Assurance
  • Follow ISO 9001 quality management requirements.
  • Participate in internal quality audits.
  • Maintain laboratory documentation according to QA procedures.
  • Support method validation and uncertainty evaluation.
  • Participate in inter-laboratory comparison and proficiency testing.
  • Process Monitoring
  • Monitor raw mix chemistry and kiln feed quality.
  • Support kiln optimization through timely laboratory feedback.
  • Monitor clinker quality trends and cement quality before dispatch.
  • Shift Responsibilities
  • Handle all laboratory activities independently during assigned shifts.
  • Ensure continuous sample testing and maintain shift handover records.
  • Coordinate with CCR operators and production personnel.
  • Escalate quality deviations immediately.
  • General Shift Responsibilities
  • Assist in laboratory planning, scheduling and review of analytical data.
  • Train laboratory technicians and trainee chemists.
  • Prepare SOPs and work instructions.
  • Support laboratory improvement projects.
  • Participate in quality meetings and process review discussions.
  • Coordinate with production, mines, and raw material handling teams to ensure compliance with quality specifications.
  • Safety & Housekeeping
  • Follow laboratory safety procedures and use appropriate PPE.
  • Handle acids, alkalis, gases and chemicals safely.
  • Ensure proper storage and labeling of chemicals.
  • Maintain 5S standards in the laboratory.
  • Dispose of chemical waste according to environmental regulations.
  • Report unsafe conditions, incidents, and near misses.

Required Qualifications & Experience

 Educational Qualifications

  • B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Industrial Chemistry, or a related field.
  • Additional training in Cement Chemistry or Analytical Instrumentation is preferred.

Experience

  • 5–10 years of experience in a cement plant chemical laboratory.
  • Experience with XRF operation, wet chemistry and laboratory quality systems.
  • Familiarity with LIMS/ERP systems is an advantage.
  • Willingness to work in rotating shifts and general shift assignments as per requirement.

Required Skills

  • Strong knowledge of cement manufacturing chemistry.
  • Expertise in XRF analysis and sample preparation.
  • Knowledge of wet chemical analysis and analytical calculations.
  • Familiarity with ASTM, BIS (IS), EN and ISO standards for cement testing.
  • Proficiency in MS Excel, Word and laboratory data management software.
  • Good analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.

jobs.title: Global Safety Associate Medical Director
jobs.description:
The Global Safety Therapeutic Areas serve as the safety experts for all Amgen products globally and are accountable for the safety strategy and major safety deliverables for each Amgen product. Leaders in the therapeutic area safety teams are accountable for the staff management and resource allocations in Global Patient Safety and support GPS in the establishment of a highly effective global safety organization in full compliance to worldwide regulations. 

Job Summary

The Global Safety Officer (GSO) for Marketed Products serves 2 roles: 1) safety expert of the assigned marketed product(s), establishing the strategy, direction, and priorities of pharmacovigilance activities. The GSO is accountable for the overall safety profile and all product-related decisions and deliverables for assigned marketed products. 

The GSO leads the Safety Analysis Team (SAT), Global Safety Team (GST) and is a core member of the Executive Safety Committee (ESC). The GSO also is a member of the Evidence Generation Team. The GSO will be assigned as delegate for the TAH as needed and has management of Global Safety Scientists.

Key Activities

Applicable tasks may vary by product(s) assigned.

Product safety profile, benefit-risk evaluation, and risk communication:

  • Accountable for the Development and maintenance of core reference safety information (e.g Core safety information portions of Core Data Sheet [CDS])

  • Participate in product label process

Clinical trial safety:

  • Develop a strategy as needed for preparing and updating safety related portions of the Informed Consent Form and other study related documents for trials conducted post marketing.
  • Develop strategy for and lead preparation of responses to safety-related inquiries from regulatory agencies and ethics committees
  • Perform signal detection activities for developmental products under the direction of the GSO leading the product in development.

Signal detection, evaluation, and management:

  • Documents work as required in the safety information management system

Risk management and minimization:

  • Ensure timely preparation, content, and quality of new or updated risk management plan (RMP) document
  • Develop a strategy for safety risk minimization measures globally (including US REMS if applicable)

Periodic (aggregate) safety reporting:

  • Ensure timely preparation and quality of periodic reports (e.g., PSUR/PBRER)

Amgen commercialization process:

  • Accountable for disseminating and representing corporate and departmental information to staff and ensuring understanding and adherence to changes
  • Development plans for staff created annually and reviewed quarterly

Knowledge and Skills

  • Advanced understanding of interfaces across various pharmacovigilance and risk management processes

  • Safety data capture in clinical development and post-market settings

jobs.title: Brand Manager
jobs.description:
ANKURAM IVFJOB DESCRIPTION – BRAND MANAGERMarketing, Doctor Relations & Business Growth

Department: Marketing & Business Development

Designation: Brand Manager – Marketing & Business Growth

Reporting To: Director / Management

Location: Ranchi, Jharkhand

Employment Type: Full-Time

1. POSITION SUMMARY

ANKURAM IVF is looking for an experienced, dynamic and result-oriented Brand Manager – Marketing & Business Growth to lead the overall marketing and business development activities of the organization.

This is a senior marketing role with responsibilities similar to a Marketing Head, with particular emphasis on doctor referrals, professional relationship management, hospital and clinic tie-ups, patient acquisition, territory development, brand building and revenue growth.

The Brand Manager will be responsible for developing and executing strategies that increase the visibility, reputation and market presence of ANKURAM IVF and ultimately contribute to growth in fertility consultations, IVF cycles and revenue.

The candidate must be capable of working independently, managing a marketing team, building strong professional relationships with doctors and identifying new opportunities for business growth.

2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIESA. Doctor Referral & Relationship Management

Doctor relationship management will be one of the most important responsibilities of this position.

The Brand Manager will develop and maintain strong, professional and long-term relationships with Gynecologists, Obstetricians, Physicians, Urologists, General Practitioners and other healthcare professionals who can contribute to the fertility referral network.

Responsibilities include:

  • Identify high-potential doctors and develop them as active referral partners.
  • Regularly visit and engage with referring doctors.
  • Develop a structured doctor relationship management system.
  • Track doctor-wise referrals, consultations, conversions and IVF cycles.
  • Identify doctors whose referrals have declined and develop reactivation strategies.
  • Continuously add new doctors to the ANKURAM IVF referral network.
  • Develop doctor-specific engagement plans.
  • Organize professional meetings, CME programs, scientific sessions and doctor networking events.
  • Maintain regular communication and professional relationships with referring doctors.
  • Understand doctors expectations and identify opportunities to improve the referral experience.

The objective is to build a strong, ethical and sustainable doctor referral ecosystem for ANKURAM IVF.

3. HOSPITAL, CLINIC & INSTITUTIONAL TIE-UPS

The Brand Manager will identify and develop strategic relationships with:

  • Hospitals
  • Nursing homes
  • Gynecology clinics
  • Maternity centres
  • Diagnostic centres
  • Pathology laboratories
  • Corporate organizations
  • Healthcare institutions
  • Community organizations

The candidate will be responsible for identifying potential partners, initiating discussions, developing professional tie-ups and monitoring the business generated through such relationships.

The objective is to expand ANKURAM IVF's referral network beyond individual doctors and establish a wider healthcare ecosystem.

4. BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT & PATIENT GROWTH

The Brand Manager will have direct responsibility for developing strategies for patient and business growth.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Develop monthly, quarterly and annual marketing plans.
  • Increase fertility consultations and IVF cycles.
  • Identify new sources of patient acquisition.
  • Develop strategies for increasing referrals and repeat business.
  • Identify underperforming geographical areas.
  • Develop territory-wise growth plans.
  • Identify new markets for ANKURAM IVF.
  • Monitor patient acquisition and conversion.
  • Work with the counselling team to improve consultation-to-treatment conversion.
  • Analyse reasons for patient drop-outs and recommend corrective measures.
  • Identify opportunities to increase revenue through better market penetration.
  • Develop innovative marketing strategies beyond traditional marketing methods.

The Brand Manager will be expected to focus on business outcomes rather than simply activity numbers.

5. FIELD & OFFLINE MARKETING

The Brand Manager will lead and supervise the offline marketing activities of ANKURAM IVF, including:

  • Doctor visits
  • Hospital visits
  • Infertility awareness camps
  • Community awareness programs
  • Rural outreach
  • Sahiya/health-worker engagement
  • Corporate awareness programs
  • Referral meetings
  • Local events
  • Outdoor branding
  • Poster campaigns
  • Hyperlocal marketing
  • New territory development

The candidate should continuously identify innovative methods of reaching potential patients and referral sources.

The objective is to ensure that field marketing generates qualified patients and measurable business, rather than simply increasing the number of activities.

6. BRAND MANAGEMENT

The Brand Manager will be responsible for strengthening the overall brand presence of ANKURAM IVF.

Responsibilities include:

  • Develop and maintain consistent brand positioning.
  • Improve brand visibility among doctors and the public.
  • Develop concepts for infertility awareness campaigns.
  • Plan offline brand-building initiatives.
  • Coordinate with the creative and digital marketing teams.
  • Ensure consistency of brand communication.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen ANKURAM IVF's position as a trusted fertility care provider.
  • Monitor market perception and competitor positioning.

The Brand Manager should continuously identify new ideas that can differentiate ANKURAM IVF from competing fertility centres.

7. DIGITAL MARKETING – STRATEGIC COORDINATION ONLY

Digital marketing will be handled by a separate digital marketing team/agency.

The Brand Manager will not be responsible for daily digital marketing execution.

However, the Brand Manager will provide strategic inputs based on market and field-level observations.

Responsibilities include:

  • Suggest ideas for digital campaigns.
  • Recommend topics based on patient and doctor requirements.
  • Share successful field campaigns with the digital team.
  • Suggest geographical and audience opportunities.
  • Provide feedback on the quality of digital leads.
  • Coordinate offline and digital marketing campaigns.
  • Review whether digital activities are aligned with the overall ANKURAM IVF brand strategy.

The Brand Manager will not be responsible for daily social media posting, graphic designing, video editing, SEO, Google Ads or Meta Ads execution.

8. MARKETING TEAM MANAGEMENT

The Brand Manager will lead and supervise the marketing/business development team.

Responsibilities include:

  • Set monthly targets.
  • Allocate territories.
  • Monitor field visits.
  • Monitor doctor and hospital visits.
  • Review referral performance.
  • Conduct weekly performance meetings.
  • Train team members in doctor relationship management and communication.
  • Monitor individual performance.
  • Identify underperforming areas and employees.
  • Develop corrective action plans.
  • Motivate the team to achieve business targets.

The Brand Manager should create a target-driven and performance-oriented marketing culture.

9. CRM, MIS & DATA ANALYSIS

All marketing activities must be systematically recorded and analysed.

The Brand Manager will monitor:

  • Doctor visits
  • Doctor referrals
  • Hospital visits
  • New tie-ups
  • Leads
  • Consultations
  • IVF conversions
  • IVF cycles
  • Revenue
  • Area-wise performance
  • Centre-wise performance
  • Marketing expenditure
  • Referral source
  • Conversion rate

Monthly reports should clearly identify what is working, what is not working and where additional resources should be invested.

10. COMPETITOR & MARKET INTELLIGENCE

The Brand Manager will regularly monitor:

  • Competitor IVF centres
  • New fertility clinics
  • Competitor doctor networks
  • Pricing and packages
  • Marketing campaigns
  • Referral strategies
  • New centre openings
  • Local brand visibility
  • Competitor positioning

The candidate should provide practical recommendations to management based on market intelligence.

11. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS

Performance will be measured primarily through measurable growth.

Primary KPIs
  • Growth in IVF consultations
  • Growth in IVF cycles
  • Revenue growth
  • Increase in active referring doctors
  • Increase in doctor referrals
  • Doctor referral conversion
  • New hospital/clinic tie-ups
  • Growth in new geographical territories
  • Marketing ROI
  • Marketing team target achievement
Secondary KPIs
  • Doctor engagement activities
  • CME and professional meetings
  • Awareness programs
  • Field productivity
  • CRM compliance
  • Competitor intelligence
  • Brand visibility
12. CANDIDATE PROFILEEducation

MBA/PGDM in Marketing or Business Development preferred. Healthcare Management qualification will be an advantage.

Experience

5–10 years of experience in healthcare marketing, business development or related fields.

Candidates with experience in IVF, fertility, hospitals, gynecology, maternity or diagnostics will be preferred.

Candidates having an established professional network among Gynecologists and healthcare professionals in Ranchi/Jharkhand will receive strong preference.

Required Skills
  • Excellent communication and networking skills
  • Strong doctor relationship management
  • Business development capability
  • Leadership and team management
  • Negotiation skills
  • Strategic thinking
  • Field marketing experience
  • Data analysis
  • Presentation skills
  • Strong follow-up ability
  • Target orientation
  • Willingness to travel
  • Ability to work independently
13. CORE EXPECTATION

This is not a conventional Marketing Executive position.

ANKURAM IVF is looking for a person who can think and perform like a Marketing Head and Business Growth Leader.

The candidate should be capable of:

Building Doctor Relationships → Developing Referral Networks → Creating Hospital Tie-ups → Expanding Territories → Generating Patients → Improving Conversion → Increasing IVF Cycles → Growing Revenue.

The Brand Manager will be expected to take end-to-end ownership of marketing growth, identify problems independently, develop solutions and execute them effectively.

PRIMARY OBJECTIVEBuild the ANKURAM IVF brand, strengthen the doctor referral network, expand the market, generate quality patients and deliver sustainable growth in IVF cycles and revenue.

jobs.title: Compliance Manager - APAC
jobs.description:
Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

Environmental Conditions

Office

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you'll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world's toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

As a Compliance Manager within the Audits and Inspections team, you will be responsible for managing all aspects of GxP audits and Regulatory Authority inspections for the company, investigator sites, and clients. The Compliance Manager leads and/or reviews complex internal and external audits and inspections to ensure compliance with established quality assurance processes, standards, global regulatory guidelines and/or client contractual obligations. Majority of the work is focused on the APAC region; however, inspection support in other regions is also in scope.

What you will do:

  • Provide consultation to project teams and clients on GxP audit and inspection readiness, preparation, management, and follow-up activities.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for audit and inspection-related discussions with clients.
  • Support client audits and GxP regulatory authority inspections of the company, investigator sites, and sponsors, including risk assessment and mitigation strategies, training of involved staff and conducting mock interviews, internal preparation, pre-inspection / mock inspection activities, review of documentation requested by inspectors, audit/inspection hosting and facilitation, and post-inspection follow-up.
  • Lead, review, and approve reports for a variety of client, internal, or GxP audits and regulatory inspections.
  • Support project teams in investigating root causes of findings/non-conformances and in developing CAPAs to address identified issues; follow up on action implementation, effectiveness checks, and the collection and review of supporting evidence.
  • Contribute to lessons learned discussions and participate in company-wide improvement initiatives.
  • Develop and effectively share guidance and reference information, repositories, and communication channels including policies, procedures, guidance documents, or quality management systems training.
  • Lead process improvement initiatives and collaborate with a variety of cross functional staff to ensure appropriate execution and completion and continuous improvement.
  • Develop tools and other materials for tracking of compliance management activities and analyse trends.
  • Mentor less experienced staff and serve as project lead for group projects.
  • Identify and resolve issues impacting the quality and/or integrity of clinical research programs, determine root cause of non-conformance and develop strategies to address issues.
  • Prepare and present audit findings and/or other related information at departmental, internal operations or client meetings.

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent and relevant formal academic / vocational qualification
  • Preferred Fields of Study: Biology, Pharmacy or related
  • 5+ years of quality assurance experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job or equivalent combination of education, training, & experience.
  • 1+ years of experience in management/leadership roles preferred

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

  • Extensive knowledge of GxP, with GCP required, along with a strong understanding of applicable regional clinical research regulations, requirements and guidelines, along with applicable global guidelines / requirements
  • Proven expertise and experience in quality management systems and regulatory frameworks, conducting internal audits, supporting, hosting/management of client audits and GxP regulatory inspections across the region
  • Proven experience in root cause analysis
  • Strong problem solving, critical thinking, risk assessment and impact analysis abilities
  • Detail oriented with ability to deal with multiple and changing priorities
  • Exceptional communication (verbal and written) and presentation skills (including appropriate use of medical and scientific terminology)
  • Strong negotiation and conflict management skills
  • Ability to effectively mentor and provide direction to staff and to work independently or in a team environment
  • Strong organizational and time management skills, flexibility and ability to multi-task and prioritize complex demands/workload
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and compliance-related software. Veeva QMS experience is a plus

Why Join Us

When you join Thermo Fisher Scientific, you become part of a global team that values passion, innovation, and a commitment to scientific excellence. You'll work in an environment where collaboration and development are part of the everyday experience—and where your contributions truly make a difference.

Apply today to help us deliver tomorrow's breakthroughs.

jobs.title: Test Architect / Tech Lead - CTI MD Tech (GRA/GSC)
functions: Global Regulatory Affairs And Scientific Communications
jobs.description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it's work worth doing. If you're driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.

Test Architect / Tech Lead - CTI MD Tech (GRA/GSC)

Global Regulatory Affairs (GRA)

  • Global Scientific Communications (GSC)
  • CTI-MD Tech@Lilly

Global Regulatory Affairs (GRA) and Global Scientific Communications (GSC) together own how Lilly's medicines move through health authority review, stay compliant once approved, and get communicated externally — spanning regulatory submissions, labelling, clinical trial disclosures, and scientific publications. Both functions operate under strict compliance and audit-readiness requirements, and are scaling agentic and generative AI capabilities across their platforms, creating a growing need for consistent, reusable test automation and AI quality engineering practices across GRA and GSC.

The Test Architect / Tech Lead (R4), GRA/GSC is accountable for building the test automation frameworks and reusable testing components that drive quality engineering across GRA and GSC, with particular depth in evaluating and validating generative AI and agentic systems. The role also carries tech lead accountability: designing and building the application architecture for GRA/GSC platforms and owning delivery of key initiatives end to end, not solely test strategy. This is a single R4 path role by design: test standards, automation architecture, and application architecture need to be set once and held consistently rather than fragmented across roles without the seniority to drive strategic evolution end to end. The role owns the build-out of reusable frameworks and components, drives test automation initiatives, leads delivery of key technical initiatives, and manages stakeholders to ensure quality and AI evaluation rigor scale consistently as GRA/GSC's agentic platforms mature.

Path/Level: R4 (Test Architect / Tech Lead)

Key Responsibilities

  • Reusable Test Framework Development — design, build, and own reusable test automation frameworks and shared components (libraries, harnesses, fixtures, evaluation pipelines) that can be adopted consistently across GRA and GSC rather than rebuilt per program.
  • Application Architecture & Design — design and build the application architecture for GRA/GSC platforms as a tech lead — defining technical approach, component design, and integration patterns alongside the test and quality strategy.
  • Delivery Ownership — act as tech lead for key technical initiatives, owning end-to-end delivery — from architecture and build through testing and release — and holding accountability for outcomes, not just quality gates.
  • Automation Enablement — drive test automation efforts across GRA and GSC, identifying opportunities to replace manual and duplicated testing effort with shared, scalable automation.
  • AI & Agentic Quality Engineering — build and own evaluation frameworks for generative AI and agentic systems — groundedness validation, hallucination detection, relevance/accuracy testing, and RAG and LLM evaluation — using tools such as RAGAS, DeepEval, and LLM-as-a-Judge approaches.
  • Test Initiative Leadership — define and drive test initiatives end to end — scoping, prioritizing, and delivering automation and quality-engineering improvements across concurrent teams and workstreams.
  • Stakeholder Management — partner with engineering leads, product owners, and quality/compliance stakeholders to align on architecture, delivery plans, test strategy, and adoption of shared frameworks.
  • Observability & Trace Analysis — establish agent observability and trace-analysis practices to diagnose failures in multi-agent and agentic workflows, and feed findings back into architecture, framework, and test design.
  • Synthetic Test Data & Coverage Strategy — build synthetic test data generation capabilities and apply risk-based prioritization to determine test depth and coverage across critical workflows.
  • Talent Development & Mentorship — mentor test engineers and technical leads, building a team capable of operating independently on architecture, framework design, automation, and AI evaluation.

Technical & Strategic Expertise Areas


Application & Solution Architecture

  • AI Evaluation Frameworks (RAGAS, DeepEval, LLM-as-a-Judge)
  • Groundedness Validation
  • Hallucination Detection
  • Relevance & Accuracy Testing
  • Generative AI Testing
  • Agentic AI Testing
  • RAG Validation
  • LLM Evaluation
  • Prompt Engineering & Context Validation
  • Multi-Agent Systems
  • Agentic Frameworks
  • AI Quality Engineering
  • End-to-End Test Automation
  • API & Integration Testing
  • Agent Observability & Trace Analysis
  • Synthetic Test Data Generation
  • Python
  • JavaScript/TypeScript

Basic Qualifications


  • Proven track record architecting and scaling test automation frameworks across multiple concurrent programs.
  • Demonstrated experience designing application architecture and leading end-to-end delivery of key technical initiatives as a tech lead.
  • Demonstrated experience driving technical direction for AI-driven or agentic platforms, not solely test execution.
  • Experience setting quality/validation standards enforced consistently across distributed or vendor-delivered teams.
  • Track record of operating with seniority across functional boundaries in ambiguous, fast-scaling transformation environments.

Additional Qualifications / Competencies


  • Experience in both Global Regulatory Affairs and Scientific Communications, or comparable regulated pharma functions.
  • Familiarity with Regulatory Content and Submission Management, Veeva RIM, and regulatory platforms.
  • Experience with document and content management ecosystems.
  • Background in pharma and GxP-regulated environments.

No matter where you sit in the organization you can make a lasting impact on the projects you work on, the teams and committees you join and our business.

We offer competitive pay and benefits, well-being programs to support you and your family, and the development resources you need to advance your career.

When you join us, you will connect and collaborate with a global network of experts – planners, designers, engineers, scientists, consultants, program and construction managers – leading the change toward a more sustainable and equitable future. Join us and let's get started.

Job Description

Position Overview:

The Senior QA/QC Manager shall report to the Project Director / Project Head and serve as the PMC lead for Quality Assurance and Quality Control management across the airport development project.

The role shall be responsible for establishing, implementing, monitoring, and continually improving project-wide Quality Management Systems (QMS), quality governance frameworks, inspection and testing regimes, compliance monitoring processes, and quality performance improvement initiatives throughout the project lifecycle.

The position shall provide leadership and oversight to ensure that all design, construction, testing, commissioning, and handover activities are executed in accordance with project specifications, approved drawings, contract requirements, statutory regulations, aviation standards, applicable codes and international best practices.

The Senior QA/QC Manager shall proactively identify quality risks, implement preventive and corrective measures, promote a culture of quality excellence across all project participants, and support the successful delivery of airport infrastructure meeting the highest standards of safety, performance, durability, reliability, and operational readiness.

Key Responsibilities:

Quality Leadership & Governance
  • Develop, implement and maintain the Project Quality Management Plan and Quality Assurance Framework.
  • Establish project-wide quality governance structures, reporting mechanisms, quality objectives, and performance monitoring systems.
  • Provide strategic quality leadership and guidance to the Project Director and Project Leadership Team.
  • Promote a culture of quality excellence, continuous improvement, and proactive quality management across all stakeholders.
  • Lead and mentor QA/QC engineers, inspectors, laboratory personnel, and quality teams deployed across the project.

Quality Assurance Management
  • Establish and maintain ISO 9001 compliant Quality Management Systems for project delivery.
  • Review and approve Contractor Quality Plans, Method Statements, Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs), Quality Procedures, and Quality Manuals.
  • Ensure quality requirements are integrated into project planning, procurement, design reviews, construction, commissioning, and handover activities.
  • Monitor contractor and supplier compliance with approved quality systems and contractual quality requirements.
  • Review quality management procedures and recommend improvements where necessary

Quality Control & Inspection Management
  • Oversee inspection and testing activities for civil, structural, architectural, finishing, MEP, utilities, airfield and associated infrastructure works.
  • Ensure compliance of materials, workmanship, installations, equipment, and systems with project specifications and approved standards.
  • Monitor laboratory testing, field testing, inspections, mock-ups, factory acceptance tests (FAT), site acceptance tests (SAT), testing and commissioning activities.
  • Review quality records, test certificates, inspection reports, calibration records, and compliance documentation.
  • Ensure timely identification and resolution of quality deficiencies.

Risk Management & Non-Conformance Control
  • Establish systems for identification, monitoring and mitigation of quality risks.
  • Manage NCRs, observations, deviations, concession requests, corrective actions, preventive actions and root cause analysis processes.
  • Lead investigations into recurring quality issues and implement sustainable improvement measures.
  • Monitor quality trends and develop proactive risk mitigation strategies.
  • Advise project leadership on critical quality issues and recommended corrective actions.

Testing, Commissioning & Handover Quality
  • Oversee quality assurance requirements during testing, commissioning, integrated systems testing and operational readiness activities.
  • Ensure commissioning documentation and quality records are properly maintained.
  • Monitor snagging, defect management, punch-list closure and readiness assessments.
  • Verify compliance of completed facilities prior to handover and operational acceptance.
  • Support transition from construction to operational phases while ensuring all quality requirements have been achieved.

Audits, Compliance & Performance Monitoring
  • Conduct quality audits, surveillance inspections, compliance reviews and management assessments.
  • Evaluate contractor, supplier and consultant quality performance.
  • Develop quality dashboards, KPIs, trend analysis reports and management review reports.
  • Monitor compliance with Employer Requirements, contractual obligations, approved specifications and statutory requirements.
  • Identify opportunities for quality improvement and process optimization.

Stakeholder Coordination
  • Coordinate with Airport Operators, Designers, Contractors, Independent Testing Agencies, Authorities, Consultants, Vendors and Regulatory Bodies on quality-related matters.
  • Support interface management between multiple contractors and project stakeholders.
  • Facilitate timely resolution of quality issues arising during project execution.
  • Participate in project reviews, technical workshops, governance meetings and quality management forums.

Qualifications

Qualifications & Experience:
  • Bachelor's degree in civil engineering or other relevant Engineering discipline from a recognized university.
  • Master's degree in engineering/ construction management/ quality management or related discipline shall be preferred.
  • Professional certifications in Quality Management, Lead Auditor (ISO 9001), Six Sigma, CQI/IRCA or equivalent shall be preferred.
  • Overall, 15-20 years of professional experience in quality assurance and quality control management for large construction, infrastructure or industrial projects.
  • Minimum 10 years of relevant QA/QC experience on airport or aviation-related projects, including terminal buildings, airside infrastructure, runways, taxiways, aprons, ATC facilities, utility systems and operational airport environments.
  • Demonstrated experience in development, implementation, and administration of ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems for design, construction, testing and commissioning activities.
  • Experience in PMC, EPC, Design-Build, Independent Engineer, or Client-side project management environments.
  • Strong knowledge of airport construction standards, quality control procedures, material testing requirements, inspection methodologies, and commissioning protocols.
  • Experience in brownfield airport developments, operational airports, complex multidisciplinary construction projects, and fast-track project delivery shall be preferred.
  • Strong working knowledge of relevant Indian and international standards, including BIS, IRC, IS Codes, ASTM, ACI, ICAO, FAA, EASA and other industry standards, as applicable.
  • Experience in at least one Greenfield or Brownfield airport project of minimum 10 MPPA capacity involving terminal, airside or major airport infrastructure works.

Additional Information

Key Competencies:
  • Proven leadership in QA/QC management for major airport and aviation infrastructure projects.
  • Strong expertise in Quality Management Systems (QMS) and ISO 9001 implementation.
  • Comprehensive understanding of airport construction quality requirements for terminal, airside, landside, MEP and utility systems.
  • Expertise in Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs), quality audits, material testing, acceptance criteria and compliance management.
  • Strong knowledge of testing, commissioning, ORAT-related quality requirements and handover processes.
  • Experience in NCR management, CAPA implementation, root cause analysis and quality improvement initiatives.
  • Strong capability in quality audits, inspections, supplier quality management and contractor performance monitoring.
  • Proficiency in digital quality management systems, dashboards, reporting tools and performance analytics.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, decision-making and risk assessment capabilities.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management and leadership skills.
  • Ability to manage multidisciplinary teams and complex contractor interfaces.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify quality risks, implement mitigation measures and drive continuous improvement.
  • Ability to perform effectively under demanding project schedules while maintaining the highest standards of quality, compliance and operational readiness.

jobs.title: Manager, Clinical Data Sciences
jobs.description:
Premier Research is looking for a Manager, Clinical Data Sciences to join our Clinical Data Sciences team.

You will help biotech, medtech, and specialty pharma companies transform life-changing ideas and breakthrough science into new medicines, devices, and diagnostics. What we do is profoundly connected to saving and improving lives, and we recognize our team members are the most valuable asset in delivering success.

  • We are here to help you grow, to give you the skills and opportunities to excel at work with the flexibility and balance your life requires.
  • Your ideas influence the way we work, and your voice matters here.
  • As an essential part of our team, you help us deliver the medical innovation that patients are desperate for.

Join us and build your future here.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Serves as primary Clinical Data Sciences contact in assigned studies and ensures that data cleaning is performed in a consistent way between team members
  • Coordinates all tasks within the data science process between different team members from database development to database lock
  • Prepares data science plans, data entry guidelines, data science reports and other documents required for preparing and completing databases
  • Supports database development activities and coordinates database amendments in collaboration with the database development team
  • Provides leadership and advice to Data Coordinators (DCs) and trainees on Clinical Data Science procedures, SOPs, ICH-GCP
  • Provides and/or co-ordinates training and mentoring of DCs and trainees
  • Helps to assess DC performance and execute annual appraisals, monitors career development, and performs end-of-probationary-period reviews
  • Onboards, trains, and evaluates new employees to facilitate integration into the department and to reach target utilization in a timely manner
  • Supports department management in resource planning and allocation; hiring and management of data management staff; and achievement of department financial goals
  • Directly manages a team of Lead Data Scientists and other Clinical Data Sciences staff as assigned

What We're Looking For

  • 12+ years mastery in data management experience, with at least 4 - 7 years of supervisory/management experience. Minimum of 3 years of experience in leading studies.
  • Experience working across clinical data management systems and in-depth knowledge of at least one, preferably Medidata Rave or Calyx EDC
  • Familiar with all phases of a study, e.g., pre-award, study startup/database setup, maintenance and lock
  • Knowledge of data mining and the application of data standards
  • End-to-end operational management and delivery ownership
  • Performance management (goal setting, reviews, continuous feedback)
  • Process improvement and driving key initiatives
  • Budget management and financial awareness
  • AI initiatives and implementation

jobs.title: Occupational Therapist
jobs.description:
An exciting opportunity has arisen for a motivated and enthusiastic Band 5 Occupational Therapist to join the Caithness Integrated Health and Social Care Team.

This is a rewarding role offering a varied caseload across acute hospital in-reach, rural hospital support and community services. You will play a key role in supporting individuals to maximise independence, improve functional ability and ensure safe, timely discharge.

The post will primarily involve occupational therapy in-reach into Caithness General Hospital, working across acute admissions and rehabilitation wards, alongside providing support to rural hospitals and community settings across Caithness. The role focuses on early assessment, discharge planning and rehabilitation, helping to prevent unnecessary admissions and reduce delays.

You will work as part of a multidisciplinary team, including physiotherapists, nurses, social care staff, GPs and other professionals, delivering coordinated, person-centred care.

This post is based in Caithness, the primary base is negotiable depending on location of successful applicant; travel will be required to acute & rural hospitals and community settings.

Hours are typically worked Monday to Friday, 9am–5pm.

A full driving licence is essential, and access to a vehicle for work purposes may be required.

Applicants must be registered with the Health and Care Professions Council (HCPC).

jobs.description:
Description

AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector

The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Engagement Manager to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you will lead delivery quality and velocity for programs spanning several concurrent workstreams, orchestrating 50+ person teams of AWS builders, partners, and customers to deliver transformational AI, data, and enterprise modernization outcomes for the world's leading HCLS organizations.

Your objective will be to deliver distinctive customer business outcomes and experience. In doing so, you will lead the implementation of AWS delivery innovations with customers, including re-designing software development processes to become AI-native end-to-end (AI-DLC). You will bring exceptional stakeholder orchestration and relationship-building skills, intrinsic problem-solving ability to proactively shape program direction, anticipate and mitigate risks, and actively manage interdependencies, and the backbone to influence customers and partners when program success demands it. This is an opportunity to shape the future of the industry directly through hands-on transformation leadership.

We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.

  • Build and nurture trusted executive relationships (VP+), delivering strategic counsel on program direction, health, risks, and trade-offs to inform executive decisions

  • Orchestrate across customer lines of business, IT, and partner teams simultaneously, aligning these stakeholders on priorities, timelines, and definitions of success, and escalating blockers where necessary for resolution
  • Define and track measurable customer business outcomes (e.g., time-to-market acceleration) as the north star for program success, translating technical delivery progress into executive-ready value narratives that demonstrate ROI and inform strategic decisions
  • Own the program financial health, including forecasting, revenue recognition, commercial management, change request negotiation, and scope management for fixed-price, milestone-based delivery constructs
  • Influence human builder and agent builder teams effectively, establishing clear operating models and responsible AI guardrails as delivery increasingly incorporates AI-augmented development workflows and agentic automation
  • Drive adoption of AI-DLC (AI-Driven Development Life Cycle) methodologies across delivery programs, adapting delivery models and team structures for accelerated scale and pace, establishing outcomes-based governance frameworks for AI-native builds, and steering multi-agent systems at scale to drive delivery productivity across the program
  • Establish and enforce governance frameworks for agentic AI in delivery — including observability, cost controls, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and compliance guardrails — ensuring AI-augmented workflows remain auditable, secure, and aligned with customer regulatory requirements
  • Proactively surface ideas on how ProServe and other AWS teams can innovate to help our customers achieve their goals at a faster pace and larger scale

Diverse Experiences

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent
  • 2+ years of solving problems with technology in the Healthcare/Life Sciences Industry experience
  • Experience delivering results for large, cross-functional initiatives/projects, or experience in solving complex business challenges by delivering accurate and timely financial models, analysis, and recommendations that have a proven impact on business (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits)
  • 5+ years of experience in technology transformation program management, with experience leading complex, multi-workstream delivery programs ($5M+/year in professional services revenue) end-to-end, including governance, program delivery quality and velocity, and financial health
  • Experience in adopting and championing emerging delivery methodologies and tooling that accelerate team productivity, including experience adapting governance frameworks for new technology-driven delivery models

Preferred Qualifications

  • cloud certification like AWS Cloud Practitioner or AWS Solutions Architect - Associate
  • Experience creating and implementing large-scale programs
  • MBA, or 3+ years of working with Data & AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage experience
  • Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
  • Experience in advising and influencing executive leadership
  • Experience building trusted relationships with senior customer executives (VP+) to influence strategic and operational decisions and managing escalation paths across complex stakeholder landscapes
  • Experience in software development and proficiency in AI-DLC or equivalent AI-accelerated development methodologies at the governance and program leadership level, including experience adapting estimation, milestone tracking, and quality assurance frameworks for AI-native delivery models

jobs.title: Senior Specialist - Quality Assurance
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Quality Advisor works closely with the Asia HSEQ team and reports to the Associate Quality Excellence (India). This person will be key in implementation of surveillance and monitoring programmes across our projects to ensure a robust and compliant quality culture is in place that aligns to our IMS and Way of Working. This person will also ensure quality compliance and liaise with Project teams where required, closely work with the Associate Quality Excellence (India) to provide source support and guidance to our Project Leaders, Quality leads, and their teams deliver an effective quality management framework across their project programmes.

Responsibilities

  • Ensure that our people follow our way of working, the requirements of the Project Life Cycle (PLC) and Integrated Management System (IMS)
  • Support and promote our quality management system (QMS)
  • Perform online scheduled quality audits and reviews across all projects and undertake surveillances as required, including reports.
  • Use quality management tools and techniques to promote continual improvement and quality awareness
  • Predict quality performance using trends and reports, lead actions to address risk elsewhere in the business
  • Provide quality management support and assistance, working closely with the project teams
  • Provide inputs to our quality statistical tracking and trending data, provide weekly and monthly reports.
  • Advises the projects on suitable quality objectives, KPIs and targets in line with WSP and client quality requirements, report for any deviations noted.
  • Following a risk-based approach, assist in the preparation of the quality audit schedule, ensuring compliance and identify any gaps and/or improvements
  • Report audit findings with recommendations for correction, corrective and improvement to the management
  • Participate in management meetings providing insight into the key areas of risks and opportunities
  • Reviews, collates, and communicates all quality reports from Projects, prepares countries overall KPI reporting and sends to Quality Excellence Team Leader for senior level reporting.
  • Monitor quality trends, conducts analysis, and provides reporting as may be required.
  • Reviews and ensures follow-up of any quality related complaints or concerns.

Why does it matter to our Business


  • Our Way of Working is what differentiates us from our competitors
  • Compliance with our IMS framework drives consistency in our processes and excellence in our service delivery
  • Process and system audits enable us to understand the true position of compliance and risk
  • Embedding a compliance and improvement culture drives long term resilience in our approach to right first time and maintains our organisational ISO certifications
  • Ensures that our governance and operational process are fit for purpose.

How do I know when I am successful at what I do


  • Reduction of complaints and improvement in project teams compliance with WSP way of working.
  • Building strong relationships with project leads and Quality Managers
  • I achieve our targets and objectives for support, compliance, and training.
  • Our people are actively engaging in quality collaboration and excellence
  • Audits are timely done and reported, same with the Project KPIs.

What are my key relationships


  • Head of HSEQ/Quality - Asia (Asia based)
  • Senior Quality Managers – Asia/ India
  • Project Leaders/ Quality Managers (Asia)

Qualifications


Expertise

  • Overall 6 to 8 years experience, 2 years minimum with an international design or construction consultancy. (preferably Asia/ China Region/Singapore)
  • Formal training in an ISO 9001:2015 related course
  • Bachelor's degree in an Engineering and/or Construction related discipline
  • Excellent communication skills, verbal and written in English
  • Experience of operational auditing
  • Basic knowledge of database computer systems and software including Microsoft word, excel, visio and SharePoint.
  • Flexible approach to managing, prioritising and delivering to deadlines in a demanding environment
  • Experience of documentation processes within an engineering, design, or construction environment
  • Good understanding of ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 standards

Key Competencies


Quality Advisor is expected to have the below-listed skills to excel in their role and contribute to high-quality outcomes and deliverables that bring value to the organization.

  • Strong Analytical Skills
  • Attention to Detail
  • Technical Proficiency
  • Excellent Communication Skills
  • Problem-Solving Abilities
  • Knowledge of Quality Techniques
  • Adaptability and Continuous Learning
  • Strong Documentation Skills.

BGV:


  • Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification (BGV) check conducted by a third-party agency appointed by WSP India.
  • Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner.

About Us


WSP is one of the world's leading professional services consulting firms. We are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower. We are technical experts and strategic advisors including engineers, technicians, scientists, architects, planners, surveyors and environmental specialists, as well as other design, program and construction management professionals. We design lasting solutions in the Transportation & Infrastructure, Property & Buildings, Earth & Environment, Power & Energy, Resources and Industry sectors, as well as offering strategic advisory services. Our talented people around the globe engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come.

With approximately 4,000 talented people across 3 locations (Noida, Bengaluru & Mumbai offices) in India and more than 73,000 globally, in 550 offices across 40 countries, we engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come.

At WSP we draw on the diverse skills and capabilities of our employees globally to compete for the most exciting and complex projects across the world and bring the same level of expertise to our local communities. We are proud to be an international collective of innovative thinkers who work on the most complex problems. Unified under one strong brand, we use our local expertise, international reach and global scale to prepare our cities and environments for the future, connect communities and help societies thrive in built and natural ecosystems. True to our guiding principles, our business is built on four cornerstones: Our People, Our Clients, Our Operational Excellence and Our Expertise.

 www.wsp.com

We are

  • Passionate people doing purposeful and sustainable work that helps shape our communities and the future.
  • A collaborative team that thrives on challenges and unconventional thinking.
  • A network of experts channeling our curiosity into creating solutions for complex issues.

Inspired by diversity, driven by inclusion, we work with passion and purpose.


Working with Us

At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.

Our Hybrid Working Module

With us, you can operate in a flexible, agile, yet structured work environment and follow a Hybrid Work Model.

  • Maximize collaboration.
  • Maintain product quality and cultural integrity.
  • Balance community, collaboration, opportunity, productivity, and efficiency.

Health, Safety and Wellbeing


Our people are our greatest asset, and we prioritize a safe work environment. Health, safety, and wellbeing are integral to our culture, with each of us accountable for fostering a safe workplace through our Making Health and Safety Personal initiative. Our Zero Harm Vision drives us to reduce risks through innovative solutions, earning recognition for our global health and safety practices with the prestigious RoSPA Health and Safety Awards for six consecutive years.

Inclusivity and Diversity

We ensure an unbiased approach in hiring, promotion, and performance evaluation, regardless of age, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation, marital status, physical ability, education, social status, or cultural background.

Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.

Join our close-knit community of over 73,300 talented global professionals dedicated to making a positive impact. Together, we can make a difference in communities both near and far.

With us, you can.

Apply today.

Here is a professional and structured job description for a Medical Oncologist (Onco Physician) within a hospital setting, tailored for a formal recruitment layout.

Job Summary

The Medical Oncologist (Onco Physician) is responsible for diagnosing, staging, and treating all forms of cancer using systemic therapies. This role involves managing the complete lifecycle of oncological care, from initial outpatient consultations and inpatient treatment to managing side effects, coordination of multidisciplinary care, and long-term survivorship or palliative management.

Core Key Responsibilities

  • Clinical Consultation & Diagnosis: Conduct outpatient (OPD) and inpatient (IPD) evaluations, accurately diagnose cancer types, determine staging, and interpret laboratory, pathology, and imaging results.
  • Treatment Planning & Delivery: Formulate and manage individualized systemic treatment plans, including the prescription and monitoring of chemotherapy, immunotherapy, targeted therapies, and hormone therapies.
  • Complication & Side-Effect Management: Monitor patients closely during active treatments, managing acute toxicity, treatment-related side effects, oncological emergencies, and medical comorbidities.
  • Multidisciplinary Collaboration: Actively participate in tumor boards and collaborative conferences alongside surgical oncologists, radiation oncologists, radiologists, and pathologists to deliver comprehensive, integrated care.
  • Palliative & Supportive Care: Address symptom burden, pain management, and supportive care needs for advanced-stage cancer patients, maintaining a compassionate approach to quality of life.
  • Documentation & Compliance: Maintain precise, updated electronic health records (EHR) outlining chemotherapy protocols, treatment tracking, and clinical progress notes in compliance with hospital standards and legal healthcare regulations.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Education:
    • MD / DNB in General Medicine, followed by a DM / DNB / DrNB in Medical Oncology from a recognized medical institution.
    • Valid registration with the Medical Council of India (MCI) or State Medical Council (SMC).
  • Experience: Open to varying levels (typically 1-3 years for junior consultant roles; 5+ years for senior consultant tracks).
  • Key Competencies: Strong clinical acumen in systemic therapies, meticulous attention to protocol safety, excellent empathetic communication skills, and ability to handle high-stress clinical environments.
