About The Role

We're looking for a senior Commercial Analytics Consultant with a broad, hands-on grounding in pharma and HLS sales and marketing data — someone who has spent close to a decade using that data to solve real commercial problems and is ready to lead engagements, not just execute on them. You'll anchor our HLS analytics team's thinking across a wide spectrum of initiatives spanning marketing, commercial & sales, and customer/omnichannel analytics, bringing a consulting mindset and enough seniority to own client relationships end to end.

You'll lead work across areas like campaign and brand analytics, channel analytics, omnichannel engagement and next-best-action, and hyper-personalization — as well as the data management, dashboarding and reporting work that underpins all of it. You'll also help shape our own analytics products and IP, bringing life sciences context that makes them genuinely fit for the industry. Marketing mix modeling is part of that toolkit alongside these other methodologies, and you'll be equally comfortable framing a new problem with a client as you are directing the team that solves it.

What You'll Do

Marketing Analytics

  • Lead campaign performance analytics, content testing and product development analytics engagements for pharma brand teams.
  • Own brand & portfolio analytics and competitive insights work, from framing through to client-ready output.
  • Direct the application of marketing mix and optimization approaches — including MMM — as part of a broader measurement toolkit.

Commercial & Sales Analytics

  • Lead partner & channel analytics engagements across pharma commercial teams.
  • Own 4P (product, price, place, promotion) insights and broader commercial analytics initiatives.
  • Direct field force effectiveness and territory-level commercial analytics work.

Customer & Omnichannel Analytics

  • Lead omnichannel engagement and customer experience analytics across pharma commercial teams.
  • Own next-best-action, digital shelf and hyper-personalization use cases from scoping to delivery.
  • Guide patient safety / adverse event monitoring analytics where relevant.

Data Management, Visualization & Reporting

  • Partner with data engineering and platform teams to structure and integrate sales, marketing, digital and omnichannel data for analysis-ready use.
  • Set the standard for dashboards and reporting assets (e.g. Power BI or equivalent) that make commercial analytics outputs genuinely usable for brand and field teams.
  • Define reporting requirements and data structures for recurring commercial performance tracking as well as one-off analyses.
  • Own data quality, consistency and governance across the sales & marketing data feeding into analytics and reporting outputs.

Consulting & Client Leadership

  • Own client relationships and lead conversations end to end, translating open-ended business questions into scoped analytical approaches across the above spectrum.
  • Direct delivery teams — including marketing mix modeling, data engineering and visualization — bringing pharma commercial context to their work.
  • Shape pharma commercial context into proposal development and scoping for prospective clients, including new business conversations.
  • Bring life sciences and pharma context to the ongoing development of our own analytics products and IP, helping shape them to be genuinely fit for the industry's commercial use cases.
  • Mentor and guide cross-functional team members working across these engagements.

What You Bring

  • 8+ years in pharma/HLS commercial analytics, working directly with sales and marketing data — promotional spend, prescription/volume, digital and omnichannel engagement, and CRM/field activity.
  • A track record of solving a wide variety of commercial analytics problem statements, spanning areas such as campaign/brand analytics, channel analytics, or customer/omnichannel analytics.
  • Hands-on experience with data structuring, dashboarding and reporting (e.g. Power BI or equivalent tools), and a strong sense of what makes a dashboard genuinely usable for a commercial or brand audience.
  • A consulting mindset with the seniority to own new, loosely-defined problems and structure an analytical approach directly with the client.
  • Working exposure to marketing mix modeling or other media/channel measurement approaches.
  • Strong client-facing communication skills; comfortable owning senior stakeholder relationships and leading conversations independently.
  • Ability to translate fluently between business/brand stakeholders and technical delivery teams in both directions.
  • Experience mentoring or leading cross-functional team members within a project or engagement structure.

Nice To Have

  • Exposure to payer analytics or broader healthcare analytics — e.g. claims-based insights, formulary or market access analytics — beyond core pharma commercial data.
  • Exposure to sales force effectiveness or territory alignment analytics.
  • Experience with next-best-action, hyper-personalization or digital shelf analytics.
  • Familiarity with synthetic control, test-and-learn or other causal measurement approaches.
  • Experience with data pipeline or automated data ingestion tools that feed into reporting and dashboarding layers.
  • Prior experience contributing to internal analytics products, accelerators or IP.
  • Prior consulting or client-services background, with experience scoping and delivering engagements from discovery through to results.

What We Offer

  • A senior, client-facing seat spanning the full spectrum of HLS commercial analytics, with real ownership over engagements.
  • A voice in shaping our analytics products and IP for the life sciences industry, alongside client delivery leadership.
  • Exposure to a wide portfolio of global pharma and life sciences clients and commercial data ecosystems.
  • Close partnership across our marketing mix, data engineering and visualization teams, with real influence over how engagements are scoped and framed.
  • A collaborative, flexible working model with a clear path into broader commercial analytics practice leadership.

jobs.title: Instructional Designer
jobs.description:
The Instructional Designer is a practitioner who independently designs and develops high-quality learning solutions. You bring strong command of instructional design methodology, content development, and technical execution, producing learning materials that meet rigorous quality standards.

This role sits above the Instructional Designer on the career ladder. You work with greater autonomy on more complex briefs, apply AI-assisted workflows, and bring emerging awareness of quality, consulting, and ecosystem topics. The Sr. ID is a critical execution anchor on project teams and a deliberate stepping stone toward the Learning Experience Architect path.

What You'll Do Daily

No two days look the same. On any given day you might be:

  • Designing a learning solution from a brief: choosing the right structure, writing learning objectives, and making the key decisions on modality and interaction pattern
  • Building out a storyboard in Storyline or Rise, writing the scenario branches, and making sure the interactions actually test what they are supposed to test
  • Working through SME feedback on a module you drafted, deciding what to take, what to push back on, and updating the content accordingly
  • Running a QA pass on your own work or a colleague's, checking for accuracy, accessibility, and whether the design holds up pedagogically
  • Applying AI tools to speed up a content drafting task or generate variation options for a scenario
  • Sitting in on a needs analysis conversation with a senior team member, taking notes, and starting to recognise which parts of the brief are driving the design

Education

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Instructional Design, Education, Communication, or related field

Experience

2–7 years in instructional design and learning development

Instructional Design

Proficient in applying instructional design frameworks (ADDIE, Bloom's Taxonomy, contemporary adult learning principles) to design effective solutions; independently conducts needs analysis, defines measurable objectives, and ensures pedagogical soundness across a range of project types

Content Development & Storyboarding

Proficient in creating compelling storyboards and learning content that translate complex information into digestible materials; independently produces content with appropriate examples, narrative flow, and cultural adaptability

Authoring Tools & Development

Proficient in building functional eLearning modules using Articulate Storyline or Rise, including interactivity, branching scenarios, and SCORM compliance; working knowledge of LMS platforms; proficient with business tools such as SharePoint, Word / PowerPoint / Excel / Outlook / Teams

Visual Design & Multimedia

Proficient in creating professional visual assets and multimedia elements that enhance learning; independently applies design principles (color theory, typography, layout) to ensure visual consistency, accessibility (WCAG compliance), and brand alignment

Learning Experience Design

Working knowledge of user-centered learning experience design; can apply emotional appeal, learner motivation, and experience-layer thinking with guidance from architects; developing toward independent application

Quality Assurance & Standards

Working knowledge of quality assurance practices; applies established QA frameworks with guidance to ensure learning products meet standards for accuracy, functionality, and pedagogical effectiveness

AI & Emerging Technology

Proficient in leveraging AI-powered tools and emerging technologies to accelerate learning design, enhance quality, and drive innovation; independently applies AI-assisted workflows across the design and development lifecycle

Communication

Strong written and verbal communication skills; collaborates effectively with SMEs, stakeholders, and team members

Why Infopro Learning

Innovation & Impact

Work on award-winning projects creating impactful learning experiences for global Fortune 500 companies.

Growth & Development

Develop expertise through challenging projects, mentorship from senior architects, and access to cutting-edge technologies. The Sr. ID role is a deliberate stepping stone toward the Learning Experience Architect path.

Culture & Balance

Join a collaborative team that values creativity and work-life balance. Enjoy competitive compensation and recognition for your contributions.

Job requirements

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Awareness of performance consulting principles and when learning interventions are or are not the right solution
  • Familiarity with learning ecosystem architecture and curriculum mapping concepts
  • Basic familiarity with learning analytics platforms and interpreting engagement or completion data
  • Experience with business simulations, scenario-based learning, or immersive learning technologies (VR/AR)
  • Awareness of change management or adoption strategies in learning contexts
  • Advanced certifications in instructional design, UX design, or learning technologies

jobs.title: Senior QA Test Engineer
jobs.description:
Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.

The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and AgroScience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.

In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1,000 companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.

In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6.95 billion; and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

Quality Assurance & Testing

  • Analyze requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria to identify test scenarios.
  • Create, maintain, and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test data.
  • Perform Functional, Integration, Regression, Smoke, and UAT support testing.
  • Validate complex business workflows across eLIMS-BPT and integrated applications.
  • Ensure complete test coverage and traceability between requirements and test evidence.

Test Automation

  • Design, develop, and maintain automation frameworks and automated test suites.
  • Improve automation coverage to reduce manual testing effort and increase release confidence.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Analyze automation failures and continuously improve test reliability.

Defect Management

  • Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects through closure.
  • Perform detailed root cause analysis for escaped defects.
  • Work closely with developers and business stakeholders to validate fixes.

Release & Validation Support

  • Support release planning, validation activities, and controlled deployments.
  • Participate in release readiness reviews and risk assessments.
  • Ensure required evidence is generated and maintained for regulated environments.
  • Support audit and compliance activities when required.

Collaboration & Leadership

  • Collaborate with Product Owners, Developers, Business Analysts, Functional Analysts, and Support teams.
  • Mentor junior QA engineers and guide testing best practices.
  • Participate actively in grooming, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Drive process improvements to improve product quality and team efficiency.

Quality Engineering

  • Define and track quality metrics such as defect leakage, automation coverage, and test effectiveness.
  • Recommend improvements in testing strategies, tools, and processes.
  • Promote a quality-first mindset across delivery teams.

Required Skills & Experience

Technical Skills

  • 5–8+ years of experience in Software Quality Assurance.
  • Strong experience in Functional and Regression Testing.
  • Experience with Test Automation tools such as WebDriver IO ( preferred) or Selenium or Playwright, or equivalent.
  • Experience with scripting language such as Java script/ Type script ( preferred) or C# or Java , or equivalent.
  • Good understanding of API testing using Postman or similar tools.
  • Experience with SQL and database validation.
  • Knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies.
  • Experience using Azure DevOps or similar ALM tools.
  • Understanding of CI/CD concepts and release management practices.

Domain Knowledge

  • Experience in Healthcare, Life Sciences, Laboratory Systems, LIMS, ELN, or regulated environments is preferred.
  • Understanding of validation concepts and evidence generation in regulated systems is an advantage.

Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership.
  • Mentoring and leadership capabilities.
  • Strong attention to detail and quality mindset.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Performance Testing (such as JMeter or equivalent ).
  • Experience with Azure services and cloud-based applications.
  • Experience working on enterprise-scale distributed systems.
  • Knowledge of security testing concepts.

Key Success Measures

  • Low defect leakage to production.
  • Improved automation coverage.
  • High-quality release validation.
  • Effective collaboration across teams.
  • Timely delivery of testing activities.
  • Continuous improvement initiatives contributing to overall product quality.

Additional Information

Personal Skills:

  • Customer-service oriented with a problem-solving attitude.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy is essential.
  • Entrepreneurial thinking and flexibility to change.
  • Very good English communication skills (concise writing and orally convincing);
  • Structured and clear writing skills.
  • Proven ability to solve complex business problems using analytical reasoning.

jobs.title: Business Development Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT EVERYDAYSMILE

EverydaySmile is India's dedicated healthcare growth and transformation practice, built for hospitals and clinics across Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities. We combine AI-powered auditing, hands-on operational execution, and ground-level business development to help healthcare providers grow sustainably.

ROLE SUMMARY

We are looking for a driven, relationship-first Business Development Manager to lead EverydaySmile's growth across Lucknow and major cities of Uttar Pradesh. This is a dual-mandate role: you will sell EverydaySmile's healthcare consulting and growth services to hospitals and clinics, and sell our Pressure Injector product to diagnostic centers equipped with CT-Scan facilities. If you understand healthcare sales, build trust quickly, and are energized by being on the road meeting decision-makers face-to-face, this role is built for you.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Business Development — Hospital & Clinic Services

•    Identify, approach, and onboard hospitals and clinics across Lucknow and key UP cities for EverydaySmile's healthcare consulting, operations, and growth programs

•    Build and nurture strong relationships with hospital owners, administrators, and doctors

•    Conduct in-person meetings, presentations, and pitches to prospective clients

•    Consistently achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets across both client sign-ups and Pressure Injector sales

Product Sales — Pressure Injector (Diagnostic Centers)

•    Identify and engage diagnostic and imaging centers with CT-Scan facilities across the assigned territory

•    Present and sell the Pressure Injector product to relevant decision-makers

•    Coordinate product demonstrations, negotiate terms, and close sales

•    Maintain long-term relationships to support repeat business, servicing needs, and referrals

Territory Management & Travel

•    Own and grow the business pipeline across Lucknow and major cities of Uttar Pradesh

•    Travel extensively within the assigned territory to meet prospective and existing clients on the ground

Reporting & CRM

•    Maintain accurate, up-to-date records of leads, meetings, and sales activity in the CRM

•    Share regular sales reports and on-ground market feedback with the leadership team

REQUIREMENTS & QUALIFICATIONS

•    Graduate degree required; MBA compulsory (Sales, Marketing, or Healthcare Management preferred)

•    Minimum 1+ years of sales experience in healthcare-related products or services (hospital sales, medical devices, diagnostics, or pharma preferred)

•    Fluency in both Hindi and English — verbal and written — is compulsory

•    Must personally own a laptop and a two-wheeler or four-wheeler for regular travel

•    Willingness to travel extensively across Uttar Pradesh

Skills We're Looking For

•    Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills

•    Self-motivated with a target-driven, ownership-first mindset

•    Comfortable working independently in the field with minimal supervision

•    Working knowledge of CRM tools and MS Office / Google Workspace

•    Understanding of the hospital or diagnostic center ecosystem is a strong plus

COMPENSATION

Fixed Salary

₹3,00,000 per annum

Incentive

Performance-based, linked to sales — paid quarterly

Operational Expense

Travel & operational allowance provided separately

EMPLOYMENT TERMS

•    Sales targets are set on a quarterly basis, directly linked to the performance incentive payout

•    This role carries a probationary period of 3 months from the date of joining, following which continuation is confirmed based on performance
